B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institution.
Proficiency in computer-aided design tools, project management software (MS Project/Primavera), and technical documentation.
Experience Overview
Minimum 8 years of total post-qualification experience in execution, site supervision, and quality control of major infrastructure projects, with a strong preference for Hydro Electric Projects (HEP), Tunneling/Underground works, or Dam/Powerhouse construction.
Key Responsibilities
Site Execution & Supervision: Act as the primary on-site engineering representative to oversee daily civil construction activities, including surface/underground excavation, slope stabilization, tunneling, concreting, and structural works.
Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC): Ensure all construction materials (cement, steel, aggregates) and workmanship rigorously comply with national standards, project technical specifications, and design drawings.
Progress Monitoring: Track daily site progress against baseline construction schedules, report bottlenecks, and assist senior management in developing recovery plans for delayed activities.
Technical Compliance & Drawings: Review construction drawings, method statements, bar-bending schedules, and technical submittals at the site level, flagging discrepancies proactively.
Contract Administration Support: Maintain meticulous daily site records, measurement books (MB), joint measurements, and documentation required for tracking variations and contractor billing.
Safety & Health Compliance: Strictly enforce site safety rules, health guidelines, and environmental protocols, working closely with the HSE team, particularly given the challenging Himalayan terrain of Arunachal Pradesh.
Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate smoothly with contractors, testing laboratories, and multidisciplinary project teams to resolve technical issues swiftly on-site.

Location:
Hosakote, IN, 562122 Bangalore, IN, 562122
Position Type: Professional
Permanent/Temporary: Permanent
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
Who we are and what we believe in

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.
Supply Network Quality
Interested to join a team who works hand and in hand with our supply network partners to secure the best product quality for our end-customer Driven by a strong quality mindset Convinced that building solid relationships with supply network partners is key to continuously improve Or just curious about the title These are already good reasons to look at this job posting!
This is us, your new colleagues
The Supply Network Quality (SNQ) organization, belonging to Truck Quality, is driving the supply partner base towards premium automotive quality standards and world-class performance. We are responsible for continuously improving the supply partner base and the quality of purchased parts. There is now an opportunity to join the SNQ India team. By joining our team, you can expect to be warmly welcomed, respected and appreciated for who you are. We value difference convinced that it is key for a team to better perform in our work when everyone can express themselves freely. Your personal development is our priority making you, we hope, happy and motivated to come every day to work!
Requirements
The Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP) is responsible for managing purchased-part quality activities within the Volvo plant to secure uninterrupted production and ensure supplied components meet quality requirements. We look for a candidate who enjoys working in a dynamic manufacturing environment, has strong commitment, takes ownership, works effectively both independently and in teams, and can handle a high pace. The candidate should have strong collaboration and communication skills to work with suppliers, plant functions and SQEs, be capable of managing multiple quality concerns simultaneously, and demonstrate a proactive approach to problem-solving and risk management.
Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP)
Location: Hoskote,Bangalore - 562122
Main Responsibilities
Manage purchased-part quality concerns and assess risks to plant operations, other Volvo sites and customers.
Secure immediate containment through segregation, inspection, sorting, rework and replacement with suppliers and plant functions.
Manage supplier Inspection Reports and quality claims in accordance with Volvo Group processes and SPQAM requirements.
Drive supplier root-cause analysis, validate and approve 8D reports, and verify corrective-action effectiveness before closure.
Coordinate supplier quality crises and escalate risks to safety, conformity, production continuity and customers.
Collaborate with suppliers, plant functions, Engineering and SQEs to resolve concerns and prevent recurrence.
Secure supplier launch readiness for new product and localization projects with SQEs, suppliers and plant functions to support smooth Volvo plant SOP.
Monitor supplier performance and drive risk-based improvements, investigations, process reviews, audits and inspections with SQEs.
Participate in Part Handling Reviews and assess handling, packaging, logistics, assembly and product or process change risks.
Share operational evidence and lessons learned with SQEs and other Volvo plants to strengthen prevention.
Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) arising from supplier-related quality issues and drive actions.
Coordinate supplier visits at the plant and facilitate the necessary support.
Competence and Experience
Degree in Mechanical, Automobile or a relevant engineering discipline.
Experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality or production, preferably in automotive.
Technical knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, handling, packaging and logistics.
Knowledge of automotive quality standards, core quality tools, Lean, root-cause analysis and 8D methodology.
Experience in containment, supplier claims and corrective-action verification.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications, with knowledge of dimensional inspection and measurement techniques.
Analytical, structured and preventive mindset, with independent working and timely decision-making under production pressure.
Strong collaboration and assertive supplier communication skills, professional English and willingness to travel.

Our people are passionate about what they do, they aim for high performance and thrive on teamwork and learning. Everyday life at Volvo is defined by a climate of support, care and mutual respect.
If you aspire to grow and make an impact, join us on our journey to create a better and more resilient society for the coming generations.

Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.

Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported

Job Summary
The opportunity : Analyst-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process Controls - Mumbai
AMI :
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process Controls :
through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.


Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Support execution of Internal Audit and Risk Consulting engagements
Perform process walkthroughs and document key processes, risks, and controls
Prepare and update Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs)
Perform sample testing and maintain audit working papers
Analyse financial and operational data to identify exceptions and control gaps
Assist in drafting audit observations, reports, and management presentations
Coordinate with process owners for information and supporting evidence
Support seniors and managers in timely delivery of engagements


Required Skills
Understanding of Internal Audit, IFC, SOX and Risk Assessment
Basic knowledge of SAP/ ERP environments
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
Good analytical and problem-solving abilities
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work effectively in a team and manage multiple deliverables


Qualifications
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Commerce
Chartered Accountant


Experience
Financial Analysis (3+ years)


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
Job Title: Apprentice Hiring
Location: Mumbai, India
About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.


Role Description
This is a Business Finance role for the Private Bank (PB) franchise and is responsible for managing all PB Divisional Finance topics, facing off to CFO and Business Finance Global Leads and business managers across hub locations.
The incumbent would be responsible for a range of business finance activities including month end ledger close, journal postings, PL reporting, Revenue Flash/Actuals, Balance Sheet substantiation, financial disclosures; and so on.


Your key responsibilities
Business Finance is responsible for the production, validation and reporting and analysis of daily PL including attribution, month end financial statements including substantiation, and disclosures, for their area, in line with applicable internal policies and external regulatory, statutory and control frameworks.


Key deliverables for this role include:
Supporting preparation of Revenue Flash, explaining variance vs prior trends and actuals as they develop during ledger close.
Engaging with Business managers across regions/businesses for the above - this is critical due to lack of daily PL, requiring detailed driver based explanations of movements, cyclical and episodic events
Supporting other deliverables including daily PL reporting, FX exposure management, financial disclosures and Balance sheet substantiation.
Supporting performance of key controls including Analytical review, Financial Adjustment reviews, Book Completeness.
Managing audit requirements


Your skills and experience
Commerce Graduate or MBA Finance with specialization in Financial accounting reporting
Good communication and articulation skills with experience in facing off to business heads
Ability to work in a diverse team with cross-cultural exposure
Very good desktop and presentation skills
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for assisting with the administrative and clerical duties of the Human Resources department, management of team member files, support of the hiring process, onboarding of new hires, coordination of training activities, and so on. A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . Relevant work experience in human resources and administrative.
Proficient in the use of the Microsoft Office suite.
Demonstrates knowledge of fundamental labor laws and employment regulations, or exhibits a willingness to learn about them
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Provide exceptional front office support: Welcome and assist guests, applicants, and team members with prompt, professional, and courteous service
Support daily office operations: Provide administrative support such as word processing, data entry, filing, and copying to support HR department operations
Manage communication: Handle phone calls, emails, mail processing, and meeting coordination
Coordinate travel arrangements: Organize and manage bookings for HR department managers
Support special projects: Assist with departmental initiatives or ad-hoc assignments

Description:
Join a team that delivers well-controlled compensation programs and processes across salary, incentive compensation, and market benchmarking. This role offers hands-on analytical work that translates complex compensation data into clear insights and recommendations. You will partner closely with Compensation colleagues, Human Resources Business Partners, and other stakeholders to deliver effective compensation solutions. You will contribute to reward initiatives while maintaining strong governance, documentation, and confidentiality.
Job summary
As a Compensation Associate, you will support the delivery of compensation programs and processes, providing analytical and advisory support across salary, incentive compensation, market benchmarking, compensation planning, and other reward initiatives. The role requires strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex compensation data into clear insights and recommendations. You will partner closely with Compensation colleagues, Human Resources Business Partners, and other stakeholders to deliver effective, well-controlled compensation solutions.
Job responsibilities
Support annual compensation planning, including salary and incentive compensation modelling, allocation analysis, planning guidance, reporting and post-planning analytics.
Help conduct market and internal compensation analysis, including benchmarking, range positioning, pay distribution and employee-level analysis to support compensation decisions.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies and potential compensation issues, translating findings into clear and actionable insights.
Support the development, review and maintenance of salary ranges and compensation structures, including market competitiveness and range-health analysis.
Provide compensation analysis and guidance to Human Resources Business Partners and other stakeholders, helping them understand compensation outcomes and apply established compensation frameworks.
Support job and employee-level compensation reviews, including new hires, promotions, salary adjustments and other compensation-related requests.
Prepare high-quality management information, dashboards and presentations, clearly communicating key findings and recommendations.
Partner across Human Resources and other functions to ensure compensation processes are executed accurately, consistently and within required timelines.
Maintain a strong controls and governance mindset, ensuring appropriate review, documentation, data quality and confidentiality of compensation information.
Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis and processes using Microsoft Excel, approved artificial intelligence-enabled tools and other analytical capabilities.
Contribute to broader compensation initiatives and projects, including policy changes, regulatory requirements and process enhancements.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Relevant experience in Compensation, Human Resources analytics, Finance, Human Resources consulting or a related analytical discipline.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to work confidently with large datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation and analysis.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify inconsistencies and ensure accuracy of compensation outputs.
Ability to interpret data and translate analysis into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex compensation concepts clearly.
Strong organization and prioritization skills, particularly when managing multiple deliverables during time-sensitive compensation cycles.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Human Resources and broader stakeholder groups.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee and compensation information.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Prior experience in Compensation or Total Rewards, ideally within a large, complex or global organization.
Experience with compensation benchmarking, salary structures, annual compensation planning or incentive compensation.
Working knowledge of compensation survey and market-pricing methodologies.
Experience with Human Resources and compensation systems and reporting tools.
Bachelor s degree or equivalent experience.

Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager Global Taxation (CA, 0–5 Yrs)
Role Overview
We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (0–5 years experience) to join our team as Assistant Manager / Manager. You will manage end-to-end global tax compliance, provisioning, and reporting across the US, Canada, Australia, and India.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage multi-state US (SALT / Franchise Tax) and Canada (GST / HST /PST) Tax compliances and quarterly Australian BAS filings.
• Prepare monthly tax provision, tax reconciliations and review monthly Tax GLs, effective tax rate analysis,
current and deferred tax calculations and return-to-provision adjustments for all US, Canada, Australia subsidiaries.
• Prepare monthly / quarterly estimated tax workings and supporting schedules and documentation.
• Prepare and review annual US Federal and State return filings (Form 1120, Form 1120F), Canada and Australia Income Tax Returns and related schedules / compliances.
• Prepare transfer pricing workings and documentation and ensuring compliance with group TP policies and global TP regulations.
• Evaluate cross-border transactions, interpret DTAAs, assess PE risks, and determine consequent tax implications (such as withholding tax rates and foreign tax credits).
• Identify potential tax issues and assist in developing solutions or planning strategies.
• Overhaul and monitor state-level tax portals, resolve tax notices, tax audits and queries from IRS and various state tax departments, support statutory / internal audits. Maintain proper documentation and ensure accuracy and compliance in all tax filings.
• Identify and implement process improvements and technology tools to enhance efficiency in tax operations.
Work on tax software and internal trackers to ensure smooth workflow management.
• Conduct basic to intermediate tax research on legislative and regulatory developments in the US, Canada and Australia taxation. Develop technical skills by remaining up to date on trends, new developments and
tax authority decisions, and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Candidate Profile
• Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory (US CPA / EA is an added advantage).
• Experience: 0–5 years of post-qualification experience in corporate tax. Exposure to US / Global taxation is a major plus.
• Core Competencies: Intrinsic understanding of tax concepts and compliance landscapes, strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, and comfortable collaborating across international time zones with consultants and internal teams.

International Sales - Admissions Counsellor

Location: Marol, Mumbai (Work from Office)

Founded in 2015, upGrad has established itself as Asia's largest integrated learning, skilling, and workforce development company. Our diverse portfolio includes a range of higher education programs, such as online and hybrid degrees, certifications, boot camps, diplomas, and executive doctorate programs designed specifically for working professionals. We aim to empower the global workforce with enhanced curricula and competencies that make individuals job and market ready. By partnering with leading Indian and international universities, upGrad ensures that our programs are rich in experiential learning and meet global education standards. Our offerings span multiple domains,
including Technology, Data Science, Management, Education, Law, Human Resources, Digital Marketing, Supply Chain, Emerging Technologies, and Business Analytics.

At upGrad, we are committed to fostering equality, diversity, and inclusion as a premier online education platform. Our dedicated initiatives drive business results while contributing to a brighter
future for our employees, global learners, university and business partners, and the communities we serve. We celebrate individuals who bring their authentic selves to work, and we encourage applicants
to share any specific needs or requests for support during the application process.

We are seeking motivated candidates from Mumbai with 2-5 years of experience in International Sales, B2C, or B2B sales, and exceptional communication skills. Join us in our mission to transform digital
learning.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Serve as a mentor and trusted advisor to potential learners, guiding them in their career journeys.
Provide personalized counseling to prospective students, helping them map their career paths and demonstrating how upGrad can be a catalyst for their professional growth.
Meet weekly enrollment, revenue, and collection targets.
Articulate the uniqueness and effectiveness of upGrads online learning model.
Manage the complete sales closing lifecycle for assigned leads, which includes making phone calls, delivering product demonstrations, closing sales, and maintaining post-sales relationships.
Keep a comprehensive database of all interactions with leads and provide regular updates.

What we are Looking For:
Exceptional communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
Proven experience in international sales, with a preference for EdTech sales.
Strong understanding of the cultural nuances and buying behaviors of students from across the globe
High-achieving sales performers with a documented track record of success.
Active listeners and trustworthy individuals capable of building rapport with potential learners.
A patient and empathetic approach to handling diverse situations.
A disciplined mindset for funnel building, feedback tracking, task prioritization, and consistently exceeding targets and deadlines.
A sales-oriented mindset to effectively communicate upGrads offerings and achieve revenue objectives.
A passion for always delivering exceptional customer service.
Basic proficiency in MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel) is preferred.

Eligibility ;

A bachelors degree in any field; a degree in Business, Marketing, or education is preferred.
2-5 years of experience in international sales
Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.
Familiarity with CRM tools and sales tracking software is an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong work ethics and a proactive attitude toward achieving results.

Shift Timings:

NA & US Region: 8 PM - 5 AM or 10 PM - 7 AM
Please note: The above timings are subject to change based on business requirements
Location: Mumbai (Work from Office)
Working Days: 6 days a week (Certain Saturdays may be given as a week off, based on business feasibility)

Join us at upGrad and be a part of a dynamic team that is reshaping the future of education!

Description:
Job Summary:
Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications and trains others. Works under minimal supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Verifies the final quality of products on the production line. Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects. Separates products that do not meet the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment. Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems. Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation. Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.
Key Responsibilities Skills
Hands-on experience in operating and maintaining metrology laboratory equipment, including CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine), Roundness Tester, and Surface Finish Tester .
Expertise in programming and measurement execution on metrology equipment.
Strong knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning Tolerancing (GDT) and interpretation of engineering drawings.
Experience in Measurement System Analysis (MSA) , calibration management, and layout inspection activities.
Conducting and managing incoming/receiving inspection of components and materials.
Handling supplier quality issues , including investigation, containment, corrective actions, and follow-up.
Knowledge of Corrective Action Requests (CAR) and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCAR) , including root cause analysis and effectiveness verification.
Ensuring compliance with quality standards, inspection plans, and customer requirements.
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives for metrology and supplier quality processes
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, Metrology e. g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e. g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc. ) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Laboratory Management - Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Job Summary:
Participates in the recruiting, screening, and interviewing processes to fill current or expected job vacancies. May communicate with applicants and candidates regarding consideration for employment and the specifics of the role.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruits, screens and interviews internal and external applicants to fill current or expected job vacancies in alignment with the organization s recruiting strategies and legislative requirements. Reviews and evaluates applicants background information in comparison to the job vacancy and facilitates the applicable reference checks, background checks and applicant testing processes. Communicates with candidates regarding their application status; may extend job offers and prepares the appropriate job offer paperwork processes. Informs candidates of jobs duties and responsibilities, compensation and benefits programs, work schedule and conditions, and career advancement opportunities. Ensures the organizations recruiting processes are carried out in accordance with applicable internal policies, procedures and government legislation. Communicates with external recruitment contacts to provide information regarding career opportunities. May travel to recruiting events. Arranges interviews and travel logistics for selected applicants; partners with line human resources to ensure interview and selection process progress smoothly. Collaborates with hiring managers and other key stakeholders in the recruiting process. Utilizes and maintains applicant tracking system including periodic reporting to stakeholders.
Strong Stakeholder Management
Weekly Business Travel
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.

Candidate Assessment and Selection - Defines qualification requirements and selection criteria for open positions using Cummins tools; employs objective selection processes that meet compliance requirements; assesses, evaluates and selects candidates against pre-determined job specifics and "Select for Cummins" competencies, and communicates openly with candidate and stakeholders to ensure timely hiring outcomes.

External Talent Sourcing - Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field or equivalent experience required.

Experience:
Minimal level of relevant work experience required.

Description:
We are seeking an accomplished Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Leader to provide strategic HSE leadership across our Aftermarket Business in India.
This role will be based out of Pune, India.
As an HSE Leader, you will lead the execution of regional HSE and sustainability strategies, ensuring alignment with global objectives and driving continuous improvement across multiple sites and operations.
You will lead and develop a diverse regional HSE team, partnering with Regional Leadership , Site and Service leaders, and other key stakeholders to strengthen the organizations safety culture, improve environmental performance, manage operational risks, and ensure regulatory compliance.
Through strategic leadership, collaboration, and effective change management, you will influence stakeholders across multiple locations, drive standardization of HSE practices, and deliver measurable improvements in health, safety, environmental, and sustainability performance.
This role may require up to 25% domestic travel and 10% international travel.
1. Key Responsibilities
Regional HSE Strategy and Execution: Lead the implementation of regional Health, Safety, Environmental, and sustainability strategies, ensuring alignment with global priorities and business objectives while driving measurable performance improvements across sites.
HSE Governance and Compliance: Strengthen HSE governance, audit effectiveness, reporting standards, compliance processes, and risk management practices to ensure consistent application of policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Regional Leadership , site leaders, business teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to implement HSE programs, tools, and initiatives that minimize operational risks and enhance business performance.
Safety Culture and Risk Management: Champion a proactive safety culture by promoting accountability, risk awareness, employee engagement, and the adoption of HSE best practices across regional operations.
Team Leadership and Development: Lead, coach, and develop regional HSE professionals and site teams, building technical capabilities, encouraging continuous learning, and fostering an environment of trust and psychological safety.
Incident Management and Investigation: Provide leadership in investigating significant incidents, identifying root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, and ensuring lessons learned are effectively communicated and implemented across the region.
Continuous Improvement and Standardization: Identify, evaluate, and implement HSE best practices across sites to improve consistency, operational effectiveness, compliance, and overall HSE performance.
Global Collaboration and Sustainability: Represent the region in global HSE forums and initiatives, partnering with global teams to support policy development, process improvements, and the achievement of sustainability objectives.
Change Management: Lead HSE-related organizational and cultural change initiatives, supporting system integration, adoption of global standards, and continuous improvement across regional operations.
Regional Leadership Team Responsibilities
As a member of the Regional DBU and NRP Leadership Team, the HSE Leader serves as a strategic business partner, ensuring health, safety, environmental, and sustainability considerations are fully integrated into business strategy, operational excellence, and enterprise decision-making. This role provides executive leadership, governance, and independent oversight of regional HSE performance while supporting overall business objectives.
Key Leadership Responsibilities:
Partner with regional DBU and NRP leadership to integrate HSE risk management, sustainability, and compliance into business strategy, growth initiatives, and operational plans.
Provide expert guidance on HSE risks and opportunities, ensuring critical risks are identified, mitigated, and escalated appropriately.
Lead governance and oversight of HSE management systems, critical controls, Serious Injury and Fatality (SIF) prevention programs, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance.
Influence executive decisions related to acquisitions, capital investments, facility expansions, organizational changes, new technologies, and business continuity planning.
Champion a culture of safety, environmental responsibility, psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the region.
Monitor and communicate HSE performance, emerging risks, regulatory developments, and sustainability priorities to senior leadership.
Represent the region on HSE matters with regulators, customers, corporate leadership, external auditors, industry organizations, and community stakeholders.
Develop organizational capability by strengthening HSE leadership, succession planning, and operational competence across the business.
Ensure effective allocation of HSE resources and investments based on business risk and strategic priorities.
Serve as an independent advisor to executive leadership, balancing business objectives with the protection of people, the environment, company reputation, and long-term value creation.
Leadership Expectations:
Participate as a full Regional Leadership Team member with shared accountability for overall business performance.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Operations, HR, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to achieve HSE and business objectives.
Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on HSE risks, opportunities, resilience, and sustainable business performance.
2. Key Competencies
Strategic Leadership: Ability to translate global HSE strategies into actionable regional plans, aligning safety and sustainability priorities with business objectives.
People Leadership and Team Development: Demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, coach and mentor professionals, build technical capabilities, and promote accountability and engagement.
Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple sites, functions, and geographies.
Business Acumen: Understanding of business and operational priorities, with the ability to balance HSE requirements, regulatory compliance, and business performance.
Change Leadership: Ability to lead cultural transformation, drive adoption of new processes and standards, and influence sustainable behavioural change.
Problem-Solving and Decision-Making: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify risks, address complex HSE challenges, and implement effective solutions.
Performance and Accountability: Results-oriented mindset with the ability to establish performance expectations, monitor outcomes, and drive measurable improvements.
Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to build trust, influence diverse stakeholders, and effectively communicate HSE priorities and expectations.
3. Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Health and Safety, Engineering, Technical, Scientific, or a related discipline is required.
Professional certification in an HSE-related discipline is strongly preferred.
4. Skills and Technical Expertise
Strong knowledge of Health, Safety, and Environmental management systems, standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Expertise in HSE audits, inspections, risk assessments, compliance monitoring, and performance reporting.
Strong incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action management capabilities.
Ability to develop, implement, and monitor regional HSE programs, policies, and improvement initiatives.
Knowledge of sustainability initiatives and environmental performance management.
Experience in standardizing HSE processes, implementing best practices, and driving operational excellence.
Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to interpret HSE performance data, identify improvement opportunities, and drive data-led decision-making.
Proficiency in managing organizational change, system integration, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Summary:
Operates machines and production equipment independently in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment and may instruct or coach others.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Follows all applicable standard work, process documentation and quality procedures such as Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke and visual standards. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Identifies and controls non-conforming material. Delivery Fully proficient with all work processes, independently operating equipment to manufacture and assemble product in order to create the proper characteristics and dimensions necessary to meet customer expectations. Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability. Achieves production goals. Works at the required cycle time or defined engineering standard. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping tasks and machine cleaning tasks and performs planned operator care and maintenance tasks. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet production goals. Works with peers, skilled trades and support staff to maintain and identify equipment needing repair. Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.
Job Summary:
Responsible for Manufacturing Engineering activities across assigned areas covering Camshaft, Connecting Rod, Cylinder Head, PT Fuel and Assembly . The role will focus on PFMEA, Control Plan, Process Flow Diagram, Work Instructions, PPAP and 3DX implementation , along with process improvement, product launch and day-to-day ME support.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, review and maintain PFMEA, Control Plan, Process Flow and Work Instruction Sheets .
Maintain and update PPAP documentation for new products, engineering changes and process changes.
Drive 3DX implementation and digitalization of Manufacturing Engineering documents.
Support NPI, APQP, PPAP, process validation and product launches .
Provide ME support for three assigned manufacturing areas .
Support capacity planning, machine loading, cycle-time improvement, line balancing and productivity improvement .
Develop and optimize manufacturing layouts and material flow .
Support CAPEX, machine procurement, tooling, automation, gauging and equipment projects .
Manage ME-related PR, PO, supplier coordination and payment release activities.
Drive Lean, Kaizen, quality, cost, productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support engineering changes, process issues and shop-floor problem solving.
Coordinate with Production, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement and Finance .
Qualifications and Competencies:
Strong knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, Process Flow, Work Instructions and PPAP .
Good understanding of Manufacturing Engineering, machining/assembly processes and quality requirements .
Knowledge of 3DX, APQP, SPC, MSA, process capability and Lean Manufacturing .
Strong project management, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple ME activities and work effectively on the shop floor.
Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering preferred.
Experience:
Relevant experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Planning, PPAP, NPI or automotive/engine component manufacturing preferred.
Role Summary:
Junior Shop Manager - Manufacturing Engineering responsible for ME execution, quality documentation, PPAP, 3DX, product launches, capacity, layouts, CAPEX and continuous improvement across assigned manufacturing areas.
Focus Areas:
PFMEA | Control Plan | Process Flow | Work Instructions | PPAP | 3DX | NPI | Manufacturing Engineering | Capacity | Layout | CAPEX | Productivity | Continuous Improvement
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Courage - Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

JOB TITLE: Recruiter Level 1
LOCATION: Bangalore, Karnataka
JOB DESCRIPTION:
If you have the passion to work with people and are excited by the thought of collaborating with an
international audience, making a difference in peoples lives around the world, and of course growing your
career in the HR Recruitment space, you should interview with us.
JOB SUMMARY:
The key focus for a Recruiter is to execute sourcing strategies and plans with a focus on passive candidates,
with the aim of achieving high quality, cost-effective and timely filling of roles. You will work closely with the
Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders to recommend and develop a sourcing strategy. Based
on your experience, you will recommend enhancements to ensure recruitment strategy effectiveness and
will initiate and drive best-practice sourcing strategies
Your duties may include, but are not limited to:
Responsible for identifying talent that meets specific client requirements.
Build a strong working relationship with Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders.
¢ Understanding & analyzing the requirement of the position based on clients specifications.
¢ Utilize a variety of recruiting strategies to focus on direct sourced (passive) candidates.
¢ Involved in sourcing profiles through job portals, internal databases, and professional networking.
¢ Utilize the internal database to identify potential candidates and post jobs on the portals to increase
the pool of candidates.
¢ Call potential candidates in the US and discuss the job openings.
¢ Provide exceptional candidate care and ensure that candidates are effectively pre-screened before.
¢ Select and qualify candidates based on skill, cultural, and motivational fit, utilizing behavioral-based
Approach and screening criteria.
¢ Maintain timely and accurate information on all candidate interactions.
¢ Proactively pipeline talent and create pre-qualified candidate talent pools in line with the clients.
QUALIFICATION:
¢ Bachelors/Masters degree. (For recent under-graduates: They should have all the semesters
original mark sheets. No active backlogs)



¢ The average of 10th, 12th (PUC), and UG marks percentage should be more than 60%.
¢ Ability to learn and adapt to working on newer skills and requirements demands.
¢ Possess strong written and oral English communication skills.
¢ Ability to recruit with a sense of urgency.
¢ Availability to work before/after typical office hours as work may necessitate.
¢ A strong work ethic and sense of commitment.
¢ Ability to work under pressure and target-driven environment.
WORK SCHEDULE:

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Description:
Join us at Orange Business!
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
About the role
Engage Customer Account and Project Teams early in the deployment stage to understand expectations
Provide insights on correct engagement models and possible reasons for delays
Identify and address potential issues in the ordering and deliveries
Liaise between Customer Teams and internal process and operations teams to meet special requirement
Provide dedicated support on customer escalations
Subject Matter Expert in CPE procurement and delivery management
Build strong interlock between major customer account, project teams and SC operations
Translate customer needs in operational requirement for effective execution by service providers & / or OEMs
Consult Customer Account and Project team from ordering to delivery to run phase
Drive Customer specific CI projects for cost reductions and optimization
Escalation, Exception and Problem Management for customer specific issues
Stakeholder collaboration and alignment, Team leadership, development & evolution
Coach and Guide to Major Customer Management team
About you
Improve Customer Satisfaction
Transition Customer to Operations & Improve Delivery Time to Customer
Seamless deployment of customer orders from Supply Chain side
Synergies between teams to provide unmatched customer experience
New Customer Logos converted into full term contract
Acknowledged and Recognition by Customer Facing team as Supply Chain expert
Skills:
Customer Orientation
Supply Chain Domain Knowledge at international Level
Continuous Improvement, Problem Solving
Coping up with pressure situations
Stakeholder Management
Project Management
Analytical Skills
Strong Communication Skills
You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
What we offer
Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.
Only your skills matter
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: dont hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

Promotions every year based on performance.

Job Summary
The Visible Alpha Client Support team is a rapidly growing global team that provides support to investment professionals on the Visible Alpha and Capital IQ Pro Platforms. Understanding of Global Financial Markets and company's financial statements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or Accounting is beneficial.
Excellent interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills with the ability to communicate successfully across multiple audiences.

Additional Preferred Qualifications
A good team player with the ability to work on their initiative

Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Reporting to: Regional Collection Manager, VFS India
Department: Collections

Apprenticeship Description:

National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, is a program where Volvo Financial Services India engages freshly graduated individuals for year-long apprenticeships, providing them with practical training and skills development opportunities within the companys various functions under Financial Services. it's a way for Volvo Financial Services to train future workforce members through a structured apprenticeship program.

Purpose of the Apprenticeship as Collection Executive:

The Collection Executive is responsible for collecting overdue amounts from delinquent customer accounts allocated to him / her & maximize collected amounts / recovered assets as per targets set by VFS India Collections Head while ensuring a balanced customer service. The Collection Executive is required to adhere strictly to the compliance policies set by VFS India for collections and strictly adhere to the laws of India. The Collection Executive is also responsible for maintenance of collection data on the Collections System and official laptop provided. Selected Individual will learn Financial Services Collection process & Knowledge of financial services process related to commercial vehicle and construction equipment products during the apprenticeship period.

Key Responsibilities during the apprenticeship period:

Prepares and follows up for collection on overdue accounts allocated to him / her.
Call and follow up all customers and negotiates for collection of overdue amounts, maintains relationships with them keep tab on market references for all his customers.
Maintains effective communication with customers and third parties, e.g., lawyers, collection agencies and repossession agencies.
Identifies deployment of the asset and keeps a tab on its movement/utilization.
Regularly monitor repayment of accounts, analyse causes of delinquency, report concerns timely.
Timely resolve customer disputes
Implements repossession of the asset
Is responsible for the integrity of collection data and customer logs, including visit reports, relating to allocated accounts in the collection.
Maintains accuracy in uploading trails on all cases, within set timelines.
Strictly adheres to compliance.
Maintaining relationship with Collection Agencies and their executives, follow up and updates
Update Payments in VFS System
Role involves Collections follow up across all Buckets, Repossession

Education and Additional knowledge:

Should be a fresh graduate, preferably BCom or BBA
Should have knowledge on Microsoft Office tools usage

Competencies and Skills:

Strong willingness to learn and explore career opportunity in financial services industry.
Strong communications skills.
Knowledge of working in a process driven organisation.
Should be able to converse fluently in English, Hindi & Regional Language of said state is must and additional languages will be added advantage.

Note:
Apprenticeship is for a period of 1 year, post that certificate of completion will be provided and there is no guarantee of employment after completion of training as an apprentice.
During the apprentice period fixed stipend of INR 16,500/- per month will be provided.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities of an OBG Registrar
1. Patient Care
Assess, diagnose, and manage obstetric and gynecological patients under consultant supervision.
Provide safe, evidence-based, and patient-centered care in OPD, IPD, labor room, emergency, and operation theatre.
2. Obstetric Responsibilities
Manage antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal patients.
Conduct normal vaginal deliveries and assist in operative deliveries and cesarean sections.
Monitor maternal and fetal well-being during labor.
Identify and manage obstetric emergencies and promptly escalate to the consultant when required.
3. Gynecology Responsibilities
Evaluate and manage gynecological patients in outpatient, inpatient, and emergency settings.
Assist in elective and emergency gynecological surgeries.
Perform minor gynecological procedures as per competency and departmental protocols.
Provide comprehensive preoperative and postoperative care.
4. Emergency Services
Attend obstetric and gynecological emergencies promptly.
Stabilize critically ill patients and initiate appropriate management.
Coordinate multidisciplinary care and communicate significant clinical events to the consultant.
5. Clinical Documentation
Complete admission notes, progress notes, operative notes, discharge summaries, and treatment charts accurately and on time.
Obtain and document informed consent before procedures.
Maintain accurate medical records in accordance with hospital policies and regulatory requirements.
6. Communication & Coordination
Communicate effectively with consultants, nursing staff, and allied healthcare professionals.
Participate in daily rounds, handovers, and multidisciplinary discussions.
Counsel patients and their families regarding diagnosis, treatment plans, procedures, and follow-up care.
7. Patient Safety & Quality
Adhere to clinical protocols, infection prevention practices, and patient safety standards.
Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and departmental meetings.
Report and document adverse events, incidents, and near misses as per policy.
8. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Participate in academic activities, CMEs, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Contribute to clinical research and departmental academic programs.
Teach and supervise junior residents, interns, and nursing staff as required.
9. Administrative Responsibilities
Coordinate investigations, referrals, and discharge planning.
Ensure timely completion of medico-legal documentation where applicable.
Comply with institutional policies, procedures, and statutory requirements.
10. Professional Conduct
Maintain professionalism, ethical medical practice, and patient confidentiality.
Demonstrate accountability, teamwork, and effective communication.
Engage in continuous professional development and skill enhancement.

Key Responsibilities:

Content Analysis: Review and categorize high volumes of user reviews to determine sentiment, relevance, and compliance with global policies.

High Reading Comprehension: Ability to interpret subtext, sarcasm, and cultural nuances in written English (and/or local languages).

Attention to Detail: Ability to spot repetitive phrasing or "copy-paste" patterns that signal a coordinated spam campaign.
Policy Adherence: Ability to set aside personal bias and follow a strict set of "Source of Truth" guidelines for content removal.
Efficiency: Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with specific daily throughput targets.

ABOUT THE ROLE: As the Order Manager, you will play a crucial role within Client Services, responsible for processing client orders efficiently and accurately. You will be responsible for day-to-day order entry processing and operations, ensuring timely turnaround and delivery of client requests. This role will report to the Order Manager, Lead / Team Lead.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Responsible for complex orders from entry to completion, ensuring accuracy and timeliness throughout the process. This includes data entry, tracking due dates, assessing asset workability, and working in close collaboration with stakeholders.
• Conduct thorough validation of workflows to ensure processes are efficient, effective and compliant with company and client standards and requirements.
• Serve as a point of contact for Title or Project Leads, providing regular updates on order status and escalating any issues or concerns as needed.
• Own setting up and coordinating projects in our proprietary cloud-based platforms for Fulfillment & Localization services. Setting up projects on ONE / SNL and Sfera and sending out work requests to the production teams.
• Ensuring that files are completed on a timely manner by liaising with Production. Workability of assets and follow up with the Client on missing/erroneous assets eg: scripts, proxies.
• Set up POA for all atypical projects involving other teams. Ensure that production teams and external freelance resources are clearly and accurately informed of all client requirements for each project and comply with the requirements.
• Collaborate with Production teams, freelancers and territory affiliates regarding project status and requirements, obtaining and circulating all necessary information.
• Collaborate with Billing or Pre-Billing teams as necessary to ensure accuracy in the billing of completed work. Verify all services rendered are properly documented and billed according to established structure and client agreements.
• Responsible for data management in core internal systems (Sfera, ONE) or client systems, ensuring all relevant information is accurately recorded and maintained. Regularly audit data to identify discrepancies/errors and take corrective action as needed.
• Order and project execution/ ownership of subtitling, mastering, dubbing, fulfillment, audio, GFX and other workstreams as necessitated by client request.
• Project planning for change management and maintain clear communication on changed project plans to downstream teams.
• Other duties, projects as assigned. Sr AC & Account Specialist
• Work with the Managers to put in place process improvement initiatives and kaizen activities.
• Should be able to support the Client desk with training, mentorship, testing, overseeing major projects and being the POC in the absence of the Lead.
• Work with the Manager to review CAR/PIR and come up with corrective and preventive actions.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• 0-5 years experience across client services/order management.
• Proven experience in order management & processing of project milestones in localization, content distribution &/or E2E post-production environments.
• Proven experience in managing orders in proprietary and 3rd party systems.
• Experience in managing project milestones based on workability, production capacity, and client due dates.
• Ability to meticulously review orders, documentation, and data throughout end-to-end order management process.
• High level attention to detail for ensuring quality and accuracy in orders.
• Strong collaborative mindset with a focus on teamwork. Experience working with cross functional teams both locally and globally.
• Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
• In-depth understanding of post-production processes, including marketing campaign execution.
• Familiarity with industry standards and best practices.
• Efficient in managing time and tasks effectively, with ability to prioritize competing demands while meeting deadlines.
• Skilled in escalation management and crisis resolution.
• Comfortable and skilled in working with data, with ability to effectively interpret, synthesize and integrate complex data into systems.
• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
• Willing to work night shifts or rotational shifts as per business requirement
• Ability to multi-task and take on varied tasks and strong organizational skills. Ability to work under pressure and work towards achieving team goals. High degree of commitment to work. High performance standards • Pro-active attitude, actively problem solve, or actively employ problem-solving techniques simultaneously ability to remain calm and focused under pressure.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond to any questions from guests and follow up with guests to ensure their requests have been met to their satisfaction. Take and confirm reservations and cancellations. Supply guests with information regarding property amenities, services, room features, and local areas of interest and activities. Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (e.g., spa services, transportation, religious services, babysitting, financial services, business center services, interpretation services, reservations, dry cleaning, entertainment/sporting events, shopping) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers. Contact appropriate individual or department as necessary to resolve guest requests.
Collaborate with management to develop and carry-out ideas and procedures and set goals to continuously improve department performance. Assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

POSITION SUMMARY
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required paperwork.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Role & responsibilities

Develop and modify 2D & 3D mechanical designs using AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
Prepare detailed manufacturing, fabrication and assembly drawings.
Create 3D models, layouts, and assemblies as per project requirements.

Coordinate with Production, Projects, Purchase and other departments for design execution.

Prepare and maintain BOMs and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support during manufacturing and resolve design-related issues.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
Good knowledge of mechanical design, fabrication and manufacturing processes.

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
