Description:
Position: Branch Customer Service Manager - Alwar
Department: Customer Service
Location: Branch Based
Reporting To: Area Customer Service Manager

Role Purpose
To manage end-to-end customer service operations at the branch level, ensuring excellent customer experience, timely resolution of service requests, compliance with regulatory and internal policies, and effective coordination with Sales, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Service & Operations
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries, complaints, and service requests.
Monitor branch-level service quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
Manage activities related to loan servicing, statement requests, NOCs, foreclosure requests, repayment support, and post-disbursement customer servicing.
Drive adherence to customer service SLAs and turnaround times.
Customer Experience
Deliver superior borrower experience across all customer touchpoints.
Handle escalated cases and ensure proactive resolution.
Identify customer pain points and recommend process improvements.
Support customer retention initiatives and relationship management.
Compliance & Process Governance
Ensure adherence to RBI, NHB, company policies, and operational guidelines.
Maintain audit readiness and ensure closure of observations within timelines.
Monitor compliance with documentation, service processes, and branch controls.
Stakeholder Management
Coordinate closely with Sales, Credit, Technical, Legal, Collections, and Central Operations teams.
Act as the primary customer service representative for the branch.
Support branch management in resolving operational and customer-related issues.
Team Management
Lead and coach branch customer service executives.
Monitor individual and team productivity.
Conduct regular reviews and capability-building sessions.
Foster a customer-centric culture within the branch.
MIS & Reporting
Track service-related KPIs and branch performance metrics.
Prepare periodic reports for management review.
Analyze trends in complaints, service requests, and operational issues.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Complaint Resolution TAT
Service Request Closure TAT
Audit & Compliance Scores
Customer Retention Metrics
Branch Service Quality Parameters
Process Adherence and Accuracy

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline.
2-6 years of experience in customer service, branch operations, banking, NBFC, HFC, or financial services.
Strong understanding of home loan servicing and branch operations.
Good knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage teams and drive service excellence.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Civil Manager to lead and execute all civil construction and infrastructure development activities for a new Greenfield Aluminium Extrusion Manufacturing Plant at Shahpura, near Jaipur, Rajasthan. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end civil project execution, including site development, structural works, factory buildings, foundations for heavy machinery, utilities (including ETP, STP, Clarifier & Water Treatment Plants), infrastructure, contractor management, quality control and timely project completion.

Key Responsibilities

A. Greenfield Project Execution:-

Lead end-to-end civil construction activities for the Greenfield Aluminium Extrusion Plant.
Plan and execute site development, land levelling, excavation, grading and boundary wall
construction.
Supervise construction of factory sheds, production buildings, warehouses, administrative
blocks and other infrastructure.
Ensure project execution as per approved drawings, specifications, timelines and budgets.

B. Industrial Civil & Structural Works :-

Handle RCC, PEB (Pre-Engineered Building), structural steel and industrial building
construction.
Oversee heavy equipment foundations, machine foundations, equipment pits and industrial
flooring.
Ensure proper construction of foundations for aluminium extrusion presses, ageing ovens,
melting furnaces, utilities and other production equipment.
Manage roads, internal drainage, stormwater systems, retaining walls and other external
infrastructure.

C. Project Planning & Execution:-

Prepare project schedules, BOQs, cost estimates and resource planning.
Monitor project progress against defined milestones.
Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and project management
consultants.
Identify project delays and implement corrective measures to ensure timely completion.

D. Contractor & Vendor Management:-

Identify, appoint and manage civil contractors, subcontractors and vendors.
Evaluate contractor quotations, negotiate commercial terms and monitor work execution.
Ensure adequate manpower, machinery and materials availability at the project site.
Verify contractor bills, measurements and work completion certificates.

E. Quality, Safety & Compliance:-

Ensure quality of construction materials and workmanship as per engineering standards.
Monitor concrete testing, reinforcement inspection, soil testing and structural quality.
Ensure adherence to construction safety standards and applicable statutory regulations.
Coordinate for necessary approvals, inspections and compliance requirements.

F. Coordination & Stakeholder Management:-

Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Projects and Plant Engineering teams.
Coordinate civil requirements for installation of production machinery and utilities.
Ensure civil infrastructure readiness in line with equipment installation and plant commissioning
schedules.
Provide regular project updates to senior management.

Desired Candidate Profile:-

12 -15 years of experience in industrial civil construction and project execution.
Must have experience in Greenfield industrial/manufacturing plant projects.
Strong exposure to RCC structures, PEB buildings, heavy machinery foundations and industrial
infrastructure.
Experience in managing large-scale civil projects from land development to plant
commissioning.
Good understanding of BOQ, estimation, billing, budgeting and project scheduling.
Strong contractor management, negotiation and execution capabilities.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project / Primavera and MS Excel.
Ability to independently manage civil construction activities at a project site.

Preferred Industry Background
Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:-

Aluminium / Steel / Metal Manufacturing
Aluminium Extrusion Manufacturing
Anodising Plant Set up
Foundry and Casting Plants
Cement and Heavy Engineering
Industrial Manufacturing / Process Plants

Description:
CustomerCare Executive IIFL Gold Loan (Detailed JD)

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Job Title - Branch Manager (Gold Loans)
Looking for a rewarding career opportunity
Join the Team of Gold Loan Champions at IIFL Finance Limited.
Job Description -
Responsible for business growth, newcustomer acquisition, customer service, overall branch operations compliance.
Drives field marketing and continuouscustomer acquisition engagement in catchment area to meet branch targetsfor gold loans and other financial products.
Maintains portfolio quality by trackinggold quality and ROI.
Ensures valuation, process compliance,timely system approvals for loans.
Coordinates with audit teams; maintainsregisters and displays.
Follows up for interest collections tocontrol NPAs; handles auctions.
Monitors team's activities across goldloans, cash, documents, leads generated and new customer acquisition.
Coaches, mentors, and trains team;provides timely feedback and motivation.
Maintains branch infrastructure andhygiene standards.
DesiredCandidate Profile -
Candidate with minimum 5Years of experience in Banking Financial services can be looked at forthe role.
Prior Gold Loan Team Handling experience will be preferred.
Insummary, the Branch Manager oversees end-to-end branch operations, businessgrowth, compliance, portfolio quality and team performance. Keyresponsibilities include operational management, business acquisition andcollections, compliance and infrastructure upkeep, team leadership andmotivation.
CTC Upto 4.8 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 6.60 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Job Summary
Experience 4-6 years Weekly Rotational Shift. We are looking for a Mid-Level DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS, GCP, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and DevSecOps. The candidate will be responsible for managing cloud infrastructure, automating deployments, implementing security practices, and improving platform reliability and performance. The role also requires a good understanding of SRE practices, production support, monitoring, and incident management.


Responsibilities
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and GitOps workflows.
Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS or GCP using Terraform and Ansible.
Manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions.
Apply SRE practices to improve system availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
Troubleshoot production issues, participate in incident management, and perform root cause analysis.
Support disaster recovery, high availability, infrastructure optimization, and cloud cost management.
Collaborate with development, QA, security, and architecture teams to ensure smooth software delivery.


Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering.
Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP, including cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, and security.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions or any other.
Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and managed Kubernetes services (AKS, EKS, or GKE).
Hands-on experience with Terraform, Ansible, Git, and GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Understanding of DevSecOps practices, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and infrastructure security.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and production troubleshooting.
Understanding of SRE concepts, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, incident management, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in Linux administration, networking fundamentals, and Bash/Python/PowerShell scripting.


Preferred Skills
Knowledge of SAST/DAST, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or Splunk.
Exposure to disaster recovery, high availability, cloud migrations, and cost optimization.
Knowledge of Istio, Consul, API Gateways, or Application Gateways.
Understanding of chaos engineering, performance testing, and resilience engineering.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

POSITION SUMMARY
Direct and assist Stewards in order to make clean up more efficient. Ensure water temperature, and chemical levels are appropriate for cleaning and documented. Assist with Banquet plate-ups. Assist cooks and kitchen staff with various tasks as needed. Provide cooks with needed items. Support banquet and buffet by transporting and ensuring adequate stock. Return cleaned items to proper locations. Operate and maintain cleaning equipment and tools, including the dish washing machine, hand wash stations pot-scrubbing station, and trash compactor.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Assists the Sous Chef in ensuring the quality, consistency and production of areas of responsibility in kitchen. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works with team to improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Develops and trains team to improve results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Supervises the preparation and production of all hot or cold food items for buffet and a la carte menu to ensure that they are in compliance with the prescribed recipes and specifications.
- Supervises kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Maintains food preparation handling and correct storage standards.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Plans and manages food quantities and plating requirements for the food operation (e.g., restaurant, banquet, pastry shop).
- Communications production needs to key personnel.
- Produces production prep list.
- Assists in developing daily and seasonal menu items.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations (e.g., HACCP, OSHA, ASI and Health Department).
- Assists in estimating daily restaurant production needs.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Leading Kitchen Team
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Leads shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Supervises and manages restaurant kitchen employees. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensuring and maintaining the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Assumes duties of the Sous Chef in his/her absence.
- Assists Chef in daily line up and conducts in his/her absence.
Establishing and Maintaining Kitchen Goals
- Sets and supports achievement of kitchen goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Developing specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations work.
- Understands the impact of kitchen operation on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Effectively investigates, reports and follows-up on employee accidents.
- Knows and implements company safety standards.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Participates in training restaurant staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.

Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
Network Engineer

Experience : 5 to 10 years
Location : Bangalore

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Routers, Switches, Wireless Access Points, Wireless Controllers, and Firewalls to design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of the organizations network fabric across LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter security domains, supporting business continuity and enabling seamless connectivity.
Responsibilities

Router Administration & WAN Management
Design, deploy, and manage enterprise routers (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent) across LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments
Configure and maintain dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP for optimal path selection and redundancy
Manage WAN connectivity including MPLS, leased lines, broadband, and SD-WAN overlays
Implement and maintain QoS policies to prioritize business-critical traffic across WAN links
Perform router hardening, IOS/firmware upgrades, and lifecycle management
Troubleshoot routing issues, packet loss, and latency affecting network performance and application availability
Switch Administration & LAN Management
Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise-grade switches (Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, or equivalent) in access, distribution, and core layers
Design and manage VLAN architecture, trunking (802.1Q), and inter-VLAN routing to support network segmentation
Configure and maintain spanning tree protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP) to prevent loops and ensure redundancy
Implement link aggregation (LACP/PAGP), port security, and storm control across the switching infrastructure
Perform switch stack management, firmware upgrades, and hardware lifecycle activities
Monitor switch performance, port utilization, and MAC address tables to proactively identify and resolve issues
Wireless Access Point Deployment & Management
Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise Wireless Access Points (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, or equivalent) across campus, branch, and remote sites
Perform RF site surveys, channel planning, and transmit power optimization to ensure seamless wireless coverage
Configure SSIDs, band steering, roaming policies (802.11r/k/v), and QoS for wireless clients
Monitor AP health, client association metrics, and interference sources to maintain optimal wireless performance
Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and hardware replacement for access point lifecycle management
Support high-density wireless deployments for conference rooms, auditoriums, and open-plan office environments
Wireless Controller Administration
Administer and manage centralized Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC) and cloud-managed wireless platforms (Cisco WLC, Aruba Mobility Controller, or equivalent)
Configure and maintain controller-based policies for mobility, roaming, load balancing, and client exclusion
Manage WLAN profiles, RF groups, mobility groups, and guest access portals across controller clusters
Implement and maintain wireless security policies including WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, certificate-based authentication, and NAC integration
Perform controller software upgrades, redundancy failover testing, and disaster recovery validation
Integrate wireless controllers with AAA platforms (RADIUS/TACACS+) and network management systems for centralized visibility
Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration
Design, implement, and manage enterprise firewalls (Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or equivalent) for perimeter and internal segmentation
Create and maintain firewall rule sets, security zones, NAT policies, and application-layer inspection policies
Manage VPN configurations including site-to-site IPSec VPN and remote access VPN (SSL/TLS) for secure connectivity
Implement and maintain Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) policies, URL filtering, and threat intelligence feeds
Conduct periodic firewall rule base reviews, policy optimization, and compliance audits
Respond to security events flagged by firewall logs, and coordinate with the SOC team for threat investigation and remediation

Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and engineering
Strong proficiency in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, LACP)
Proven experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Aruba, or Meraki) including controller and AP management
Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD, or Check Point)
Experience with network security standards including 802.1X, WPA3, IPSec VPN, and SSL/TLS VPN
Familiarity with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Netmiko, or NAPALM)
Strong working knowledge of ITIL principles and ITSM practices
Industry certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP, PCNSE, NSE 4+, Aruba ACMP, or equivalent
Current understanding of industry trends including SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Networking, and cloud networking
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) team. The ideal candidate will have strong avionics software development experience, mandatory hands-on experience in Flight Management Systems, and expertise in developing safety-critical software in a DevOps environment. The role requires ownership of product quality, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, and a mindset focused on delivering optimized and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- DO178 Level A verification experience
- Very good knowledge on C++.
- Display products experience will be plus
- Design, develop, integrate, and verify safety-critical FMS software.
- Work in a DevOps environment, contributing to CI/CD and continuous improvement.
- Own product quality and ensure compliance with DO-178B/C standards.

- Works on software design, coding, integration, and verification
- Drive software optimization, automation, and engineering best practices.
- Mentor team members and contribute to technical excellence.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor s or master s degree in aerospace, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
- 3 to 10 years of experience in avionics software development.
- Mandatory experience in Flight Management System (FMS) software development. User Interface skills are recommended
- Strong knowledge of DO-178B/C and software design, development, integration, and verification.
- Experience working in a DevOps environment with CI/CD practices.
- Strong programming skills in C/C++, scripting languages, and embedded real-time software development.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desired Competencies:
- Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
- Ability to identify and implement optimized, scalable, and efficient solutions.
- Self-driven team player with a passion for developing high-quality, safety-critical avionics software.

Job Profile: Payer Modernization Healthcare Transformation & Analytics
Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
Healthcare Back Office Transformation
Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
Payer Analytics & Data Strategy
Key Responsibilities
Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
Assess existing processes and develop process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations.
Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
Support transformation across payer functions such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment.
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.
Essential Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
Understanding of payer workflows such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management.
Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
Experience working with complex datasets.
Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.
Preferred Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.
Technical Skills
Essential
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.

Job description
4-8 years Organizational Design team you will help clients address workforce and organizational challenges through innovative solutions. As an Associate you will support client delivery across key Organization & Talent priorities while developing your analytical and communication skills. This position provides an exciting opportunity to engage with diverse stakeholders and contribute to impactful transformation initiatives.
Human Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Behavior Studies, Organizational Management, Sociology, Psychology
Role & responsibilities
Assist clients in addressing organizational and workforce challenges
Support the delivery of key initiatives in Organization & Talent
Engage with diverse stakeholders to gather insights and feedback
Develop analytical skills to inform decision-making processes
Contribute to the design of creative solutions for clients
Collaborate with team members to enhance communication strategies
Participate in impactful transformation initiatives
Uphold professional standards and industry practices in consulting
Those in organisational design at PwC, you will focus on optimising the structure and processes for businesses to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. You will help clients align their organisational structure with their strategic goals for long-term success.
Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you are expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the Firm, you build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development.
Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential.
Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.
Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback.
Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns.
Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness.
Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

1. Partner Advocate Frontline Agent
Job Description
We are hiring Partner Advocates to support global technology partners with program membership, product-related queries and marketplace offers. The role involves delivering excellent customer support, resolving queries and managing cases through appropriate channels.
Key Responsibilities
Handle partner queries through phone, chat and online submissions.
Provide guidance on partner programs, membership and marketplace offers.
Troubleshoot issues and manage cases through resolution.
Maintain accurate case documentation and ensure timely follow-ups.
Escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams.
Maintain customer satisfaction, confidentiality and compliance.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline.
Minimum 6 months of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support or Sales.
Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and basic IT terminology.
Excellent English communication and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to complete required product training and certifications.

2. Subject Matter Expert (SME) Technical Lead
Job Description
Looking for an experienced SME to provide advanced technical and process support to frontline teams handling global technology partner queries. The role involves resolving complex cases, guiding agents, managing escalations and strengthening overall process knowledge.
Key Responsibilities
Provide real-time technical and process guidance to frontline agents.
Troubleshoot complex partner issues and manage critical escalations.
Support partner calls and coordinate with specialist support teams.
Mentor agents through case reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Develop and maintain SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles.
Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Minimum 1 year of experience in Technical Support, Customer Support or a comparable role.
Prior SME, escalation handling or advanced troubleshooting experience preferred.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support platforms.
Strong analytical, communication and mentoring skills.

3. Quality Analyst Quality Coach
Job Description
We are looking for a Quality Analyst / Quality Coach to monitor and improve the performance of frontline support teams. The role focuses on interaction audits, quality assessments, feedback, coaching and improving customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and evaluate customer interactions across calls, chats and case records.
Conduct quality audits based on defined standards and scorecards.
Provide individual and group coaching to improve agent performance.
Analyse CSAT, DSAT and recurring quality defects.
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
Participate in internal and client calibration sessions.
Prepare quality reports, dashboards and performance improvement plans.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience in Quality Assurance, Customer Support or Technical Support.
Experience in interaction monitoring, case audits and coaching.
Knowledge of CSAT, DSAT, RCA and quality reporting.
Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical and communication skills.

4. Trainer Partner Enablement
Job Description
Seeking an experienced Process / Technical Trainer to design and deliver training programs for partner support teams. The role involves onboarding new employees, developing technical knowledge, conducting assessments and improving overall team readiness.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct new-hire onboarding and process training.
Develop training materials, presentations, assessments and learning guides.
Deliver classroom, virtual and practical training sessions.
Train employees on partner support platforms, products and processes.
Conduct knowledge assessments and identify learning gaps.
Provide coaching during training and nesting periods.
Track training effectiveness and maintain learning records.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience as a Process Trainer, Technical Trainer or Training Specialist.
Experience in training-needs analysis and instructional design.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support processes preferred.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Teams.
Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication skills.

5. Team Lead / Assistant Manager Partner Enablement
Job Description
We are hiring an experienced Team Lead to manage frontline operations supporting global technology partners. The role involves leading a team of Partner Advocates, driving operational performance, ensuring service quality and managing customer escalations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage daily operations and allocate work across the team.
Monitor productivity, quality, CSAT and service-level performance.
Conduct regular one-on-one sessions, team meetings and coaching.
Handle complex partner escalations and ensure timely resolution.
Identify performance gaps and coordinate training interventions.
Drive process improvements and ensure compliance with policies.
Prepare operational reports and share performance updates with management.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience leading Customer Support, Technical Support or Contact Centre teams.
Experience in performance management, coaching and escalation handling.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support platforms preferred.
Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

6. Quality Manager Partner Enablement
Job Description
Looking for an experienced Quality Manager to lead the Quality Assurance function for partner enablement operations. The role involves managing quality teams, developing audit frameworks, driving customer experience improvements and ensuring consistent quality standards across support operations.
Key Responsibilities
Define and implement quality frameworks, scorecards and audit methodologies.
Lead, coach and develop the Quality Analyst team.
Monitor quality performance across calls, chats and case management.
Conduct calibration sessions with Operations, Training and stakeholders.
Analyse CSAT, DSAT, escalations and recurring quality issues.
Drive RCA, corrective and preventive action plans.
Prepare quality dashboards, reports and management presentations.
Ensure compliance with privacy, security and contractual requirements.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Significant experience in Quality Assurance and Customer Support operations.
Prior experience managing Quality Analysts or a quality team.
Strong knowledge of quality frameworks, RCA, coaching and continuous improvement.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and quality reporting tools.
Six Sigma, COPC or relevant quality certification preferred.
Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management skills.

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Technical consultant Manager (10-15 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

Support deployment activities and release management processes.
Work with development teams to resolve recurring production issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests through ticketing tools.
Monitor AWS infrastructure and application services.
Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in on-call support and production release activities.

Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Recruiting.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Recruiting areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).

You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns the value story for the engagement - defines value metrics and KPIs, establishes the baseline, builds the business case, and tracks value realization.
Defines the agentic solution design - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Drives business development and pre-sales - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact


Qualification
Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.

Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.
