Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)
Or you can upload your resume via WhatsApp and one of our YouthNet Job Centre Representatives will call you back

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Description:
Network Engineer (1Post): Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, BCA, or a related field.
Equivalent qualifications and relevant networking experience may also apply.
CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA A+, or preferred equivalent certifications.
Requirements & Key Skills:
Minimum 3-5 years of experience
Knowledge of FTTH/GPON technologies and fiber network architecture.
Familiarity with RADIUS/AAA systems, subscriber authentication, and billing integration.
Experience managing upstream BGP connectivity, peering, and traffic engineering.
Experience with network monitoring platforms such as PRTG, Zabbix, or similar NMS tools.
Basic scripting knowledge (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or MikroTik scripting) for automation and operational efficiency.
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, NAT, and network troubleshooting.
Experience with routing and switching technologies, including OSPF and BGP.
Hands-on experience with MikroTik RouterOS and enterprise networking equipment.
Knowledge of network security, firewalls, access control management.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve network, connectivity, and hardware-related issues.
Experience in network design, implementation, optimization, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
Functional Area:
Dimapur
Employment type:
Full-time
Salary Package:
Negotiable

Description:
The Educator, Art Labs will lead and facilitate impactful, art-based learning sessions in classrooms, promoting creative expression and social-emotional development among children. This role will involve regular observation and documentation of classroom dynamics and student engagement. This role will shape the holistic growth of the children by driving a community-building movement in our model school, thereby creating strong evidence on art and SEL in classrooms.


Roles and Responsibilities

1. School Scouting and Art Lab Development
Identify and visit potential schools where Art Labs can be set up.
Assess schools based on available space, infrastructure, student strength, school leadership, and readiness to support an Art Lab.
Meet principals and teachers to understand the schools needs and assess the feasibility of setting up and sustaining an Art Lab.
Document school visits and share findings to support school selection and planning for Art Lab setup.
Coordinate with selected schools to support the setup of Art Labs and their integration into regular school activities.


2. Government Engagement and Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain relationships with relevant state and district government officials, including the Education Department, SCERT, DIET, and other relevant institutions.
Share SArCs approach and work with government stakeholders and explore opportunities to establish and strengthen Art Labs in schools.
Coordinate with government officials, funders, and school leadership to facilitate school visits, address implementation needs, and support program delivery.
Work with artists, volunteers, and creative professionals to bring additional art experiences to children.


3. Art Facilitation and Classroom Engagement
Facilitate joyful and inclusive art sessions for children from Grades 1 to 8 throughout the academic year.
Adapt existing art lesson plans to suit childrens needs, interests, and classroom contexts while keeping the intended learning outcomes in mind.
Create a classroom environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves, sharing ideas and exploring their creativity.
Guide children through reflection and discussion to help them express their thoughts, listen to others, and develop self-awareness.
Design visual teaching aids and lead school-wide art projects, exhibitions and installations that give children opportunities to explore relevant social and community themes through art.


4. Field Observations and Research
Conduct school visits and structured classroom observations to understand how art education is practised, and the challenges schools and teachers face.
Collect information through classroom observations, interviews with teachers and school leaders, and other research tools as required.
Support research studies on art education, teaching practices, student engagement and the implementation of Art Labs.
Prepare field visit reports, case studies and summaries of findings, highlighting challenges, patterns and practices that can inform program decisions.
Work with the Research and Impact team to plan school visits, collect data and maintain accurate records.


5. Curriculum and Monitoring and Evaluation (ME)
Work closely with the Curriculum and ME teams to share feedback from classrooms and schools on the relevance, suitability, and implementation of art activities.
Identify gaps in lesson plans, teaching resources and facilitation approaches based on classroom experiences, teacher feedback and student participation.
Share specific recommendations on what needs to change in the curriculum, activities or teaching resources to meet childrens needs better and address classroom realities.
Support the Curriculum team in reviewing and testing revised activities and resources, and share feedback on their effectiveness.
Work with the ME team to document classroom observations, track student progress, and assess whether sessions are meeting their intended outcomes.
Maintain relevant program records, including classroom dashboards, field notes, and documentation of childrens work, to support program review and improvement.


Qualifications and Experience
A graduate degree in Education, Arts, Child Development, or a related field is required. A postgraduate degree is an added advantage.
3-4 years of experience in teaching and classroom facilitation, preferably in creative learning or arts-integrated settings.
Experience working with low-income or underserved school communities will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of child-centred pedagogy, experiential learning and childrens social-emotional development.
Experience in classroom observation, documentation and using feedback or data to improve teaching and learning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work with children, teachers, school leaders, government stakeholders and internal teams.
Alignment with Saturday Art Classs vision of making arts education an integral part of public school education.
Skills and Mindset
Facilitation and empathy: Creates inclusive spaces where children feel safe to express themselves and explore their creativity.
Curriculum adaptation: Can work with art-based curricula and adapt activities and lesson plans to suit childrens needs, abilities and classroom contexts while keeping learning objectives in mind.
Ownership and organisation: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes, manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines with minimal supervision.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
We are looking for a Python Team Lead who can combine strong technical expertise with leadership skills. The ideal candidate will guide a team of Python developers, drive best practices, and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. You will be responsible for project architecture, mentoring team members, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Lead a team of Python developers, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and performance feedback.
Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and secure applications using Python frameworks (Django, Flask, FastAPI).
Drive system design, architecture decisions, and code reviews.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
Ensure best practices in coding standards, version control, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Manage project timelines, allocate tasks, and ensure timely delivery.
Stay updated with new technologies, tools, and industry trends to improve processes and efficiency.
Required Skills
5+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
Strong expertise in Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with databases (SQL & NoSQL), ORMs, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Strong knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and test automation.
Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging, and optimization experience.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring junior developers.
Good to Have
Experience with big data, machine learning, or AI integration in Python.
Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery).
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Job Description Associate, Network
Operations Center (NOC L1)
Department: IT Network Operations
Designation: Associate NOC L1
Experience: 02 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech preferred
Certification: CCNA preferred
Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Monitor network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access
points, and ISP links, to ensure network availability.
2. Perform basic network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and
network monitoring dashboards.
3. Understand basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, OSI Model, VLANs, DHCP,
DNS, LAN, WAN, and packet flow.
4. Identify and perform initial troubleshooting of network connectivity issues, link failures,
port errors, and basic Layer 2 problems.
5. Have a basic understanding of VLAN configuration, switch port settings, trunking, and
Spanning Tree Protocol (STP).
6. Monitor network alerts, bandwidth utilization, device availability, and performance
through network monitoring tools.
7. Create, update, and track network incidents in the ticketing system, ensuring timely
escalation and resolution within defined SLAs.
8. Coordinate with ISPs and internal IT teams for connectivity issues, outages, and service
restoration.
9. Perform initial troubleshooting of wireless connectivity issues and escalate complex
problems to the NOC L2 team.
10. Assist senior engineers in network maintenance activities, switch replacements, firmware
upgrades, and configuration changes.
11. Follow established SOPs, incident management processes, escalation matrices, and
shift handover procedures.
12. Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting logs, and daily network health
reports.
Required Technical Skills
Networking Fundamentals: Basic understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing,
subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.
Basic Troubleshooting: Knowledge of Ping, Traceroute, packet flow, and identifying
common network connectivity issues.
Switching Knowledge: Basic understanding of Layer 2 switches, access/trunk ports,
VLANs, STP, and port status.
Network Monitoring: Familiarity with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or
similar NMS platforms.
Incident Management: Understanding of ticket handling, incident prioritization, SLA
tracking, and escalation procedures.
ISP Coordination: Ability to perform basic ISP link checks and coordinate with service
providers for issue resolution.
Documentation: Ability to maintain troubleshooting records, incident updates, and shift
handover reports.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications
BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred.
CCNA certification or CCNA-level networking knowledge preferred.
Basic knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls will be an added advantage.
Basic understanding of wireless networking, Wi-Fi access points, and SSID
troubleshooting preferred.
Familiarity with Cisco switches and enterprise networking environments.
Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.
Role Expectations
The Associate NOC L1 will be responsible for proactive network monitoring, initial
troubleshooting, incident logging, ISP coordination, and timely escalation of complex network
issues to L2/L3 teams. The role focuses on maintaining network availability, following
operational SOPs, and supporting day-to-day network operations under senior engineers'
guidance.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.

Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT :
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EYs Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and provide practical, data-driven solutions.
Support government, public sector, and private sector projects from planning through implementation.
Conduct market research, policy analysis, stakeholder consultations, surveys, and interviews to generate actionable insights.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations.
Develop reports, presentations, concept notes, business cases, strategy documents, and client deliverables.
Prepare financial and operational assessments, forecasts, and impact analyses to support decision-making.
Collaborate with internal teams and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
Build and maintain strong client relationships and contribute to business development initiatives.
Support proposal preparation, opportunity identification, and pursuit of new assignments.
Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining high standards of quality and professionalism.
4+ years of experience in consulting, advisory, research, policy, strategy, analytics, or project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex information.
Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and data analysis.
Excellent report writing, presentation development, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively in a team-based environment.
Strong client management and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.
Self-driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
Exposure to government advisory, public sector consulting, economic development, policy, or transformation projects will be an advantage.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and engage with senior stakeholders.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification
Bachelor of Engineering
Master of Business Administration


Experience
4+ years of Experience


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Designation: Senior Associate NOC L2
Experience: 25 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech/MCA preferred
Certification: CCNA/CCNP preferred

Key Roles & Responsibilities
Monitor and manage network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, and ISP links, to ensure high network availability and performance.
Perform advanced network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, packet analysis, and network monitoring dashboards.
Diagnose and resolve complex Layer 2 network issues, including VLAN misconfigurations, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) problems, port errors, and trunking issues.
Investigate and resolve network connectivity problems, including network loops, broadcast storms, link failures, packet loss, and high latency.
Configure and manage network switches, VLANs, access/trunk ports, and other Layer 2 network configurations as per operational requirements.
Implement and maintain network segmentation through VLAN configurations and ensure proper traffic isolation and network security.
Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilization, device health, and network alerts to proactively identify and resolve service degradation.
Act as an escalation point for NOC L1 engineers, providing technical guidance and resolving issues beyond L1 troubleshooting capabilities.
Coordinate with ISPs, internal IT teams, and OEM support teams for troubleshooting, incident resolution, and service restoration.
Assist in network maintenance activities, firmware upgrades, switch replacements, firewall changes, and planned network change activities.
Support network redundancy, failover testing, and high-availability (HA) configurations to ensure business continuity.
Manage network incidents, maintain accurate ticket updates, perform initial root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure incident resolution within defined SLAs.
Collaborate with senior network engineers and architects for network optimization, infrastructure improvements, and capacity planning.
Follow established SOPs, change management procedures, incident escalation matrices, and shift handover processes.
Maintain network documentation, troubleshooting records, configuration backups, incident reports, and daily network health reports.

Required Technical Skills
Advanced Networking Fundamentals: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.
Layer 2 Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience in troubleshooting VLAN misconfigurations, STP issues, broadcast storms, network loops, trunking problems, and switch port errors.
Network Troubleshooting Tools: Proficiency in Ping, Traceroute, packet flow analysis, and basic packet capture tools such as Wireshark.
Switching & Routing: Working knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLAN configuration, access/trunk ports, STP, inter-VLAN routing, and basic routing protocols.
Network Monitoring & Performance: Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or similar NMS platforms for device availability, bandwidth utilization, and performance analysis.
Network Security & Segmentation: Understanding of VLAN-based network segmentation, firewall policies, access control, and secure network configurations.
High Availability & Redundancy: Basic understanding of network redundancy, link failover, HA configurations, and network availability management.
Incident & Escalation Management: Ability to handle L1 escalations, troubleshoot critical incidents, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure SLA compliance.
ISP & Vendor Coordination: Experience in troubleshooting ISP connectivity, packet loss, latency, and link instability while coordinating with service providers and OEMs.
Technical Documentation: Ability to prepare incident reports, RCA documentation, network diagrams, configuration records, and shift handover reports.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications
BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred.
CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on networking knowledge preferred.
2-5 years of experience in enterprise network operations, NOC L2 support, or network infrastructure management.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches and enterprise networking environments.
Knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, including basic firewall policies, routing, interfaces, and troubleshooting, will be an added advantage.
Understanding of wireless networking, including Wi-Fi access points, SSID configurations, VLAN mapping, and wireless connectivity troubleshooting.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools, incident management systems, and change management processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to handle critical network incidents and guide junior NOC engineers.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.

Role Expectations
The Senior Associate NOC L2 will be responsible for advanced network troubleshooting, proactive infrastructure monitoring, Layer 2 network configuration, incident resolution, and technical escalation support for NOC L1 engineers.
The role requires strong hands-on networking knowledge, the ability to independently troubleshoot complex connectivity issues, coordinate with ISPs and OEMs, and ensure timely incident resolution within defined SLAs.
The candidate will also support network maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, high-availability testing, and continuous improvement of network stability and operational efficiency.

Travel: Willingness to travel to offices, warehouses, and other business locations across India
.
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sr. Associate Network Engineer (L2) to
manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. The
candidate must have hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, Cisco
switches, Cisco Meraki wireless access points, and FortiAP wireless solutions.
The role involves handling L2 network incidents, troubleshooting complex connectivity
and performance issues, supporting network deployments, coordinating with ISPs and
OEM vendors, and ensuring network availability across corporate offices and
warehouse locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Firewall Management – Fortinet
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot FortiGate firewalls.
Manage firewall policies, NAT, routing, VLANs, IPsec VPNs, and SSL VPNs.
Monitor firewall health, traffic logs, security events, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot connectivity, VPN, and policy-related issues.
Support firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and security patching.
Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized management and log
analysis, where deployed.
2. Switching and Routing – Cisco
Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches.

Manage VLANs, trunk ports, access ports, STP, EtherChannel, and inter-VLAN
routing.
Troubleshoot DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, and network connectivity
issues.
Diagnose switching loops, packet drops, port errors, and network latency.
Support switch installation, configuration, replacement, and firmware upgrades.
Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, and configuration backups.
3. Wireless Network Management – Cisco Meraki and FortiAP
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki wireless access points and
FortiAPs.
Manage SSIDs, VLAN mapping, authentication, RF settings, channel allocation,
and transmit power.
Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity, authentication failures, roaming issues,
interference, and high latency.
Analyze wireless client connectivity, signal strength, channel utilization, and
access point performance.
Manage wireless configurations through the Meraki Dashboard and
FortiGate/FortiAP management interfaces, as applicable.
Support wireless surveys, AP installations, coverage validation, and Wi-Fi
optimization at offices and warehouse sites.
4. Network Monitoring and Incident Management
Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, Nagios, or
equivalent platforms.
Investigate alerts, identify root causes, and resolve L2 network incidents within
defined SLAs.
Perform systematic troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and internet
connectivity issues.
Escalate L3 or OEM-dependent issues with detailed troubleshooting evidence.
Prepare incident reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action plans.
Participate in change management, maintenance windows, and major incident
resolution.
5. Site Deployment and Vendor Coordination
Travel to corporate offices, warehouses, and other business sites for network
deployment and troubleshooting.

Support installation, commissioning, migration, and replacement of firewalls,
switches, and wireless access points.
Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, and field support teams for fault resolution and
service restoration.
Validate network connectivity, wireless coverage, and infrastructure readiness at
new sites.
Maintain site inventory, network documentation, standard configurations, and
operational checklists.
Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.
Practical experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches.
Mandatory experience with Cisco Meraki Wi-Fi access points and FortiAPs.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, subnetting, routing, NAT,
and VPN technologies.
Experience with wireless troubleshooting, RF fundamentals, roaming, and Wi-Fi
performance optimization.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or Nagios.
Working knowledge of incident management, change management, and ticketing
systems.
Ability to use troubleshooting tools such as ping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, packet
captures, and firewall logs.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to handle critical incidents in a fast-paced environment.
Strong documentation, ownership, and follow-up skills.
Working Conditions
Willingness to travel across India as per business requirements.
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public
holidays, if required.
Availability for on-call support during critical network outages and business-
impacting incidents.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology,
Electronics, or a related field.
Fortinet NSE/FCP, Cisco CCNA, or relevant networking certifications are an
advantage.
Experience supporting distributed enterprise networks, warehouses, branch
offices, or multi-site infrastructure is preferred.

SASE Network Security Engineer
Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled SASE Network Security Engineer to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve our enterprise Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Security Service Edge (SSE) platform. This role is critical to enabling secure, high-performance connectivity for distributed users, devices, and applications while advancing our Zero Trust security strategy.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud-delivered security capabilities and will play a key role in migrating legacy remote-access and web-proxy solutions to a converged SASE architecture.

Key Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and manage SASE/SSE solutions including Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and threat protection.
Configure and optimize traffic steering, SSL/TLS inspection, client deployment, policy enforcement, and high-availability designs.
Lead migration of legacy VPN, web proxy, and remote-access technologies to cloud-delivered SASE services.
Monitor platform performance, analyze logs and telemetry, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous optimization of security posture and user experience.
Develop automation scripts, infrastructure-as-code approaches, and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
Collaborate with Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Identity, and Operations teams to ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles and enterprise standards.

Required Qualifications
2+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating enterprise SASE/SSE platforms (e.g., Zscaler, Netskope,Cisco Secure Access, or equivalent).
Strong understanding of SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures and principles.
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, Routing and Switching, VPNs (IPsec, SSL/TLS), proxy technologies, and traffic engineering.
Experience with identity federation and authentication (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and major IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Okta, etc.).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Vendor certifications (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Netskope, Cisco) related to SASE/SSE or network security.
Experience with SD-WAN technologies and integration with SASE.
Knowledge of DLP, CASB advanced features, Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), and threat protection capabilities.
Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring workflows.
Prior experience in large-scale enterprise or regulated environments.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that focuses on successfully accomplishing the daily objectives in the kitchen. Assists in leading staff while personally assisting in all areas of the kitchen, including food production; purchasing and kitchen sanitation. Position contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Maintains food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of Culinary and related kitchen area employees in high demand times.
- Oversees production and preparation of culinary items.
- Ensures employees keep their work areas clean and sanitary.
- Works with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates areas in need of attention to staff and follows up to ensure follow through.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Supporting Culinary Team Activities
- Supervises daily shift operations.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Ensures completion of assigned duties.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, giving feedback as needed.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Monitors employees progress towards meeting performance expectations.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
- Supports and assists with new menus, concepts and promotions for the Restaurant outlets and Banquets.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Additional Responsibilities
- Reports malfunctions in department equipment.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manages food and supply inventories according to budget.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.

Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job description

Senior Executive Relationship Management

Job Title: Senior Executive Relationship Management
Department: Sales
Industry: Interior Design / Home Interiors
Experience: 1-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
Fixed Weekly Off: Tuesday

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Senior Executive Relationship Management to drive sales, build strong customer relationships, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to achieve sales targets in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Generate new business opportunities by proactively engaging with prospective customers and building a strong sales pipeline.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to understand their requirements and provide suitable solutions.
Drive sales and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in coordination with the interior design team.
Ensure an excellent customer experience throughout the sales journey, from the initial enquiry to deal closure.
Understand customer needs, address concerns, and provide effective solutions to improve customer satisfaction.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and proactively resolve customer and business challenges.
Explore alternate sales channels, including residential visits, apartment activities, design consultations, and showroom engagements.
Coordinate with internal teams, including interior designers, to ensure smooth customer interactions and timely follow-ups.
Analyse sales performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
Demonstrate flexibility, accountability, and a results-oriented approach in a fast-paced work environment.
Communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, business partners, and other stakeholders.
