Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Tasks :
1.Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines.

2.HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification.

3.Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage.

6.GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits.

7.Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems.
GMP-compliant process utilities.
WFI and Purified Water Systems.
Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems.
Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems.
Biological manufacturing equipment integration.
Equipment qualification and commissioning.
Preventive and predictive maintenance.
Technical tendering, procurement and project management.
AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation.

Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Role Overview
The Squad Lead sets and delivers the Outcome-Based Plan for the assigned cluster. End-to-end accountable for regional portfolio ambitions and patient outcomes, the role operates across the Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC) leadership model.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the cluster s strategic ambition in alignment with affiliate priorities and North Star goals.
Ecosystem Shaping: Co-create partnerships with key regional and corporate accounts to accelerate access to Roche innovations.
Agile Execution: Define and oversee high-impact work packages, resource allocation, and operating models in collaboration with Disease Area Squads and Key Account Managers.
People & Network Leadership: Coach Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) and cross-functional network teams; break down internal silos to drive collective execution.
Compliance: Ensure uncompromising adherence to safety, industry codes, and Roche compliance standards, keeping patients at the center.
Qualifications
Strong track record of leadership in Roche-relevant therapy areas(esp. Hemat-Oncology).
Proven experience in strategic account management, system shaping, and multi-stakeholder partnerships.
Demonstrated ability to lead and coach cross-functional or agile network teams.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100 000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Identify resolve service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting monthly operations meeting

Digital Initiative: Be conversant with all in house systems.
Maintain Material consumption, Overtime Hrs. schedule at an agreed targeted level for the assigned service area and for technician
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Monitor report to ABM/BM on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed discuss action plans to bring it within limits

to manage Stock Levels of branches forecasting, Indenting receipt of material for branch (as an assigned function within branch by BM).
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) is followed by all assigned technicians all chemical containers have original labels
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance repairs of equipment is established followed (via JOC).
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances IR issues of Technicians bring to the notice of ABM/BM on day today basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- over commitments, recommendation regarding night service (if it is not needed), covered area mismatch, etc

Proficient in use of computer applications systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Description:
Job Summary
Agilent is looking for passionate and motivated young scientists to join our team as Field Application Engineers (FAE) supporting our LCMS (Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) and GCMS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) business. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with leading pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, environmental, and research laboratories across India. As a Field Application Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert, helping customers develop analytical workflows, optimize methods, and maximize the value of Agilent's advanced analytical instrumentation. You will collaborate with sales, product specialists, application scientists, and customers to drive technology adoption and business growth.


Responsibilities
Develop and optimize LCMS and GCMS analytical methods and workflows for applications including pharmaceuticals, pesticides, antibiotics, food safety, and other emerging markets
Design and execute experiments to support development of new applications and workflow solutions.
Generate scientific data and contribute to application notes, technical publications, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborate with leading researchers, industry experts, and key opinion leaders to drive innovative analytical solutions
Deliver customer demonstrations, technical seminars, and product trainings.
Support customer onboarding, workflow implementation, and application troubleshooting.
Participate in scientific conferences, workshops, and industry events to showcase Agilent technologies.
Work closely with commercial and technical teams to support strategic business growth in LCMS and GCMS.


Qualifications
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
Strong academic understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry techniques.
Hands-on laboratory experience through coursework, research projects, internships, or thesis work is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific communication skills.
Passion for customer engagement and scientific consulting.


Desired Skills
Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.
Curiosity to learn new technologies and applications.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%) across assigned territories.


Additional Details

Travel Required: 50% of the Time
Shift: Day
Duration: No End Date

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond to any questions from guests and follow up with guests to ensure their requests have been met to their satisfaction. Take and confirm reservations and cancellations. Supply guests with information regarding property amenities, services, room features, and local areas of interest and activities. Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (e.g., spa services, transportation, religious services, babysitting, financial services, business center services, interpretation services, reservations, dry cleaning, entertainment/sporting events, shopping) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers. Contact appropriate individual or department as necessary to resolve guest requests.
Collaborate with management to develop and carry-out ideas and procedures and set goals to continuously improve department performance. Assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales
Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

About the Role:The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular

1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

AboutCompany:
SBI Life Insurance (SBI Life / ‘The Company’), one of the most trusted life insurance companies in India, was incorporated in October 2000 and is registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) in March 2001.
Serving millions of families across India, SBI Life’s diverse range of products caters to individuals as well as group customers through Protection, Pension, Savings and Health solutions.
Driven by ‘Customer-First’ approach, SBI Life places great emphasis on maintaining world class operating efficiency and providing hassle-free claim settlement experience to its customers by following high ethical standards of service. Additionally, SBI Life is committed to enhance digital experiences for its customers, distributors and employees alike.
SBI Life strives to make insurance accessible to all, with its extensive presence across the country through its 1,146 offices, 27,040 employees, a large and productive network of about 253,799 agents, 62 corporate agents and 9 bancassurance partners with more than 41,000 partner branches, 150 brokers and other insurance marketing firms.
In addition to doing what’s right for the customers, the company is also committed to provide a healthy and flexible work environment for its employees to excel personally and professionally.
SBI Life strongly encourages a culture of giving back to the society and has made substantial contribution in the areas of child education, healthcare, disaster relief and environmental upgrade. In 2024-25, the Company touched over 53,000 direct beneficiaries through various CSR interventions.
Listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange ('BSE') and the National Stock Exchange ('NSE'), the company has an authorized capital of Rs. 20.0 billion and a paid-up capital of Rs. 10.0 billion. The AuM is Rs. 4,758.1 billion.

Job Title: Service Engineer X-Ray & C-Arm
Company: Trivitron Healthcare
Locations: Bangalore | Chennai | Aurangabad | Ahmedabad
Experience: 2–7 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Job Description
We are looking for technically skilled and customer-focused Service Engineers to handle installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance and breakdown support for our X-Ray and C-Arm product portfolio.
The ideal candidate should have experience in servicing medical equipment, preferably in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging systems.
Key Responsibilities
Install, commission and maintain X-Ray and C-Arm systems at customer locations.
Diagnose and resolve technical issues and equipment breakdowns within defined service timelines.
Perform preventive maintenance, equipment inspections and functional testing.
Maintain service reports, records and technical documentation.
Coordinate with the Service Head and technical teams for troubleshooting complex issues.
Manage service spares, tools and testing equipment effectively.
Provide basic product operation and technical training to customers.
Support Sales and Applications teams during product demonstrations and customer visits.
Ensure compliance with service, quality and safety procedures.
Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory as required.
Required Qualifications
Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Medical Electronics or a relevant discipline.
2–7 years of experience in medical equipment servicing.
Prior experience in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging equipment is preferred.
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience in installation, commissioning and preventive maintenance.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility

Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs

Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.

Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.

Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas)

- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Achieve monthly and annual sales volume, revenue and product mix targets.

2. New Customer Acquisition
Identify and generate new customer leads within the territory.
Prospect, qualify and develop potential industrial accounts.
Initiate product trials, demonstrations, and customer evaluations.
Convert successful trials and opportunities into sustainable business.
3. Existing Customer Development
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
Improve customer retention and reduce business churn.
Identify opportunities to increase Share of Wallet.
Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the customer organization, including users, maintenance, purchase, and management.
4. Solution & Value Selling
Understand customer equipment, applications, operating conditions, and business requirements.
Recommend appropriate products and solutions based on identified customer needs.

Coordinate with technical or service teams where specialized customer support is required.
5. Commercial & Receivables Management

Support timely collection of outstanding payments.
Monitor customer receivables and proactively address potential payment issues.
Ensure quotations, orders, pricing and supplies follow approved company processes.
6. Channel / Distributor Coordination (Where Applicable)
Work closely with distributors, dealers, or channel partners to execute territory plans.
Support distributor sales development and customer coverage.
Provide market inputs to support appropriate inventory planning.
Coordinate product availability and timely supplies to customers.
7. Customer Service
Ensure timely response to customer queries and requirements.
Coordinate resolution of product, service and supply-related complaints.
Follow up on customer issues through satisfactory closure.
Support customers in improving inventory and product management practices.
8. Territory & Market Development
Develop and execute territory-level business development plans.
Maintain an updated customer and prospect pipeline.
Track competitor activities, pricing, products, and market developments.
Provide regular market intelligence and customer insights to the organization.
Identify emerging applications, industries, and opportunities within the territory.
9. Sales Planning & Reporting
Maintain accurate records of customer visits, opportunities, trials, and sales activities.
Prepare periodic sales forecasts and territory plans.
Monitor performance against agreed KPIs.
Maintain and update customer and opportunity information in the applicable CRM or sales management system.
10. Product Knowledge & Capability Development
Maintain sound knowledge of the company's products, applications, and value propositions.
Stay updated on relevant industry trends, equipment, and technologies.
Complete assigned product, technical, sales and compliance training.
Continuously improve consultative and solution-selling capability.
11. Safety, Ethics & Compliance
Conduct all business activities in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.
Follow company standards relating to Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE).
Maintain high standards of ethical conduct and commercial integrity.
Comply with applicable competition and antitrust requirements and approved commercial processes.

Preferred candidate profile

Graduate, Diploma, or Engineering qualifications.
Technical qualifications are preferred for industrial or technical sales roles.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in industrial sales, B2B sales, industrial operations, technical services, or related fields.
Experience with industrial customers, equipment, lubricants, engineering products, consumables or industrial solutions is an advantage.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Project Role: Assoc Lab Project Svcs Mgr

Work Experience: xp- 5+ yrs , Clinical project management+ client/sponsor direct handling exp, life science background.

Work location: Bangalore, Thane, Hyderabad, Kochi, Ahmedabad.

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift Timings: 5:00 pm -2:00 am(Night Shifts)

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Ensures work is conducted in line with standard operating procedures, policies and good practices.
Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.
Experience in successfully leading Phase I-IV clinical trials preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.

Description:
CBRE is seeking a high-performing senior professional to join our Office Leasing practice as Landlord Representation.

In this role, you will lead business development, strategic landlord advisory, and deal execution for major institutional investors, developers, and asset owners. You will be responsible for securing multi-asset leasing mandates across key markets, formulating asset positioning strategies, driving revenue targets, and delivering end-to-end commercial real estate transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Mandate Origination & Business Development: Drive pipeline growth by identifying, pitching, and securing high-value Landlord Representation mandates; expand existing accounts through strategic relationship management.
Strategic Advisory & Commercial Structuring: Formulate asset-specific leasing strategies, pricing models, rent escalation structures, lock-in terms, tenant incentives, and positioning frameworks based on competitor benchmarking and occupier demand.
Portfolio & Governance Management: Oversee multi-asset, multi-city portfolios; establish structured client governance including weekly reporting, leasing dashboards, milestone tracking, and escalation frameworks.
Marketing & Positioning Execution: Conceptualize and drive go-to-market strategies, broker engagement protocols, collateral development, and targeted campaigns in collaboration with branding and design agencies.
Transaction Execution & Deal Closure: Lead high-value lease negotiations, prospect engagement, heads of terms drafting, and transaction closures while advising landlords on risk mitigation.
Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement: Build and maintain high-level relationships with institutional landlords, developers, corporate occupiers, investors, and third-party channel partners/agents.
Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with CBRE Research, Capital Markets, Project Management, and Occupier Services to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell business lines.
Team Leadership & Performance: Mentor junior and mid-level team members, manage channel partner ecosystems, and ensure alignment with regional revenue and occupancy targets.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 712+ years of relevant commercial real estate experience, with a proven track record in Landlord Representation, agency leasing, and developer account management.
Occupier Relationship: Experience in engaging with regional and international occupiers, institutional landlords, developers, and corporate real estate (CRE) heads.
Portfolio Capabilities: Proven capability to manage multi-asset, portfolio-wide leasing mandates across geographic markets.
Commercial & Financial Acumen: Deep knowledge of commercial office lease structures, financial modeling, market dynamics, and yield optimization strategies.
Leadership & Influence: Strong negotiation, pitch presentation, and client advisory skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively at senior executive levels.
AboutCompany:
CBRE Group, Inc.(NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2020 revenue).

The company has more than 100,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services.

CBRE was the first international real estate services firm to set up an office in India. Since then, our operations have grown to include more than 9000 professionals across 10 offices, with a presence in over 200 cities in India.

Please visit our website at www.cbre.com

Description:
Role: AI Architect.
Location: Ahmedabad, Pune, Indore
Years of Experience: 10-15 years
Notice Period 0-45 Days (Preferred)

Job Description:
A highly skilled and motivated AI Architect for designing, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions within an organization. The role focuses on leveraging AI & GenAI technologies, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems and drive innovation. The AI Architect bridges the gap between business objectives and technology, ensuring that AI systems align with the organization's strategic goals.

What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI projects, data science, or a related field.

Skills:
Expertise in AI & GenAI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision).
Proficiency in programming languages like Python or .Net
Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure & GCP), APIs, and microservices.
Knowledge of big data processing tools (e.g., Hadoop, Apache Spark).
Hands on experience with tools and platforms used in AI development (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Ollama, DataBricks etc.).
Proven experience in managing technical projects, preferably in AI, machine learning, or data-driven technologies.
Experience in architecting AI Solutions using on premise and Cloud technologies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) for managing technical projects.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficiency with data engineering and cloud architecture principles.

What you'll be doing:
Define and design AI architecture, frameworks, and strategies to meet organizational needs.
Evaluate and select AI tools, platforms, and frameworks to develop innovative solutions.
Supervise or contribute to the development, training, and optimization of Large as well as small language models.
Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing business processes while ensuring that the solution complies with customers internal policies and guidelines.
Design AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable over time.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to propose innovative solutions.
Strong understanding & knowledge about Microsoft Azure cloud and deploying PaaS & SaaS applications on Azure
Strong architecture background especially in AI Solutions and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with external vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and solutions.
Project Planning and Execution
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that align with business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones for AI development and deployment initiatives for the inhouse GenAI platform.
Collaborate with business units for ROI determination and identify KPI’s for measuring ROI for each project.
Manage day-to-day project activities to ensure successful execution and timely delivery.
Anticipate potential risks and challenges in AI projects (e.g., data limitations, algorithm performance issues, regulatory concerns).
Proactively implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Ensure that AI projects comply with data privacy regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.
Promote responsible use of AI technologies across all projects.

Team Collaboration and Coordination
Act as the primary liaison between AI research teams, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate regular meetings and communications between business units and IT to discuss AI project progress, challenges, and opportunities.
Plan and coordinate work between onsite and offshore AI teams.
Foster collaboration among team members and remove obstacles to productivity.

What We Offer:
Competitive Salary
Work Life Balance
Professional Development
Innovative Work Environment.
Recognition and Rewards

Description:
Position: Product Security- Embedded / IoT
Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT

Experience: 2 to 10 years

Role Overview
We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products.
The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation.
Key Skills
Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture.
Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections.
Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms.
Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability.
Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration.
Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security.
Ability to understand C/C++ code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts.
Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers.
Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis.
Job Responsibilities
Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks.
Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces.
Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact.
Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle.
Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions.
Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact.
Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks.
Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Position: Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Developers, SRE, and Engineering teams to design and implement Azure infrastructure solutions for products and services.
Design, deploy, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, performance, and operational supportability.
Create and maintain infrastructure architecture diagrams, technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks for Azure environments.
Develop, automate, and test end-to-end cloud infrastructure provisioning and deployment using Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management tools.
Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python, including automated provisioning, configuration, scaling, and operational tasks.
Design and optimize Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Route Tables, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints, VPN, DNS, and Firewall.
Deploy and manage Kubernetes/AKS and containerized workloads, including cluster configuration, application deployment, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application and infrastructure deployments using Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
Develop and enhance infrastructure architecture, performance optimization, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions to support 99.9%+ uptime.
Implement monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana to proactively identify infrastructure and application issues.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to develop new technology initiatives focused on availability, scalability, security, performance, automation, and supportability.
Troubleshoot complex Azure, Kubernetes, networking, Linux, Windows, and CI/CD issues and participate in root-cause analysis and production support.
Establish and enforce cloud, DevOps, security, infrastructure, and automation best practices across environments.
Stay current with emerging Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, automation, security, and cloud-native technologies and continuously improve technical capabilities.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships across Architecture, Engineering, Development, Security, QA, Operations, and Product teams.
Prepare and deliver weekly technical updates and presentations on completed work, infrastructure improvements, automation initiatives, and technical solutions to senior team members and team leads.
YOU MUST HAVE
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
4+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and supporting Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services, networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
Proficiency in Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python for infrastructure automation and scripting.
Strong understanding of Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNet, Subnets, NSGs, Routing, VPN, DNS, Load Balancer, Firewall, and Private Endpoints.
Strong experience with Linux and Windows system administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and best practices.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps.
Experience with Docker and containerized application deployments.
Understanding of cloud security, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault, secrets management, and secure infrastructure practices.
Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent monitoring/observability platforms.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive and motivated Business Development Intern who is interested in learning and building a career in IT business development and sales. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication and writing skills, a logical and analytical mindset, an innovative approach, and the ability to quickly adapt to new tools, processes, and environments. You will work closely with our business development and leadership teams to identify potential clients, research new business opportunities, support lead generation, and understand how IT services are positioned and sold in global markets.


Key Responsibilities
Lead Generation through Business Journals, LinkedIn, Google, Upwork, and other effective professional networking platforms
Perform outbound cold warm calls and emails to the targeted prospects to reach the right decision-maker
Identifying, qualifying, and securing business opportunities; coordinating business generation activities; developing customized targeted sales strategies
Building business relationships with current and potential clients
Understanding client needs and offering solutions and support; answering potential client questions and follow-up call questions; responding to client requests for proposals (RFPs)
Collaborating with sales and leadership to secure, retain, and grow accounts
Creating informative presentations; presenting and delivering information to potential clients at client meetings, industry exhibits, trade shows, and conferences
Creating and maintaining a list/database of prospect clients; maintaining a database (Salesforce, CRM, Excel, etc.) of prospective client information
Maintaining a pipeline of all sales administration using CRM software
Collaborating with management on sales goals, planning, and forecasting; maintaining short- and long-term business development plans


Skills Qualifications
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Good logical thinking, problem-solving, and research skills
Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools, processes, and environments
Proactive, self-motivated, and willing to take initiative
Innovative and creative mindset with the ability to generate new ideas
Basic understanding of lead generation, client research, and business development
Familiarity with Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer, PeoplePerHour (PPH), or Guru is a plus
Good understanding of LinkedIn, Google research, email communication, and professional networking
Comfortable learning and using CRM, Excel, and other business development tools
Ability to understand client requirements and communicate them clearly
Strong willingness to learn about IT services, technology, AI, and digital solutions
Freshers are welcome; attitude, communication, curiosity, and learning ability matter more than prior experience


Experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; the ability to call, connect, and interact with potential customers
Persuasive and goal-oriented

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated expertise in planning and executing internal audits and process reviews independently, with a clear understanding of audit methodology and documentation standards. Strong working knowledge of internal controls design, testing, and evaluation to identify control gaps and recommend effective remediation. Proficient in risk management frameworks and techniques for assessing process and operational risks within business environments. Skilled in using Microsoft Office tools such as Excel for audit data analysis, workpaper preparation, and reporting. Proven ability to deliver clear presentations and monitor the execution quality of team members' audit and process review deliverables.
Skills and qualifications To qualify for the role you must have
Master of Business Administration
Chartered Accountant
Experience
2 to 4 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and it's yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity
Consultant-National-Tax-Tax - ITTS - Advisory - Ahmedabad
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
TAX - ITTS - Advisory :
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Demonstrated expertise in advising on transaction tax matters across domestic and cross-border deal structures. Strong working knowledge of M&A tax considerations, including structuring, due diligence, and post-deal tax integration. Proficient in analyzing tax implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring transactions. Experienced in preparing tax analyses, memoranda, and advisory deliverables that support transaction decision-making. Proven ability to apply general consulting methodologies to translate complex tax regulations into practical, client-ready recommendations.
To qualify for the role you must have
CA
Experience
1+ Years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract. You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk & compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Your responsibilities
Execution on client engagement. Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business & industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the client's business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality & risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application & solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.

Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Skills and attributes for success
Determine that the work delivered is of high quality.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate.
Actively establish client (process owner/functional heads) and internal relationships.
Assist and share knowledge with team members, seniors and managers in developing new methodologies and internal initiatives and participate in performing procedures especially focusing on complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues.
Work with the team and the client to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and advise clients to understand and manage their business risks and verify the validity of their business information.
Brief the engagement team on the client's IA environment and industry IA trends. Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables. Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis.
