Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business. Demonstrate excellent project management skills, inspire teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members, and use current technology/tools to enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and services.
Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients.
Qualifications / Requirements
Chartered Accountant / Certified Internal Auditor or have a Masters degree in Business Administration.
0-1 year of post-qualification experience in risk advisory, related internal audit experience or external audit experience.
Available to travel outside of the assigned office location at least 50% of the time.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) Global Procurement
Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Page 3 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Required Functional Skills & Expertise Technology Procurement Strategic Sourcing Contracting Negotiation SaaS, software licensing, cloud, telecom, managed services, IT professional services, and global technology suppliers Category strategy, RFx/eSourcing, supplier evaluation, spend analysis, market intelligence, TCO, cost modelling, and award recommendations SAP Ariba Sourcing and Contracts; SAP S/4 or ECC, Coupa or equivalent; ServiceNow; Excel; Power BI preferred SaaS agreements, vendor redlines, SOWs, change requests, contract lifecycle management, renewals, and commercial risk assessment Structured negotiation planning, leverage creation, stakeholder alignment, supplier negotiation, and measurable value delivery Governance Tools & Systems Procurement policies, approval thresholds, compliance controls, audit readiness, and source-to-pay governance Soft / Power Skills Strategic Thinking: Translate business needs into practical sourcing and commercial strategies. Leadership Without Authority: Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies. Negotiation Excellence: Apply a structured, fact-based approach to complex technology negotiations. Analytical Problem-Solving: Use data, cost models, and market insights to guide decisions. Executive Communication: Explain complex procurement strategies and contract positions clearly. Stakeholder Management: Build trust and effectively manage senior global stakeholders. Change Mindset: Challenge the status quo and drive process and technology improvements. Resilience & Agility: Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and global time-zone requirements. Page 4 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing. 5-7 years of direct IT Procurement experience across SaaS, software, cloud, telecom, managed services, or IT professional services. Demonstrated experience negotiating SaaS agreements and reviewing supplier redlines in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders. Proven technology negotiation experience, with the ability to explain the situation, strategy, tactics, stakeholder alignment, and commercial outcome. Description:
Finance | Internal Auditor

Location: Bengaluru / Gujarat
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 3+ Years
Travel: Willingness to travel across India

About The Akshaya Patra Foundation:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is a not-for-profit organization implementing the Government of India's PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) Programme. With a presence across 16+ states and 80+ kitchens, the Foundation serves over 2.35 million meals and 1 million morning snacks every day.
Our mission is to ensure that no child is deprived of education because of hunger. We are committed to strengthening our operational and financial processes as we work towards our vision of serving 6 million meals every day by 2030.
Role Overview
The Internal Auditor will be responsible for conducting internal audits, evaluating financial and operational processes, identifying control gaps, and assessing organizational risks across various locations and functions.
The role requires an analytical and detail-oriented professional who can independently conduct audits, assess internal controls, recommend process improvements, and support the implementation of corrective actions to strengthen the organization's financial governance and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
1. Internal Audit & Process Review
Conduct periodic internal audits, process audits and thematic audits across departments and locations.
Review financial transactions, accounting processes, documentation and supporting records to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Evaluate the effectiveness of existing internal controls and identify gaps in processes.
Assess adherence to approved policies, procedures and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
2. Risk Management & Internal Controls
Identify potential financial, operational and process-related risks.
Evaluate risk exposure and recommend appropriate control measures.
Support the development and strengthening of internal control frameworks.
Assess control effectiveness and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
3. Data Analysis & Audit Reporting
Analyse financial and operational data to identify discrepancies, unusual trends and potential risks.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, findings, risk areas and recommendations.
Present audit findings and actionable insights to relevant stakeholders and management.
Maintain proper audit documentation, working papers and supporting evidence.
4. Process Improvement & Corrective Actions
Recommend improvements to existing financial and operational processes.
Work closely with respective departments to address audit observations and implement corrective measures.
Monitor and track the closure of audit findings and agreed action plans.
Support process standardization and documentation across locations.
5. Compliance & Documentation
Review compliance with internal policies, financial procedures and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper maintenance of audit records and documentation.
Support management in strengthening governance, transparency and accountability.

Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
CA Inter / CMA Inter / M.Com / MBA (Finance) will be preferred.
Candidates with relevant professional certifications in Internal Audit, Risk Management or Finance will have an added advantage.

Experience & Skills Required
Minimum 3+ years of experience in Internal Audit, Finance Audit, Risk Management or Internal Controls.
Good understanding of accounting principles, financial processes and internal control systems.
Experience in conducting process audits, identifying control gaps and preparing audit reports.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of Power BI and data analytics tools will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit assignments.
Willingness to travel across different locations in India.

Key Competencies
Analytical Thinking and Attention to Detail
Risk Identification and Assessment
Process Orientation
Problem-Solving and Decision-Making
Effective Communication
Integrity and Professional Ethics
Stakeholder Collaboration
Why Join Us?
Be part of an organization where strong financial governance and operational accountability contribute directly to creating a meaningful social impact. Your work will help strengthen systems, improve processes and ensure that organizational resources are utilized effectively towards our mission of ending classroom hunger.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Third Party Pay Roll
Officer - Costing & Budgeting
Location: Bangalore RO
Experience Required
Minimum 4 years of experience in Costing & Budgeting.
Mandatory experience in handling Real Estate Projects (Residential, Commercial, Mixed-use developments).
Job Purpose
The objective of this position is to prepare and monitor construction budgets, estimate quantities, perform cost analysis, and support effective cost control for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate cost estimation, budget monitoring, rate analysis, and timely reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Estimation
Preparation of BOQs and quantity estimation based on construction drawings.
Analysis and interpretation of drawings received from Structural Consultants, Architects, and MEP Consultants.
Preparation of project cost estimates for residential and commercial real estate developments.
Assist in budget planning during project feasibility and execution stages.
Cost & Budget Monitoring
Preparation of detailed project budgets and periodic budget revisions.
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify variances.
Track budget vs. actual expenditures and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
Prepare and submit monthly cost monitoring reports to management.
Rate Analysis
Conduct rate analysis for various construction activities and materials.
Maintain and update cost databases considering location-wise and project-specific parameters.
Evaluate vendor quotations and support procurement teams in cost comparison exercises.
Develop benchmarking data for residential and commercial projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare MIS reports related to project costs, budgets, and forecasts.
Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance teams for cost tracking and control.
Support management in decision-making through cost analysis and reporting.
Key Competencies
Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.
Ability to read and analyze architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Proficiency in MS Excel and cost estimation tools.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate cost estimation.
Effective project budget preparation and monitoring.
Accurate rate analysis and cost benchmarking.
Monthly budget variance and cost monitoring reports.
Cost optimization recommendations for real estate projects.
This version aligns the role to an Officer level and emphasizes the requirement of 4+ years of experience in real estate project costing and budgeting.

Job description
Interview mode-Face to face
Locations-Chennai, Bangalore
Shifts-US Shift timings
Cab-Two way Cab Facility available
Night Shift allowance also available

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the company's regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.
Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.
Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role
Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.
CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.
Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.
Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Company Profile
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Visit us -
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Mission Statement:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated engineer to join our team of RD Engineers.
A person interested in the field of power electronic converters and contribute towards global RD projects.

How you'll make impact:
You bring broad knowledge in the field of controls design, power electronics as an experienced control engineer for power electronics.
Development of control/Protection software in MACH control platform and MATLAB Simulink.
Documentations for control software like concept documents, test reports and other supporting documents part of development.
Eagerness for learning and innovation, the readiness of mind for the use of various new tools for developments tasks but also for collaborating with the team efficiently.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your Background:

Phd or Master's degree in electrical engineering with an emphasis on Power Electronics control and control system.
Industry experience with power converters, control systems design and real-time control software.
Control software design experience in MACH control platform, MATLAB/Simulink, or other control platforms.
Proficiency in the use of simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD would be an advantage.
Python programming would be an advantage.
Team spirit with the capacity to work independently, complemented by a quick intellect and well-developed analytical skills.
Experience working in an Agile development team would be an advantage.
You like to work in multicultural/international environment.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement: As a Tender/Quotation Specialist for Distribution Transformer Factory - Egypt, you will be part of Indian Operation Center in India (INOPC), aiming to develop a global value chain, where key business activities, resources and expertise are shared across geographic boundaries to optimize value for Hitachi Energy customers across market.
You will support tendering activities of Distribution Transformer Factory in Egypt play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless bid submission and order booking. Work location will be based out of Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Your Responsibilities
Product Marketing Management: Supports the product marketing organization/customer in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions. Formulates competitive bids/estimates/quotations, taking into account best available oil/ dry type transformer product mix and appropriate technical and commercial considerations for each individual situation. Ensures tenders are well documented in a timely manner and with appropriate level of detail, including full and accurate costs.
Offer Preparation - Manages the preparation of all technical (e.g. defining the most suitable technology and product type(s)), financial (e.g. total price sheet, cash flow analysis) and if necessary project management (e.g. quantifies hours of engineering and commissioning) aspects of the bid/estimate/quotation, indicating prices and trading conditions.
Order booking and SFDC Support: Customer creation/Change, Customer credit request, Order booking basing on ERP work as well as SFDC data input/configuration
Risk - Identifies potential risks in the bids, quotations and estimates, and in any related contract agreements across customers/channels. Provides information and/or participates in the Risk Review process in accordance with policy.
Documentation - Collects and archives documentation regarding the offer/order and records assumptions and decisions taken during the development process. Regularly reports the status of the bids/estimates/quotations using defined tools and collects and analyses the reasons for tenders being lost and won.
Health, safety and environment (HSE) - Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies


Your Background
Bachelor's degree in engineering, with 2 plus years of professional experience in Distribution Transformer Tendering or Front End Sales.
Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word
Prociency in English language.
Preferred who have worked in sizable and well-structured organization

Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.
Commercial ambition with delivery discipline.
High standards with strong people leadership.
Data-driven thinking with sound judgement.


Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful


Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix Digital is building on its established strength in global content and digital learning while expanding its Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This role offers the opportunity to influence not just how work is delivered, but how businesses scale, how leaders are built, how customers experience Hurix and how the operating model evolves in an AI-first environment. For the right leader, this is a high-impact enterprise role with significant autonomy, visibility and the opportunity to shape Hurixs next phase of growth.

Job Description Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Company: Hurix Digital

Role Overview
Hurix Digital is seeking an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen security across AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in cloud security, security automation, vulnerability management, and incident response, ensuring secure and efficient software delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement AWS security controls, including IAM, SCPs, KMS, VPC, and multi-account governance.
Integrate security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security using Terraform and policy-as-code tools.
Secure containerized environments using Docker, ECS, and Kubernetes security practices.
Implement secrets management, identity federation, and access controls.
Lead vulnerability assessments, risk-based remediation, security monitoring, and incident response.
Automate security compliance processes aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

Expertise in CI/CD security, preferably GitHub Actions, with tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, and Dependabot.
Proficiency in Terraform and security tools such as Checkov, tfsec, OPA, or Sentinel.
Experience securing ECS/Kubernetes environments, container images, and runtime workloads.
Knowledge of AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, OIDC, and SSO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Bash.
Experience in vulnerability management, SIEM integration, threat modeling, and incident response.
Understanding of security compliance frameworks and software supply chain security, including SBOMs and artifact signing.

Preferred Skills
Experience implementing automated compliance and security governance.
Familiarity with STRIDE, SLSA, and Sigstore.
Strong security architecture, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to mentor developers and drive security best practices across engineering teams.

Ideal Candidate

Job Description: API Automation Test Engineer
Position: API Automation Test Engineer
Experience: 2 to 13 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time

Required Skills
2-13 years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in API Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience in API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Experience in testing and automating RESTful APIs, Web Services, JSON, and XML payloads.
Good understanding of TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and Git.
Experience working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
Experience in database testing using SQL and backend validation techniques.
Knowledge of defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Azure Boards, etc.
Understanding of API authentication and security mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and Basic Authentication.
Experience in integration testing, regression testing, and microservices testing.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Role & responsibilities
Requirement - Business Analyst
Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. The product is deployed in several of the top mutual fund and insurance companies in India and South East Asia and will expose you to the capital markets in these regions.
Finance professional with 2+ years of experience in any Financial Services Industry viz; Asset Management / Portfolio Management / Wealth Management / Mutual Fund / Treasury and other related industry are preferred.
Exposure / Understanding of the following areas is a pre-requisite:
• Understanding of all asset classes (Equities, Bonds, Derivatives, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds , Forex etc.) and examples of each type
• Attributes of each of these asset classes.
• Investment Accounting (General Ledger)
• Understanding of various types of corporate actions
• Understanding of NFO, IPO, Primary Market, Secondary Market etc
• NAV Calculation
• Various types of fees associated with a trade and basic understanding of each fees
• Basic understanding of how accounting is done for each type of transaction.
• Knowledge of Pricing, Valuation, Gain / Loss computation, Interest computation, Amortization, Reconciliation and Reporting
• Knowledge of SQL / Microsoft Excel / Microsoft PowerPoint / Microsoft Word.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Part of the Functional team at Hexagram and will be responsible for Implementation of Hexagrams software products at its client sites
• Assisting the product development team in Testing and validation of functionality
• Providing support to existing clients on the products
• As part of Implementation, will be responsible for supporting the users in user acceptance tests, conducting user training, coordinating with Technical teams, documenting user requirements, assisting in data reconciliation and reporting
• Manage releases from the product team to the client installations, conduct detailed tests, contributing to continuous enrichment of user guides / manuals
• Ability to work as per clients working hours.
Educational Background: Graduate / Post Graduate in Finance
Should be either from BA background or accounting background.
Experience in Front/ Mid /Back end roles on Investment System is a plus.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is a leading higher education company focused on providing executive education and online learning opportunities to working professionals through partnerships with reputed universities and institutions.

Job Overview
We are looking for energetic and target-oriented Inside Sales Executives to join our Admissions & Executive Education Sales team.
The role involves engaging with working professionals, understanding their career goals, counselling them on relevant higher education programs, and managing the complete sales cycle from lead generation to enrolment closure.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with prospective customers through calls and follow-ups.
Handle both warm and cold leads and build a strong sales pipeline.
Understand candidates' career goals, professional background and requirements.
Provide consultative counselling and recommend relevant higher education and executive programs.
Explain program details, curriculum, benefits and career outcomes.
Manage the complete sales cycle including lead nurturing, follow-ups, objection handling, fee negotiation and enrolment closure.
Achieve daily calling, weekly conversion and monthly revenue targets.
Maintain accurate lead and follow-up information in CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
0-5 years of experience in Inside Sales, B2C Sales, Telesales, EdTech, Education Sales, Admissions or Business Development.
Strong verbal communication and convincing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Strong negotiation, objection handling and closing skills.
Ability to build rapport and effectively communicate with working professionals.
Experience with CRM tools will be an added advantage.

Why Join Jaro Education?
Opportunity to work in the growing Higher Education and EdTech industry.
Exposure to executive education and reputed academic institutions.
Performance-driven career growth opportunities.
Structured career progression into Senior CDO, Team Leader, Assistant Manager and Business Manager roles.

The company has been awarded as Leading EdTech Company of the Year by Times Business Award 2024, India’s most trusted online higher education by Outlook Business Icon 2023, the Edtech Leadership award, and the National Best Employer accolade by the World HRD Congress in March 2022.
With its strong domain expertise and insight into executive education, Jaro Education has transformed the careers of over 3 lakh professionals in the last 14+ years through its 23+ learning centers across India, Singapore & USA. The company aims to nurture entrepreneurs & working professionals from entry-level to C-Suite level in every field and industry by offering executive education programs that cater to their requirements. Having been recognized for changing the online education landscape in India, Jaro Education provides more than 150+ management, technology, and techno-functional programs in collaboration with top reputed institutes.

https://www.ceasefire.in/about-us
Ceasefire today is a leading manufacturer of a 360 degree-unified firefighting product portfolio and a fast-emerging
global name that protects millions across the globe. The company has set its foot in the UK with an aim to fulfill the
market gap by offering a holistic fire safety range to the customers, all under one banner. With massive investment in
terms of offices, product demonstration facilities, warehouses and stocking points; Ceasefire is equipped to give
world-class services to the customers in India and abroad.
One Brand, 360 Degree Fire Fighting Solutions
With its globally certified, holistically integrated range of firefighting solutions, the company is amongst the rarest in
the world to have such a diverse product portfolio. The range includes a complete spectrum of solutions including Fire
Extinguishers powder, water, foam, CO2 and clean gases-based extinguishers, the specialized extinguishers for
metal fires, and a range dedicated to the revolutionary Watermist technology to name a few. In-panel systems for
cabinet protection that include LPCB approved CQRS and suppression solutions for extremely small spaces called
Mini. Powder, Watermist or Gaseous Agent based Room Systems and specialized Kitchen Suppression Systems
including Commercial and Domestic systems based on Watermist or Wet Chemical technology, and other Specialised
Fire Fighting Systems, as part of a single eco-system.
Demand Fulfiller as Well as a Demand Generator
In addition to the all-encompassing product range, Ceasefire offers some unique solutions that are trendsetters in the
industry like the Ceasefire Launcher that is an extinguisher + suppression system or a Mini that is worlds smallest
suppression system to an Atom X which is worlds first retrofittable fire suppression system.
Our Manufacturing Edge
Ceasefires competitive edge & the quality promise stems from the companys state-of-the-art production facility with
cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities. This production facility is one of the most advanced in the world and is fully
compliant to the Factory Production Control (FPC) requirements of the highest global standards including EN3,
EN1866, LPCB, BSI, MED, PED, VDS, ISO and OHSAS.
Sales Management
The day-to-day working is fully supported by a robust yet user friendly CCRM that allows a salesperson to record
every transaction he has in his role as a recruiter and as a salesperson.
The CCRM follows the SPANCO process and allows our sales manager or CBA to follow through a sale from the
very start, i.e. from creating a customer profile sheet to making a prospect, sending him a proposal and executing
the order received. It also acts as an archive of marketing materials such as brochures, videos, manuals which can
be sent to many customers at the same time.

The person will be responsible to generate business in the assigned market using listed accounts
provided to him/ her or through her/ his market intelligence

customers to generate new business opportunities.

conversion through effective communication and persuasion.
Ensure strict adherence to the organizations defined sales processes and protocols.
4. Schedule and conduct a minimum of 4-7 client meetings daily to present solutions and generate sales.
5. Deliver engaging sales presentations and demonstrate strong closing
skills to finalize deals.

performance tracking.
7. Regular upskilling through online training program to generate customer need instead of just selling as per customer requirement

Regularly update inputs through CRM/SMP
Regular updating of activities of DMS

We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.

API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML

Dear Candidate,


This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Total Overall Experience-10-15years

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai (as per project requirement)
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days preferred

Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Azure GenAI Developer with strong expertise in Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The candidate should have hands-on experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications using Microsoft Azure AI services.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Build RAG pipelines using Azure AI Search, vector databases, and enterprise data sources.
Develop REST APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Work with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Functions.
Implement prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and model optimization techniques.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications using REST APIs and Azure API Management.
Implement MLOps/LLMOps practices, including deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
Follow best practices for security, responsible AI, version control, and production readiness.

Mandatory Skills:
Python programming
Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering
RAG pipeline development
Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Search and vector databases
FastAPI / Flask / Django and REST API development
Azure Functions and Azure API Management
Git, Docker, and SQL/NoSQL databases

Good to Have:
LLM fine-tuning and model evaluation
MLOps / LLMOps
NLP and machine learning fundamentals
Production monitoring using Azure monitoring tools
Experience with enterprise-scale AI deployments

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with total experience, relevant GenAI experience, current location, notice period, and current CTC/expected CTC.

Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
