Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Job Description
This role is part of the Marketing function and is responsible for driving strategy, market development, commercialization, and lifecycle management across assigned products and therapeutic areas. The Marketing team partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business results through customer-focused strategies.
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a Flex work model, combining on-site and remote work based on business needs. Travel of approximately 35-40% is expected to support customer engagement, market development activities, internal collaboration, and business initiatives across regions.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing product, portfolio, and market strategies that drive commercial growth and customer impact. The role requires strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and accountability from opportunity identification through execution.

initiatives.

Partner with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional teams to deliver strategic priorities.
Monitor business performance, evaluate return on investment, and optimise marketing programmes, resource allocation, and investments.
Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies to build alignment, support decision-making, and drive execution of key initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-impact programmes.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience developing and executing product, portfolio, or commercial strategies that delivered measurable business results.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Strong analytical capability with experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business insights into strategic recommendations.
Experience managing commercialization, product launch, market development, or lifecycle management activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within MedTech, healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, biotechnology, or life sciences industries.
Experience leading regional or multi-country marketing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across geographies.

Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.

Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

About EnKash
EnKash is a full stack payments company offering a unified platform for payables, receivables, corporate cards, and expense management. Backed by key RBI licenses including PA-O & PA-P and PPI, EnKash enables merchants to automate financial operations with compliance and control.

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Risk & Compliance professional with strong expertise in payments for managing our PA & PPI license This role will play a critical part in strengthening risk governance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing fraud across payment flows, card systems, and merchant transactions. You will work at the intersection of risk, compliance, and operations, driving robust controls across both issuance and acquiring environments in a highly regulated fintech landscape. The person is expected to coordinate internally & externally with banks, regulators, FIUs, LEAs etc and help manage risk in the ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Fraud Risk Management & Monitoring: Design and implement end-to-end fraud prevention and detection strategies across payment gateway/acquiring flows/ issuing flows, including real-time monitoring and risk mitigation.
Fraud Investigations & Incident Response: Lead investigations, manage chargebacks/disputes, and handle fraud incidents across card transactions, merchant payments, and gateway flows, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
Regulatory Compliance & Reporting: Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines across PAPG, PPI, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, FIU-IND STR reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Risk Assessment & Control Framework: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across acquiring ecosystems, identifying vulnerabilities in transaction flows, integrations, settlements, and merchant onboarding. Audit & Governance: Drive internal and external audits, strengthen governance frameworks, and ensure robust internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Policy Development & Process Excellence: Develop and enhance risk, compliance, and fraud management policies/SOPs aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices across both ecosystems.
Stakeholder Management & Training: Collaborate with product, tech, business, and compliance teams; present risk insights and drive organization-wide awareness on fraud prevention and regulatory compliance.

What Were Looking For
8-12 years of experience in Audit, Risk, Fraud, or Compliance roles within fintech
Strong exposure to PAPG (Payment Aggregator/Payment Gateway) ecosystems and/or Prepaid Payment Instruments ecosystems.
Solid understanding of RBI regulations, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, fraud management, and digital payments compliance
Hands-on experience in fraud risk management, transaction monitoring, and chargeback handling across cards and/or payment gateway environments
Proven experience managing internal/external audits and regulatory interactions
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
Managing and closing LEA/FIU queries.

Why Join EnKash?
Opportunity to work across both acquiring (PAPG) and issuance (PPI) ecosystems
Exposure to complex, high-scale payment and regulatory frameworks
High ownership role with direct impact on risk strategy and governance

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Gen AI Architect - Lead Data Scientist

Architect end-to-end enterprise GenAI solutions focusing on agentic system designs, including multi-agent orchestration, autonomous task execution, tool-use chains, LLM integration, and RAG pipelines.

- Align technology choices with clients preferred cloud platforms and infrastructure, ensuring compliance, cost efficiency, portability, and seamless integration with existing governance policies and services.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate objectives into agentic AI requirements, defining agent capabilities, success metrics, and MVP scope for iterative delivery.
- Establish robust observability, testing, and operational standards for agentic AI solutions including telemetry, monitoring, automated regression tests, simulation environments, and production SLAs to ensure reliability.

What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Over4years of experience in developing and scaling Generative AI projects from prototypes to enterprise production, managing throughput, latency, cost, and multi-region deployments.
- Proven expertise implementing AI interoperability protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) at scale for seamless system integration.
- Skilled in using enterprise cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI to build and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions.
- Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen for building robust generative AI applications.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Canada Business is looking to appoint a number of Highways BIM Designer's to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.
Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Canada business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.
Your Role
Responsibilities
Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables. Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis.
About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 6 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 2 to 3 years.
AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.
Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 5 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Description:
Online Travel platforms obtain hotel data from multiple sources, including GDSs, bed banks, and other suppliers. Because each source lists hotels differently, this often results in duplicate or mismatched hotel entries.
Hotel Mapping solves this problem by identifying and merging duplicate hotel listings across multiple sources into a single, clean, accurate listing.
This removes duplicates, improves data quality, and ensures customers see the right hotel every time. A Hotel Mapping Expert organizes, matches, and validates hotel data using tools, logic, and automation.
This role is critical for improving customer experience, reducing booking errors, and scaling travel platforms efficiently.

Job

Summary:

Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Organizational Analytics (OA) Consultant in our Talent & Organization (T&O) practice, a typical day might include.

Adopt a data-driven approach to Transformation and Workforce solutions for Global and Local clients.

Engage with clients to understand their challenges, requirements and concerns to determine the best OA solution.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Experience in building data-driven survey-based solutions including frameworks, questionnaires, and action plans.
Linking analytics results with Behavioral Science/ Industrial and Organizational Psychology concepts.
Exposure on Work Force Analytics using basic and advance statistical/ML methodologies in last least 1-2 years.

Define data-backed people strategies to support business transformational programs.
Co-create solutions and assist clients in developing action plans.
Support Product Development and own the delivery of new OA products.
Build strong relationships with clients and foster business growth.
Contribute to T&O practice-building efforts such as recruiting, training and attending community events.


 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Data fluency and working knowledge of statistical methodologies.
Data interpretation with working knowledge of analytic (predictive and prescriptive) models and digital tools.
Fluency in English is required, additional language capabilities are highly advantageous.
Ability to perform in a non-structured and dynamic environment.



Additional Information

:

Natural leader; easily establishes relationships with clients and colleagues.
Team Player; enjoys the intellectual stimulation of collaborating with colleagues around the world.
Determined; appreciates a challenge and overcoming obstacles to achieve results.
Digitally savvy; continuous learner.
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression.
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning.
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do.
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities.

Job Title - Human Resource Transformation Consultant T&O - (S&C GN)

Management Level:09 - Consultant

Location:Gurgaon, Mumbai and Bangalore

Must have skills:Human Resource transformation, HRT


Good to have skills:Organization Design OR Organization Development OR Organization Restructuring OR HR Operating Model

Experience:Minimum 3+ years of experience post Masters


Educational Qualification:Any Fulltime Masters degree/ MBA

Job

Summary:

HR Strategy & Transformation is a team of HR Professionals who specializes in select areas within HR to help our clients target and deliver values for their HR and Talent investments using a distributed delivery model, and can be deployed globally - onsite, near shore and offshore.


Roles & Responsibilities:
HR Operating Model HR Op Model Design, Organization Design, Capability Enhancement
Competency Based Talent Management Competency Modelling, Design, Assessment and Integration with HR & Talent processes
Workforce Management Workforce effectiveness analysis, planning and optimization
HR Shared Services HR Shared service Assessment, Design and Deployment
Process Excellence HR & Talent Processes design, innovation & Implementation
HR SaaS Implementation SaaS Process design, configuration, training & Change Enablement


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:



Knowledge and application of Business Process Re-engineering
HR and TM Process Design experience
HR system implementation experience
Conduct HR Policy Design and harmonization
Project Management of large HRT engagements
Design and deployment of HR Service Delivery Model across diverse set of organizations
Desired knowledge of Cloud HR Platforms (SuccessFactors/Workday/Oracle/SAP)
Knowledge of outsourcing business model of key HR processes.
Talent Management Processes including Talent Acquisition and Performance Management and Rewards.
Talent Availability and Competency Modeling and Assessment
Sourcing Strategy, Recruitment Process Optimization
Performance Measurement, Rewards Audit and Strategic Role Assessment
Minimum 3 plus years of work experience after masters degree and significant years of experience in Human Resource Transformation and Talent Management related projects is desired.
This individual must be comfortable working at the highest levels of client organizations and interacting closely with the C level executives in a range of environments
The individual should be comfortable functioning in a broadly positioned and highly diverse consulting firm
The individual should be comfortable with the Pre sales ,sales and delivery cycle in a global client engagement model
The individual should possess an impressive executive demeanor, a team oriented and collaborative approach, and excellent presentation skills, including strong oral and writing capabilities





Additional Information:


Leadership responsibilities: Focus on growing the practice by ensuring the right strategies and actions are in place. Achieve the target metrics on productivity, utilization, geographic penetration, head count growth, controlling attrition and high degree of engagement from the team and maintaining exception delivery quality


Engagement Management: Manage engagement risk, project economics including planning and budgeting, manage account receivables, define deliverable content, ensure buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client/ client team


Business Development: Work as part of a joint global sales team to identify and win potential opportunities.
People Development: Performs role of counselor and coach, provides input and guidance into the firms staffing process, and actively participates in staff recruitment and retention activities.
Domain Development: Development of assets and methodologies, development of point-of-view, research or white papers, support development of marketing collateral, public speaking and publication in industry periodicals.

Impeccable team management skills with an ability to engage effectively with multiple stakeholders
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight
Strong analytical and writing skills to build viewpoints on industry trends
Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

Roles Responsibilities:

Professional Technical Skills:
3-8 years of relevant post qualification experience
Good, in-depth experience in working in one or more of the following areas:
Oracle Applications solution design : Ability to support the business need discussions and mapping the requirements to Oracle applications/Fusion applications and design the process for supply chain management. Should have skillset to do the configuration as per designed solution.

Understanding of end-to-end cycle of Oracle project like Blueprinting, Configuration, testing, UAT, Cutover, Go-Live, Post Go-Live is preferable
Good knowledge on integration aspects of SCM with other modules such as Finance, Resource planning (ERP), HCM etc.

Bachelors degree in Engineering with good academic record

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Maintain accurate electronic spreadsheets for financial and accounting data. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Address guests service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones and emails using appropriate etiquette. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Key Responsibilities:
Supervise and care for children in the daycare and pre-primary section.

Podar Education was started and operates with the prime purpose of building young minds to spearhead a dynamic future globally. A focus on technology and innovative educational teaching methods has helped Podar establish a leading position among schools in India. In all Podar schools, technology is given special attention and state-of-the-art facilities are available for all the students.
Podar also lays extensive emphasis on sports and extra-curricular activities. Specialized and experienced coaches are deployed in a wide spectrum of sporting disciplines. The schools participate and excel in various inter-school sports tournaments.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Supports all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Supports the tracking and resolution of service issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Operations
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Supports handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Assists with energy conservation efforts by monitoring compliance during property tours.
Supporting Projects and Policies Related to Guest Experience and Safety
- Supports implementation of the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Supports regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintenance.
- Sends copy of MOD report to all departments on a daily basis.
- Ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Understands and can implement all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc.
- Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved.
- Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills.

Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Job description

Lead overall branch operations, customer service, and retail product marketing. Drive business growth by achieving targets in book size, yield, fee income, and customer quality.

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Drive CASA book growth, yield, fee income, and business quality targets.
2. Manage branch sales and service environment effectively.
3. Build and deepen relationships with retail customers.
4. Plan and execute cross-sell strategies and improve sales productivity.
5. Lead local sales campaigns and promotions.
6. Foster a customer-centric culture that ensures high engagement and satisfaction.

Please share the resume at shubham.gupta07@jana.bank.in
AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Short Text :-

Process Engineer is responsible for review process design, conducting technical studies and analysis, problem solving and troubleshooting, plant performance optimizing, implement best practices. Ensure safety and regulatory compliance, sharing knowledge and expertise with team members.
Job Accountabilities:-

1. Conducting technical studies and analysis to optimize plant performance
2. Developing and implementing process designs and improvements
3. Technical studies, technical report preparation for ongoing projects
4. MOC proposal technical evaluation & field verification to ensure risk mitigation
5. Participating in PSSR field activity to capture observations related to process
6. Assistance in basic / detail engineering/pre-commissioning / commissioning for upcoming projects.
7. Ensuring compliance with safety & regulatory standards
8. Use of different tools of Risk assessment-HITRA, Whatif, HAZOP
9. Software competency in process & data analysis tools-Aspen, Hysis, Pipesim, Olga
10. Root cause analysis for failure review, use of failure analysis tools e.g. Why-why
11. Prepare SOP, SMP, KPI and periodic review with job cycle check
12. Providing training to team members for competency building
13. Operating experience of alarm management, alarm rationalization.
14. Carrying out Pre-start-up safety review of new projects and equipment
15. Interpretation of cause & effect, SOC, Alarm & trip register, design conditions.
16. Knowledge of SCADA system and its operating features
17. Working experience as Technical Service with good interpretation of technical data
18. Ensuring deliverable as per Operating management system.

Skills Required (Knowledge and Skills)

Expertise in process engineering fundamentals, process principals including mass & energy balance, thermodynamics and chemical reactions.
Knowledge of different national & international standards, regulations and their applicability.
Experience in process simulation and modelling such as Aspen plus, Hysys, Bow tie, PHAST or similar tools.

Key Attributes (Experience and Qualification)

BE -Chemical Engineering
Minimum 3 years in working experience in upstream (E&P) Oil/Gas/ Project design.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

1. Customer Delight & Experience Excellence Deliver a seamless, personalized experience for every pet parent and pet, ensuring high NPS and repeat visits through proactive engagement, swift service delivery, and empathetic interactions.

Description:
Job Title: Academic Counsellor
Offline Learning Centres
Location: Thane/ Andheri/ Marol/Mumbai
Working Days: 6 (Monday Saturday)
About upGrad
Founded in 2015, upGrad is Asias largest integrated Learning, Skilling, Workforce Development, and Placement company. Its offerings include online and hybrid degrees, study abroad programs, certifications, bootcamps, and doctorates for working professionals. Through its B2B arm, upGrad also provides enterprise training, recruitment, and staffing services. With 10M+ learners across 100+ countries, 300+ global university partners, 2500+ pathway connections, and 20,000+ recruitment partners, upGrad continues to empower careers worldwide.
Learn more: www.upgrad.com/offline-centres
About the Role
As an Academic Counsellor, you will play a key role in guiding potential learners, helping them identify the right career path, and showcasing how upGrads programs can accelerate their journey. You will be responsible for driving enrollments and revenue by nurturing leads, providing consultative counselling, and closing sales in a highly competitive environment.
5 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1. Performance Incentives: Target monthly incentive of INR 30,000, with potential to earn 1.5X/2X of that based on performance.
2. Career Growth: Promotion opportunities in 1 year or lateral movement across other Business Units at upGrad.
3. Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount for your family.
4. Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
5. Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.
Key Responsibilities
Engage with potential learners through calls, video sessions, and in-centre meetings to understand their career goals and recommend suitable programs.
Drive weekly & monthly enrollment and revenue targets by effectively converting leads into admissions.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle from first interaction to enrollment and post-sales support.
Track and improve key performance metrics such as counselling sessions, conversion rates, and revenue.
Maintain accurate learner records on CRM and share feedback with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.
Work closely with centre teams to ensure a smooth learner journey and high satisfaction levels.
Skills & Experience
Graduate with 1–6 years of experience in consultative or B2C sales (education industry exposure preferred).
Strong communication, persuasion and relationship-building skills.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Empathetic listener with ability to build trust and focus on learner success.
Comfortable with CRM tools and basic MS Office proficiency.
Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Description:
Role & responsibilities

Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
Department: Operations
Experience: 7-10 Years (3-5 Years in People Management)
Work Schedule: India Night Shift
Employment Type: Full-Time/In Office
About the Role
We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and experienced Night Shift Operations & Floor Manager to oversee and manage our Indore office operations during the night shift.
The individual will be responsible for ensuring smooth floor operations, employee discipline, employee support, and effective coordination with the Process Managers and Operations Leadership team based in Mumbai.
The person will act as the primary point of contact at the Indore office during India night hours, taking ownership of day-to-day operational activities, addressing employee concerns, managing emergencies, and ensuring that all critical updates and challenges are communicated to the appropriate stakeholders in Mumbai.
We are looking for someone with a strong leadership mindset who can manage the floor, motivate employees, proactively identify challenges, and ensure complete operational visibility for management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Floor & Operations Management
Take complete ownership of the Indore office floor during the night shift.
Ensure smooth day-to-day operations and maintain discipline across the floor.
Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, engagement, and productivity.
Ensure employees remain focused on their assigned responsibilities and avoid unnecessary idle time, excessive personal mobile usage, or unproductive activities.
Identify operational gaps and proactively address floor-related challenges.
Ensure a professional, productive, and well-managed working environment.
2. Coordination with Mumbai Management
Act as the primary point of contact between the Indore night shift team and Mumbai-based Process Managers and Operations Managers.
Immediately escalate production, accuracy, employee performance, and operational challenges to the respective managers.
Maintain regular communication with the Mumbai night shift management team.
Schedule meetings and discussions whenever required to address process-related concerns.
Ensure all escalated issues are followed up until closure.
3. Employee Management & Team Motivation
Motivate, guide, and support employees working during the night shift.
Maintain positive employee morale and encourage teamwork and accountability.
Address employee concerns and workplace challenges.
Monitor employee behaviour, discipline, and overall floor engagement.
Identify employees requiring additional support and coordinate with the respective managers.
4. Medical & Emergency Support
Ensure medical assistance is arranged whenever employees require medical attention.
Act as the first point of contact for emergencies at the Indore office during the night shift.
Immediately communicate critical incidents and emergency situations to the appropriate management.
Ensure timely coordination and support until the situation is resolved.
5. Productivity & Performance Monitoring
Monitor team productivity, production levels, and accuracy.
Identify performance-related challenges and coordinate with the respective Process Managers.
Proactively flag employees or teams facing productivity or accuracy issues.
Arrange discussions with the relevant stakeholders to address performance gaps.
Ensure corrective actions are implemented and monitored.
6. Daily Reporting & Management Updates
Share regular updates with management regarding all important night shift activities.
Provide visibility into employee attendance, productivity, floor discipline, and operational performance.
Report internet connectivity issues, system failures, infrastructure challenges, and other floor-related disruptions.
Maintain records of escalations, incidents, action items, and pending concerns.
Ensure management is immediately informed of any critical issue rather than waiting until the end of the shift.
Prepare and share structured daily shift reports.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Overall 7-10 years of experience with minimum 3-5 years of experience in people management, preferably in BPO, KPO, back-office operations, or similar service environments.
Experience managing teams and handling day-to-day operational activities.
Previous experience in night shift operations will be preferred.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Strong email drafting and professional communication abilities.
Good working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to handle employee concerns, operational escalations, and emergencies.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Ability to manage responsibilities and take ownership of situations.
