Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Guwahati (Lower Assam)
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.

Location: Assam
Position: EHS Officer
Industry: Construction / Infrastructure

Job Purpose
The EHS Officer will be responsible for implementing and monitoring Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) practices at the construction site, ensuring compliance with safety standards, occupational health requirements and environmental management plans.

Educational Qualification & Experience
- Graduate in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 5 years of on-site experience, OR

- Experience working as an EHS Officer in the construction of multi-storied buildings is mandatory.

- Implement and monitor site safety procedures and EHS policies.
- Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety standards.
- Conduct regular site safety inspections and identify potential hazards.
- Monitor implementation of Environment Management Plans (EMP).
- Ensure workers follow safety guidelines and use appropriate PPE.
- Conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks and awareness sessions.
- Investigate site accidents, incidents and near misses.
- Maintain safety documentation, inspection reports and compliance records.
- Coordinate with project teams and contractors to ensure a safe working environment.

Mandatory Requirements
1. Civil Engineering Graduate/Diploma qualification.
2. Relevant on-site EHS experience.
3. Mandatory experience in multi-storied building construction.
4. Hands-on experience in site safety and occupational health & safety.
5. Experience implementing Environmental Management Plans.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.


Requirements

Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Guwahati

* Eligibility Criteria:
Graduate/Diploma in Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
Knowledge of quality testing, sampling and documentation
Good observation, reporting and analytical skills.
Comfortable working at vendor/plant locations and using mobile applications.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Managing all day-to-day operations.
Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Ensures employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Collaborates with the Front Office Manager on ways to continually improve departmental service.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans based on review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Displays outstanding hospitality skills.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Functions in place of the Front Office Manager in his/her absence.
- Communicates critical information from pre- and post-convention meetings to the Front Office staff.
- Participates in department meetings.

Prepare & monitor preventive maintenance (PM) Schedule; review the technician & vendor performance (Site visit, SLAs etc.).Periodically as per defined Parameters, ensure proper documentation of reports (Field service reports, log books etc.) accurately and Timely, supervise maintenance and working of Equipments like network monitoring systems, PIUs for Alarms to avoid major outage and drive better uptime and guide technicians in their work.
Conduct root cause analysis for breakdowns, analyses past PM data; review alarm status at the time of
Breakdown; guide technician on troubleshooting in order to identify causes of breakdown and ensure timely.
30% Compliance with PM Schedules, Site Audit compliance, Feedback, Higher Uptime, PIU working at Site, Accurate and timely Documentation No. of breakdowns at Site/Outages.



Conduct site visits to monitor site hygiene and safety, carry out periodic audits of log books, diesel filling

Control energy OPEX by keeping DG on auto mode and utilizing battery back-up as planned, ensuring no overrated equipment is operated at site; monitor and analyses consumption patterns; identify discrepancies and negative trends; coordinate with technicians to take corrective actions to optimize diesel usage, monitor & document DG/battery/EB run hour and take corrective actions as required, control caretakers/landlords so that they do not interfere with operations & diesel-filling etc.

Create database of site history and issues to share experiences with team and proactively address

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. Other Admin/ operations related works

Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.

Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language

Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.

Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.

Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Senior Manager (Corporate HR, M&A, Payroll Operations & Compliance)
Role Summary
You will oversee workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, and legal compliance.
Manage end-to-end payroll processing, HR operations, and statutory compliance across the organization. Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursements, maintain employee data integrity, and keep company policies and filings aligned with applicable labor and tax laws.
Responsible for leading people-related activities across the acquisition lifecycle, from due diligence and pre-close planning through employee transition, integration, and post-close stabilization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:
F Partner with department heads on manpower planning, manage hiring pipelines, and run structured onboarding programs.
F Employee Relations & Culture:
F Handle grievances, resolve workplace conflicts, support employee engagement, and uphold company policies.
2. Performance & Learning:
F Coordinate appraisal cycles, support career development, and roll out training initiatives.
F Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:
F Administer salaries, benefits, and statutory/payroll processes (such as PF, ESI, and TDS in India).
3. Compliance & HR Operations:
F Maintain accurate HRIS/employee records, track people metrics, and ensure adherence to labor laws and internal policies (including POSH compliance).
4. Pre-Merger: Due Diligence & Risk Assessment
A. Talent & Leadership Audit:
F Identify key personnel, critical revenue-generators, and flight risks.
F Liability & Compliance Review:
F Audit employment contracts, change-of-control clauses, severance agreements, ongoing grievances, and underfunded pension or benefit plans.
B. Cultural Compatibility:
F Evaluate values, leadership styles, and engagement levels to spot major friction points early.
F Deal Negotiation & Valuation
C. Retention & Incentives:
F Help structure stays bonuses, equity rollovers, and compensation packages to lock in key talent.
D. Synergy Validation:
Test assumptions around headcount reductions, restructuring, and organizational design to ensure cost/revenue targets are realistic.
5. Post-Merger Integration (PMI) & Day 1 Execution:
A. Operational Continuity:
F Ensure payroll, medical benefits, HRIS systems, and data flow seamlessly from Day 1 so employees get paid accurately and on time.
B. Organizational Design:
F Redefine reporting lines, eliminate redundancies humanely (with outplacement/counseling support), and align job tiers.
C. Cultural Integration:
F Build a blended corporate culture through active change management and transparent leadership.
D. Communication:
F Over-communicate through multi-channel updates to counter uncertainty, build trust, and keep morale stable
6. Payroll Operations
F Process monthly payroll accurately and on schedule, including salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, overtime, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
F Collect, verify, and reconcile attendance, leave, and compensation change inputs with HR and Finance teams.
F Manage statutory and voluntary deductions (such as PF, ESIC, TDS, Professional Tax, LWF, NPS, or benefits contributions), tax declarations, and payslip generation.
F Resolve employee payroll queries and grievances promptly and maintain audit-ready payroll records.
7. Corporate HR Operations:
F Oversee employee lifecycle administration from onboarding and transfers to promotions, policy updates, and offboarding.
F Maintain accurate employee master data, digital records, and HRIS/payroll system workflows.
F Prepare regular MIS reports, headcount/payroll analytics, and leadership updates.
8. Statutory & HR Compliance:
F Ensure timely filings, challan payments, and annual returns under applicable labor, wage, and tax laws.
F Support internal, statutory, and vendor audits by providing required documentation and reconciliations.
F Keep employee handbooks, workplace policies, and employment records aligned with current regulations.

Preferred candidate profile
I. MBA in HR with 10+ years in corporate HR, talent/org design, Payroll Operations & Compliance with proven hands-on M&A lifecycle experience.
II. Strong grasp of payroll accounting, labor laws, statutory deductions, and tax compliance.
III. Strong understanding of HR disciplines and their interdependencies, including compensation, benefits, HR operations, talent acquisition, talent management, employee relations, payroll, mobility, HR technology, and HR business partnering.
IV. Strong business and financial acumen to evaluate cost drivers, financial exposure, and workforce costs, and balance transaction objectives with employee experience, compliance, and operational readiness.
V. Deep understanding of the HR M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, pre-close planning, employee transition, integration, stabilization, and transition to steady-state operations.
VI. High attention to detail, strict confidentiality, deadline ownership, problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication.
VII. Proficiency in HRMS/payroll software and advanced Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data validation).

Gratuity

Mentor junior consultants and support knowledge transfer activities.

Change Communications Consultant
Job Description
A Change Communications Consultant is responsible for developing and implementing communication strategies that support organizational change initiatives. During periods of change, this role helps keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned with organizational goals, ensuring a smooth and successful transition.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with change management teams to understand the impact of change initiatives and develop communication strategies that reduce resistance and drive adoption.
Design and tailor communication approaches for different audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, engaging, and impactful messages.
Create and deliver communication materials to support change programs, including presentations, newsletters, email campaigns, and leadership communications.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of communication efforts, gathering stakeholder feedback and refining strategies as needed.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communication activities are aligned across the organization.
Facilitate communication between leadership, project teams, and employees to maintain transparency and engagement.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience in developing and executing communication strategies for organizational change initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
Experience using communication and collaboration tools/platforms.
Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to adapt and thrive in dynamic and evolving environments.
Strategic mindset combined with creative problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience with PTC Windchill and/or PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems.
Automotive industry experience or strong domain knowledge in the automotive sector.
Background in change management or organizational development initiatives.
Change Management certification such as Prosci or ACMP.
Familiarity with digital communication tools and employee engagement platforms.
Experience working in large, complex, and matrixed organizations.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Job Title: Business Development Manager
Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.
Who We Are Looking For

Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.
Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

GM Marketing - Engineering Plastics PAN INDIA
Objective:
You are responsible for leading commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds. (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET / PMMA/Nylon/Poly/ POM Blends)
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P-L, and build B2B partnerships.
Oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics across target industrial segments
Principal Accountabilities / Key Responsibilities
F Develop, obtain approval and implement a strategic sales and marketing plan for domestic and export markets, with focus on PP Compounding and non-auto plastic applications.
F Responsible for creating and executing national sales strategies to drive revenue growth.
F Achieve targeted sales volumes, price premia, market share and segment-wise growth in line with the approved marketing plan.
F Devise pricing strategies within defined guidelines to maximize product premia and shareholder value.
F Drive continuous improvement in profitability through regular assessment of customer, product and application portfolios.
F Lead sales & business development for engineering plastic compounds across PAN India
Business Development
F Lead business development for PP Compounding and Plastic Injection Moulding applications for:
F Non -Automotive Industry
F Support customer engagements related to material selection, application development, trials, validation and commercialization.
F Expand Co’s footprint other than non-auto industry
F Analyzing market trends and identifying new business opportunities,
F Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer demand to refine sales strategies and identify new business opportunities.
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings
F Work closely with technical, R&D, production and quality teams
People Management & Leadership
F Build, mentor and develop a high-performing sales & marketing team.
F Setting sales targets, managing and coaching a national sales team,
F Ensure all team members work in alignment with Co’s strategic objectives and HR policies.
F Promote a culture of performance, accountability, knowledge sharing and ethical conduct.

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Location: Bangalore/Noida

Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Job Description
Internal Audit (UK Territory)
Level: Senior Associate
Line of Service: Risk Advisory
Service Area: Internal Audit UK (C&G/ FS)
Location: Acceleration Centre (India), supporting UK onshore teams
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Role Overview (Clear Differentiation)
This role sits within UK Internal Audit and the Senior Associate will perform judgement-led Internal Audit work, including risk assessment, control design evaluation, audit issue formulation, and report drafting, aligned to UK Internal Audit standards and practices.
The role requires individuals who can think like internal auditors, not testers, with the ability to assess end-to-end processes, identify root causes, and articulate meaningful audit insights to UK stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Internal Audit Delivery
Deliver UK Internal Audit engagements across planning, fieldwork, and reporting phases, in line with PwC Internal Audit methodology.
Develop Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs), based on process walkthroughs and risk assessment.
Evaluate control design adequacy and operational effectiveness using professional judgement, not tick-box testing.
Perform targeted substantive testing where required to support audit conclusions.
Independently draft audit observations, issues, and root-cause analyses, clearly articulating:
What is wrong
Why it matters (risk and impact)
Why it occurred
What should be done to remediate
Draft high-quality Internal Audit reports suitable for senior management and Audit Committee consumption.
Ensure issues and recommendations are risk-focused, proportionate, and pragmatic, aligned to the clients UK regulatory environment.
Lead client walkthroughs and deep-dive process discussions, demonstrating strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, risks, and controls.
Act as a key offshore point of contact for UK engagement teams and clients, engaging confidently with stakeholders beyond evidence collection.
Challenge management appropriately and constructively where control weaknesses or design gaps are identified.
Quality, Standards & Methodology
Ensure audit documentation, RCMs, and reports comply with Internal Audit Standards (IIA) and PwC quality requirements.
Support or perform quality reviews of audit work, focusing on audit judgement, clarity of conclusions, and linkage between risks, controls, testing, and findings.
Other Responsibilities
Take ownership of allocated audit areas or workstreams, managing timelines and deliverables independently.
Review and coach junior team members, helping them move beyond testing to risk-based Internal Audit thinking.
Support UK Managers and Senior Managers in managing predominantly offshore or hybrid engagements.

Skills & Experience Required
4 to 8 years experience in Internal Audit (3rd line of defense), preferably supporting UK or similar mature IA environments.
Demonstrable experience in:
Risk assessment and RCM development (beyond testing)
Audit report and issue drafting
Leading client walkthroughs and audit discussions
Strong understanding of Internal Audit concepts, audit lifecycle, and risk-based assurance.
Prior experience in Financial Services (Banking or Insurance) preferred. (Only for FS Recruitment)

Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Commerce, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent.
CA / ACCA / CIA preferred.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.

Senior Network Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 10 Years

About Us:
Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. We are looking for a Workday HCM Functional Consultant with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in the Workday Payroll module

Key Responsibilities
Configure and support Workday HCM and Payroll modules.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into Workday solutions.
Configure Business Processes, Security, Compensation, Absence, and Time Tracking.
Handle Payroll configuration, processing, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
Support Workday implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support.
Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, and technical teams on integrations and EIBs.
Support UAT, regression testing, Workday releases, and issue resolution.

Required Skills
3+ years of hands-on Workday HCM experience.
Strong Workday Payroll experience is mandatory.
Knowledge of Core HCM, Business Processes, Security, Compensation, and Absence.
Experience with Workday Reports, EIBs, and Integrations.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Workday HCM/Payroll certification preferred.
AboutCompany:
At Mastek, were on a journey "to Decomplex Digital with Trust, Value and Velocity"—a mission-driven promise that empowers our customers, colleagues, and communities to thrive in the digital age.
Here’s what makes us unique—and why you’re joining at such an exciting time:
AI-First Momentum
We’ve recently delivered over 25+ new AI-led deals in Q2 FY26, reinforcing our status as a trusted AI-first digital engineering and cloud transformation partner.
We’ve launched pioneering AI platforms like ADOPT.AI and Lightbeam, backed by an AI Engineering Centre of Excellence & AI Academy.
Strong Financial and Operational Performance
Q2 FY26 revenue rose by 8.4% YoY to 940 crore, with a healthy operating EBITDA of 145.5 crore and a 13.2% increase in 12-month order backlog.
Our global presence spans 40+ countries, supported by 5,000+ Mastekeers dedicated to transforming industries across the UK, Europe, US, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
Values-Driven Culture
At Mastek, our culture is shaped by VECTOR—our core values of Velocity, Empowerment, Collaboration, Trust, Ownership, and Respect. These guide everything from decision-making to team interactions.
Employees consistently highlight our “supportive work culture,” collaborative teams, and numerous opportunities for learning and growth.

Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship Job description About the role: We are seeking a highly motivated Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship to join our team, contributing to our efforts in transforming healthcare delivery through Value-Based Care (VBC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong clinical background, basic understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, and a passion for leveraging data to drive better health outcomes and cost efficiencies. We are looking for individuals who will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and are keen to significantly grow their skills and knowledge in clinical data analysis, clinical coding, and risk analysis. Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship will work directly with our clinical data analysts, prior authorization and utilization management reviewers, qualified clinical informaticists, and data scientists. This role bridges clinical knowledge with analytics, clinical information exchange, supporting strategic decision-making and operational efficiency across our value-based care programs.
What We Offer:
A challenging and rewarding experience at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
Direct mentorship from experienced clinical informaticists, data scientists, and analysts.
Opportunity to make a tangible impact on Value-Based Care initiatives.
Exposure to cutting-edge tools and methodologies in clinical data analysis.
A collaborative and supportive team environment dedicated to professional growth.
A Day in the Life
Collaborate and Learn: Work alongside clinical data analysts to evaluate and assist in extracting meaningful insights from electronic clinical data.
Data Translation: Assist in the translation of non-standard electronic clinical data into standard clinical codes (e.g., ICD, CPT, SNOMED).
Clinical Review Support: Support reviews of prior authorizations and utilization management guidelines, offering insights from both provider and payer perspectives.
Communication Presentation: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders, effectively translating complex data into actionable strategies.
Process Improvement: Identify and recommend innovative ideas, processes, and/or procedures for enhancements, additions, and modifications to improve existing workflows and processes.
Regulatory Awareness: Research and stay informed on key updates related to CMS, HCC, NCQA, HEDIS, and other regulatory frameworks relevant to VBC and CMMI programs.

What you Need:

Clinical Background: Clinician experienced in direct patient care or clinical experience in a U.S. healthcare setting.
Data Familiarity: Familiarity with data concepts; exposure to SQL, FHIR, or experience working with clinical or claims datasets.
Analytical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to approach clinical and operational challenges with a data-driven mindset, translating them into data requirements and potential insights.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and clinical problem-solving skills.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.
Time Zone Alignment: Ability to work hours aligned with the U.S. Central Time Zone (typically 12:00 PM - 8:30 PM IST / 12:30 PM - 9:00 PM IST). This alignment is critical for real-time collaboration with U.S.-based teams.
Preferred:
Informatics Exposure: Prior exposure to clinical informatics, healthcare IT systems, or population health initiatives.
Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with concepts like HCC coding, risk adjustment, and quality metrics (e.g., HEDIS, STAR ratings).
Advanced Data Skills: More advanced experience with SQL, Python, R, or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Core Competencies
Analytical thinking and clinical problem-solving
Strong communication and presentation skills
Cross-functional collaboration and team orientation
Attention to detail with a systems-thinking mindset
Passion for improving healthcare delivery and outcomes

Benefits

Here s What We Offer
Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
Parental Leave: Leverage one of industrys best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break Weve got you covered. Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
Care Program: Whether it s a celebration or a time of need, we ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Job Responsibilities
Image Interpretation: Review and analyze diagnostic images (X-rays, MRIs, CT scans, ultrasounds, and PET scans) to identify abnormalities and establish accurate diagnoses.
Report Generation: Prepare detailed, comprehensive written reports of findings and document procedural outcomes for referring physicians.
Image-Guided Procedures: Perform or direct minimally invasive, image-guided procedures such as biopsies, aspirations, and vascular interventions.

Technical Proficiency: Hands-on ability to operate and navigate advanced hospital imaging hardware and Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS).

Manual Dexterity: Steady hand-eye coordination required for performing delicate image-guided interventions and biopsies.

Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
  Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.
