Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Front Office Front Office Executive, you re not just managing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Role overview
The opportunity: Project Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - Noida

ASU - Forensics - Discovery :

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Your meticulous attention to detail and commitment to excellence will help create an unforgettable experience for our guests. As a Housekeeping Associate, you re not just ensuring the cleanliness of guest rooms - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Minimum of 1 year of experience in the Housekeeping department
Prior housekeeping or room attendant experience preferred, especially in hospitality.
Ability to maintain high cleanliness and presentation standards.
Capable of performing physically demanding tasks (e.g., lifting, bending, standing for long periods).
Courteous and professional when interacting with guests.
Efficient in completing tasks within set timeframes.
Works well with housekeeping and other hotel departments.
Available to work shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Basic proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Knowledge of cleaning chemicals and safety procedures.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Keep guest rooms spotless: Clean and tidy assigned rooms, including making beds, cleaning bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, and performing deep cleaning tasks as needed
Replenish linens and amenities: Replace bed linens, towels, and guest essentials as needed
Manage supplies: Stock, maintain, and transport the housekeeping supply cart daily
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests promptly and courteously
Manage waste disposal: Dispose of trash and recyclables in designated areas

Role & responsibilities :
OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

JL5: 5-9 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle-from concept and planning through construction and operation. Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in building and maintaining robust backend services that power our applications. This position requires a developer with strong experience in Golang and Python , along with hands-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure , containerization , and databases .

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go (Golang) and Python .
Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for efficient data storage and caching.
Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance and scalability issues.
undefined

Qualifications:
3-5 years of backend development experience.
Proficiency in Golang and Python .
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis .
Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestration.
Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM).
Understanding of RESTful API design principles.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
B.E/BTech. degree in Computer Science, similar technical discipline or equivalent practical experience

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

Description:
Manager - Operations
About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratizing the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to mid-market to cater to the next
100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (10001500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (15003000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)
We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10 across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Description:
Position Summary

The IT Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for program implementation.

The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations.

Travel: Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting

Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorised service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.

B. IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding

Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organisational IT standards and security requirements.

C. IT Asset Management and Inventory Control

Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilised equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.

D. Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure

Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorised vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.

E. Software, Applications, and Digital Tools

Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organisation-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organisational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organisational devices and systems.

F. IT Security and Data Protection

Ensure that organisational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organisational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorised access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorised applications or storage devices.

G. IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings

Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.

H. IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring

Maintain a centralised log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and prioritise critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

I. Staff Orientation and Basic IT Capacity Building

Conduct basic orientation sessions for new and existing staff on the appropriate use of laptops, email, approved applications, and IT security practices.
Develop or share simple user guides and troubleshooting instructions for frequently reported issues.
Help staff adopt standard procedures for raising IT requests and reporting technical incidents.
Identify common IT skill gaps among field staff and recommend targeted support or refresher sessions.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
Approximately 23 years of relevant experience in IT support, desktop support, helpdesk operations, or field-level IT service delivery.
Experience providing technical support across multiple offices or geographically dispersed locations would be an advantage.
Practical knowledge of laptop and desktop troubleshooting, Windows operating systems, printers, basic networking, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 or similar productivity applications, email systems, video-conferencing tools, and basic endpoint security.
Experience maintaining IT asset registers, service request trackers, and equipment repair records.
Ability to communicate technical information in simple language to non-technical users.

5. Core Competencies

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills - a responsive approach to staff support.
Ability to prioritise requests and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
Ability to work independently across multiple districts.
Willingness to travel regularly to district offices and field locations.
Commitment to confidentiality, data protection, and organisational IT policies.

Job Summary
The Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for programme implementation. The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements. The base location will be Palamu/Hazaribagh.
Responsibilities
Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorized service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.
IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding
Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organizational IT standards and security requirements.
IT Asset Management and Inventory Control
Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilized equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.
Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure
Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorized vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.
Software, Applications, and Digital Tools
Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organization-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organizational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organizational devices and systems.
IT Security and Data Protection
Ensure that organizational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organizational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorized access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorized applications or storage devices.
IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings
Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.
IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring
Maintain a centralized log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and priorities critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Title: Project Manager - YouthRise
Education: Bachelor of Social Work in Any Specialization, B.A - Bachelor of Arts in Development Studies, Rural Development / Rural Studies, Social Work, Social Sciences (General), B.Sc in Rural Development Science
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Project Management, Program ManagementStakeholder Management, About company, ChildFund India works towards ensuring that children from the most marginalized sections of the society become able, confident, and responsible adults.
Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Project Manager will be overall lead for the project titled YouthRise currently being implemented in Khunti and West Singhbhum districts of Jharkhand. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end project planning, implementation and monitoring across 100 target villages of the project. This includes program planning, execution, team management, engagement with the government line departments, local partners management, budget oversight and management, and reporting including donor reporting. The role requires a hands-on leader who can manage a field-based team, build strong relationships with government line departments, provide technical support to local implementing partners and ensure the project delivers quality outcomes for children, youth and communities in the target districts within the project timelines and approved budget. The Project Manager is also responsible for ensuring technical guidance and support to the project from different thematic specialists at National Office in Delhi/Bangalore.
Be accountable for accomplishing the project milestones, enhance relationship and networking with other stakeholders such as government departments, technical agencies, local partners, local authorities, elected representatives, peoples organizations, local communities, etc.
Develop annual, quarterly and monthly work plans, budgets, and targets in line with the overall project design and donor commitments.
Ensure smooth implementation of the project activities as per approved plan, meeting the compliance requirements.
Manage the project budget responsibly, ensuring adherence to ChildFund India's financial policies and donor guidelines.
Coordinate timely technical guidance and support from different Thematic Specialists particularly Child Protection, Youth Skilling / Livelihoods and Education to the project to ensure quality inputs to the project and its outcomes
Build and maintain strong working relationships with the District Education Department, Child Protection Unit, State/District Livelihoods Mission and leverage their support for successful implementation project activities.
Represent the organization in appropriate external forums particularly at government line department level.
Prepare periodic and qualitative reports with inputs from technical team and finance team for submission to the donor on quarterly and annual basis.
Conduct periodic monitoring visits to the project to review activity implementation and address gaps through requisite support.
Managing the team and provide them necessary technical and operational guidance and support including capacity building/specific trainings.
Establish monitoring and tracking frameworks and coordinate with the MEL and Research team to undertake project related assessments baseline, midline and endline to generate project evidence as well as establishing uninterrupted flow of project data and information on a regular basis.
Coordinate with Communication Team for producing project impact stories, video documentation, case stories, etc. to capture project impact and its submission to the donor.
Conduct monthly, quarterly and annual reviews with the project staff and report on the progress with feedback for further improvement on a regular basis.
Provide required feedback to the project team with corrective measures and technical support on a regular basis.
Support in identifying consultants & technical / resource agencies for specific technical assignments planned under the project.
Submit timely and quality narrative and financial reporting to the Specialist, State Program and Partnership and/or Regional Lead Program & Partnerships as well as other stakeholders as required.
Undertake monitoring visits to local partners to observe activity implementation, review the project progress including budget monitoring and technical guidance.
Lead local partner capacity assessments, draw capacity building plans and ensure its implementation with technical support from both internal and external experts.
Be the focal point for all partner related communications, reporting and government engagement to implement project activities.
Ensure partners submit timely quality program and financial reports and its submission with technical review.
Ensure child safeguarding and child protection standards are upheld across all project activities and community engagements.
Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities in implementation and proactively flag these to management with recommended solutions.

Perform any other responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager relevant to the program's goals.

Preferred candidate profile
Education: Bachelors degree in social work, Education, Development Studies, Management, or a related field.

Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in NGO sector, of
which minimum of 3 to 5 years experience in management and leading specific project/program.

Language Proficiency: Strong communication skills (both verbal and written) in Hindi & English. Jharkhand local languages will be an asset.
Skills and Abilities: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort with basic data and reporting tools. Willingness to travel extensively within Khunti and West Singhbhum districts and undertake frequent field visits to program locations to interact with children, youth, women and communities as well as local partners. Excellent presentation, public speaking and interpersonal skills. Self-driven, result oriented and experience of managing teams. Be gender sensitive with strong conviction and skills for the empowerment of excluded and disadvantaged children.
Job Knowledge: Self-driven, result oriented and experience of managing teams. Strong experience in building networks and developing relations with stakeholders both government and non-government at district and state level. Demonstrated experience in capacity building of staff and partners including training, mentoring and leadership. Knowledge of participatory community development approaches. Previous experience of designing and implementing Child Protection and/or Livelihoods projects would be an asset. Prior experience of working with government line departments and leveraging resources for the benefit of program participants would be advantageous. Sound understanding of budget management and donor reporting requirements.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Salary starts at INR 925,000/- per annum plus benefits, with scope for consideration for adjustment in line with the experience, skills, and knowledge the selected candidate brings.
Benefits (subject to the provisions of the approved Employee Manual):
Provident Fund and Gratuity as per Indian Labour Law
Annual Merit-based Performance Salary increase.
Health Insurance Coverage - to support the well-being of employees and their families.
Leave and Holiday framework that supports rest, renewal, and personal priorities Annual Leave (24 days), Casual Leave (10 days), Sick Leave (10 days), Special Leave (5 days), Maternity Leave (26 weeks), Paternity Leave (2 weeks), Exam Leave (5 days), Holidays (15 days)
Hybrid and flexible work schedule options for eligible roles to enable effective offsite working while staying connected and productive.
Learning and Development opportunities to support growth and build future-ready capabilities.

Description:
We work in collaboration with State Education Departments to bring reform by implementing large-scale system-led projects, with the goal of improving foundational learning (FLN) outcomes in students. Our team supports the State in designing and implementing an integrated program that encompasses multiple aspects of a reform process - ranging from designing effective classroom pedagogy to building salience and state capacity to deliver FLN at scale, while also strengthening governance and other critical enablers. Room to Read has partnered with the Education Department of Jharkhand on a long-term engagement for system reform and a demonstration program in selected districts.


Responsibilities
The Program Associate will be responsible for the intervention in his / her district and will have the following specific key roles and responsibilities:


Program Understanding
Develop a thorough understanding of Room to Read s Literacy program design and Project Deliverables
S/he has good awareness of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy programs, their design and strategies operating in project region.
Develop a strong understanding of Govt s education policies NEP, NCF, FLN, SIQE, Mission Ankur etc.


On-ground Implementation and Monitoring
Support the quality implementation of the project in the district and blocks, ensuring timely, efficient, and well-coordinated implementation, adhering to the program and budget guidelines.
Complete higher frequency of regular visits to program schools, observe classroom transactions, speak to teachers and head masters and make suggestions for improving quality and utilization of these materials.
Support District Lead collating collated from the field to further communicate the same to SO and CO for necessary changes in the pedagogy and material.
Support in analyzing various data and information emanating from the field, develop programmatic co- relations and flag off issues for a larger discussion.
Participate in any other activities which may be required to be undertaken to fulfil the objectives of the organization.
Support effective utilization of program budget through proper planning and tracking of planned activities. Ensure that financial and procurement norms are adhered to, and efforts are made to reduce cost to the extent possible, without compromising on the quality.
Track program progress on key indicators according to the ME framework during monthly meetings and throughout the project timeline.
Participate actively on social media in all Room to Read (RtR) campaigns.
Stay updated and share this knowledge with the District Lead regarding new programs/interventions of the like-minded organizations in district.
Identify operational bottlenecks and weaknesses, wherever applicable and come up with solutions for the same in consultation with District Lead.
Support the District Lead in the execution of the Project by leading all technical tasks in the district focused on capacity building of stakeholders across all levels (District, Block, Cluster and Schools), support uptake of materials, and establish coordination with various stakeholders at the district level to sustain the impact and interventions from the program.


Government Liaison and Technical Support
Support District Lead in participation of technical assistance discussions at the district level.
Attend government meetings, discussions and committees on foundational literacy as well as Numeracy and use those forums to advocate for enabling policies and government orders in support of RtR literacy program.
Interact with key stakeholders (government departments and officials such as CDEO/ADPC/DEEO/RPs/DIET etc.) as recommended by the District Lead to ensure delivery of program objectives and explore opportunities for systemic integration.
Conduct discussions with stakeholders at multiple levels across the districts reflecting on the insights collated via field visits, monitoring data and interactions to formulate the way forward for the month.


Participation in Meetings/Workshops at State and INCO Level
Participate in IDTS workshops on material development, training module development and training of trainers.
Attend review meetings at the state/national level and provide reflective feedback on program implementation and design issues. At the same time acts as the conduit for transferring innovative ideas and practices from the national level (or from other states) on to the field.


Planning, Reporting and Documentation
Support District Lead for preparing regular (monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis, including program data) qualitative reports and documenting event reports, case studies and best practices.
Support and ensure all data entry and compilation on monthly, quarterly and yearly basis, including GSD, Dashboard data, maintaining high levels of data quality.
Develop actionable insights through analyses of data collected via monitoring visits to further inform the project implementation.
Assist for preparing Implementation calendar, cash forecast, PRs budget outlook, APB and regular tracking of budget management.


Qualifications

Required
Master s degree in education / social sciences or equivalent preferred.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector.
In-depth knowledge on foundational literacy, language and reading practices and approaches.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Ability to travel regularly to project sites in remote locations.


Preferred
Able to design google forms, sheets, sites, dashboard etc.
Data analysis through advance excel, SPSS etc.
Development of short videos
Able to design workshops session plan.
Able to lead facilitation in workshop for internal team, teachers and officers etc.
Able to design modules, feedback forms, questionnaire, etc.
