Description:
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.


Job Summary
Position Overview: The Associate will supports technology adoption, EdTech pilots, and on-ground program delivery for the Prevail Fund Jharkhand Foundational Literacy Program (SFLP) in Jharkhand. The role also feeds into the wider Jharkhand State Project Management Unit (SPMU) technology agenda. The role sits close to field cadres and program teams. It will be a cross functional role involving you moving between a training hall, a school, and a spreadsheet in the same week. This role turns technology into action on the ground: configuring the LMS, running pilots, listening to users, and closing the gap between what a tool promises and what a CRP or teacher actually experiences in the field. This position requires frequent travel and will report to District Lead.
About the Edtech Function in Prevail-Jharkhand: Room to Read uses a blended training framework (Online + Offline) to train and certify field cadres (Program Field Coordinator, Program Associate, Program Officer, District Lead) across multiple districts. The program also testing new EdTech and AI tools to support teacher training, coaching, and classroom practice.


Responsibilities
LMS Management: Manage day-to-day use of the Jharkhand LMS instance for field cadre training and certification.
Set up courses, quiz banks, and completion tracking for each training module.
Coordinate with the Room to Read India LMS administrator for platform changes and upgrades.
Troubleshoot access and login issues for learners and facilitators.
EdTech Pilots and AI App Testing: Coordinate the testing of AI applications and EdTech tools proposed for the Jharkhand program.
Plan and run field pilots from setup through review: install the tool, train the users, observe use, and record results.
Flag technical issues and usability problems to the EdTech Lead and the tool developer.
User Research and Feedback: Plan and conduct user interviews with teachers, CRPs, Master Trainers, and other field cadres.
Collect feedback on the Moodle platform, training content, and EdTech pilots.
Turn raw feedback into clear, short insights the Edtech team can act on.
Use Case Landscaping: Map where technology is already used, and where it could help, across the Prevail Jharkhand project: training, coaching, monitoring, and libraries.
Keep a shared, up-to-date use-case map for the project team.
Flag priority use cases for the EdTech Lead to take forward.
Creation of mockups and prototypes using AI and other design tools
Field and Program Support: Give on-ground support to program staff and government cadres in multiple districts.
Join field visits with the District Lead, CRPs, and Master Trainers as needed.
Support the rollout of training sessions, TLM (Teaching and Learning Material) distribution, and monitoring tools at the school and cluster level.
Technology Facilitation: Act as the first point of contact for field staff questions about LMS, apps, and other digital tools.
Run short orientation sessions on new tools for field cadres.
Write simple, step-by-step guides for tools and workflows.
Reporting and Documentation: Keep clear records of pilot activities, interview notes, and platform issues.
Contribute EdTech updates to monthly and quarterly program reports.
Keep the projects knowledge base current on EdTech status and open issues.


Qualifications
Graduate degree in education, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in EdTech, LMS administration, or field program support.
Comfort with frequent field travel as needed across multiple districts.
Basic troubleshooting skills with mobile apps and digital tools.
Experience with qualitative research methods, such as user interviews and feedback collection.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi.


Preferred
Working knowledge of Moodle or another LMS platform.
Prior experience in the education or development sector.
Exposure to AI tools used in education or training delivery.
Experience working with government education cadres (CRPs, BRPs, Master Trainers) or community-level stakeholders.

To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

Education :
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology

4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.

Location: Sambalpur and Cuttack

Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Institution: Birla Global University
Department: Admissions

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Admission Officer to manage the end-to-end admission process at Birla School of Engineering and Technology. The candidate should have strong communication, counselling, coordination and student engagement skills, preferably in the higher education sector.
Key Responsibilities
Handle admission enquiries and counsel students and parents about academic programmes.
Manage the complete admission process from enquiry to enrolment.
Follow up with prospective students and drive admission conversions.
Verify applications, eligibility and supporting documents.
Maintain admission records, databases and reports.
Coordinate with academic and administrative departments.
Support admission campaigns, education fairs and outreach activities.
Ensure compliance with institutional admission policies.
Eligibility & Skills
Graduate/Postgraduate in any relevant discipline.
6-12 years of experience in admissions, preferably in a university or engineering college.
Excellent communication, counselling and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of admission procedures and documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office and admission management systems.
Strong coordination, follow-up and team management skills.
Preferred: Candidates with experience handling admissions for engineering programmes or higher education institutions.
* Good knowledge of admission procedures, documentation and student database management.
* Proficiency in MS Office and admission management systems.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and team management abilities.
Candidates with relevant experience in educational institutions, preferably in handling admissions for engineering programmes, are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Electrical Engineer
Job Brief: Join JSW Steel Limited's Maintenance Department as a key technical professional responsible for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of electrical systems within a large-scale manufacturing environment. This role demands expertise in electrical engineering principles applied to heavy industrial equipment, with a focus on preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and system optimization to support continuous steel production operations. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance operational safety, reduce downtime, and improve energy efficiency in alignment with JSW Steel's commitment to excellence and sustainability.
Responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance plans for electrical equipment and systems in the steel manufacturing plant.
Conduct detailed electrical inspections and diagnostics to identify faults and recommend effective solutions to minimize production interruptions.
Collaborate with mechanical and process engineering teams to integrate electrical systems with overall plant operations and optimize performance.
Manage and supervise electrical maintenance teams, ensuring adherence to safety standards and regulatory compliance.
Analyze electrical system failures and implement root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability.
Coordinate with vendors and contractors for procurement, installation, and commissioning of electrical components and systems.
Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, electrical schematics, and compliance records.
Lead initiatives for energy conservation and electrical system upgrades to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety protocols, and environmental regulations specific to electrical maintenance in manufacturing.
Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers and maintenance staff to build team capability.
Skills:
Industrial Electrical Systems Maintenance
Electrical Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Preventive and Predictive Maintenance
Electrical Safety Standards Compliance
Power Distribution and Control Systems
PLC Programming and Automation
Root Cause Analysis
Energy Management and Conservation
Technical Documentation and Reporting
Team Leadership and Training
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.
Professional certification in electrical maintenance or industrial automation (e.g., Certified Maintenance Reliability Professional, Electrical Safety Certification) is highly desirable.
Required work experience
Years of experience: #*3-8 years experience*#

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Manager - Concurrent / Prepayment Audit.
Join a leading stainless-steel manufacturer as the pre-payment control gatekeeper at our Jajpur plant. 100% concurrent / prepayment audit of all invoices - Project, Logistics, Raw Material, MRO & Operations - before payment is released. Prevent leakages, ensure compliance and drive recoveries within a robust SAP-based continuous audit framework.


Key Responsibilities
Pre-audit of all invoices before payment (3/4-way match in SAP).
Verify PO, GRN, BOQ/JMR, rates, LD & contractual terms.
Detect duplicate, advance & overpayments; plug leakages.
Cover Project, Logistics, RM, MRO & Operational invoices.
Maintain audit trackers, aging, recovery & MIS dashboards.
Coordinate with Finance, Purchase, Projects & vendors.
Individual Contributor and mentor the location concurrent audit team.


What you bring
Qualified CMA / MBA (Fin) / Inter-CA (CIA/CISA preferred).
4-8 years in concurrent / prepayment /Accounts Payable / internal audit.
Hands-on in SAP FICO & MM (MIRO, MIGO, ML81N, FBL1N).
Strong in Accounts Payable (AP) or invoice processing prepayment audit.
Experience in project, logistics, RM & MRO invoice review.
Advanced Excel & PPT.
Strong stakeholder management & integrity.


Key Skills & Competencies
SAP Proficiency - Hands-on working knowledge of SAP FICO & MM modules - vendor invoice verification (MIRO), PO/GRN 3-way & 4-way matching (ME23N, MIGO), FBL1N vendor ledger, service entry sheets (ML81N), payment blocks and release strategy.
Prepayment / AP Audit - Deep expertise in Accounts Payable (P2P) cycle, prepayment / pre-audit of invoices before release of payment, TDS/GST validation, duplicate payment detection and vendor reconciliation.
Invoice Domain Coverage - Ability to audit all invoice categories - Project (Civil / Mechanical / Structural / E&I) , Logistics & Freight, Raw Material (RM), MRO and Operational / service invoices.
Stakeholder Management - Strong engagement with Finance, Purchase, Projects, Stores, Logistics, Plant Operations and vendors; ability to resolve queries with documentation and traceability.
Analytics & Automation - Advanced Excel, Automate for audit trackers, aging analysis, KPI scorecards and continuous monitoring.
Compliance & Governance - Sound knowledge of GST, TDS, Indian INCO, statutory compliances, internal controls.

Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Coordinate employee transport services and site vehicle management.

Manage daily canteen forecasting, manpower availability, and service quality.
Support front desk operations, courier services, and employee administration activities.
Coordinate leadership, global leadership, customer visits, and hospitality arrangements.
Organize employee engagement activities such as birthday celebrations and events.
Support medical health check-up drives and employee welfare programs.
Manage uniform measurement and distribution activities.
Coordinate induction and training schedules for new joiners.
Drive plant 5S initiatives and workplace organization standards.
Manage admin service vendors and ensure compliance with service-level agreements.

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Minimal or no work experience required.

Position description: Join Jindal Ferrous Limited's Central QA - Blast Furnace department as an entry-level engineering professional dedicated to supporting quality assurance processes within the mining and metals sector. This role involves assisting in the monitoring and optimization of blast furnace operations to ensure compliance with industry standards and company quality benchmarks. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise in metallurgical processes, data analysis, and quality control methodologies while contributing to the continuous improvement of production efficiency and product quality in a dynamic industrial environment.

Conduct routine inspections and data collection to evaluate the performance and condition of blast furnace equipment.
Support senior engineers in analyzing metallurgical data to identify process deviations and recommend corrective actions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to safety and environmental regulations during furnace operations.
Maintain accurate documentation of quality control tests, inspection reports, and process parameters.
Participate in troubleshooting and resolving operational issues under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Contribute to the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for blast furnace quality assurance.
Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations for management review and decision-making.
Engage in continuous learning to stay updated on industry best practices, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements.

Metallurgical Process Knowledge
Quality Assurance and Control
Data Analysis and Interpretation
Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Technical Report Writing
Root Cause Analysis

Job Description


Any Graduate
Proven experience (1-3 years) in providing IT support, preferably in a warehouse or logistics setting.
Strong knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, and software applications, Basic network systems.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Customer-focused with outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Detail-oriented and well-organized.
Willingness to work in shifts or extended hours, if required.



1. Help Desk Support:
- Act as the first point of contact for warehouse staff seeking technical assistance, both in person and remotely.
- Provide prompt and efficient resolution of hardware, software, and network-related issues.
2. Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution:
- Diagnose and resolve technical issues reported by warehouse personnel related to computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
- Escalate complex problems to the IT team or vendors when necessary and follow up to ensure timely resolution.
3. Inventory Management:
- Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware, software licenses, and related equipment used in the warehouse.
- Assist in the procurement and deployment of new IT assets as needed.
4. Data Security and Backup:
- Ensure data security measures are followed, including regular backups of critical systems and data.
- Assist in implementing security protocols to protect sensitive information.
5. User Training and Documentation:
- Conduct training sessions for warehouse personnel on IT procedures, best practices, and software usage.
- Maintain documentation for IT processes, troubleshooting guides, and user manuals.

Job Title: Data Science Instructor
Location: Gurugram & Bhubaneshwar
Working Days: 6 (Monday to Saturday)

About the Role
As an Instructor at our Offline Learning Centres, you will deliver engaging sessions in Data Science,
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and related fields to students and working professionals. You will play a vital role in ensuring high-quality learning outcomes through classroom teaching, mentorship, and academic support. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for technology and education, while shaping the careers of tomorrow.

6 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1. Career Growth & SME Pathway: Accelerate your career with opportunities to move into
leadership roles and grow as a Subject Matter Expert by contributing to content
development, curriculum design and new program launches.
2. Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount
for your family.
3. Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself
and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
4. Attractive Incentives: Earn additional incentives for successful student referrals from your
batches, giving you direct rewards for expanding the learner community.
5. Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral
bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.
6. Impact & Exposure: Opportunity to work with industry leaders, design cutting-edge content,
and directly impact learner success.

Key Responsibilities
* Deliver in-person lectures and training sessions in Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and related domains.
* Guide learners through concepts, case studies, and projects to ensure strong understanding and application.
* Collaborate with Centre Managers and academic teams to monitor learner progress and outcomes.
* Support students with doubt-solving, mentorship, and building career-ready skills.
* Continuously update knowledge and content to stay current with industry trends and tools.

Skills & Experience
* Minimum 2+ years of teaching/training experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related fields.
* Strong programming skills in Python and understanding of SQL, Excel.
* Solid grasp of ML/DL concepts such as Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests,Ensemble methods, Neural Networks, NLP, Recommendation Systems, etc.
* Strong communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
* Comfortable with both classroom delivery and online teaching (camera-facing).
* Education: BE/ B.Tech (minimum); Postgraduate preferred.

Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate
on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual
orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.


Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.

Location: Sambhalpur, Cuttack

Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar

Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

General Admin (Facility Management RM)

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

PwC US CONSULTING SOLUTIONS - MANAGEMENT CONSULTING Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Description:
Manager - Actuarial - Business Consulting Risk
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and 'It's yours to build' which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
About Actuarial Services:
The Team advises clients in the terms of:
- Reserving
- Audit
- M&A Support
- Capital modelling
- IFRS Reporting
- Business Planning
- Reinsurance Structure and Optimization
- Regulatory Compliance and more
The opportunity:
General Insurance - Domestic & Global Market - Business Consulting Risk - Actuarial
Your key responsibilities
- The Incumbent will be responsible for executing projects in the Actuarial space
- We are looking for Actuaries with varying experience in the Indian/ Global insurance market. The job grade of the successful candidates for this role will depend on their respective qualities and experience. The typical responsibilities of the role include
- Play a proactive role within a multi-disciplinary EY team in supporting the various client engagements which may span across Reserving,
- Statutory reporting,
- Solvency assessment,
- IFRS17 implementation,
- Statutory Audit, Internal Audit & Review,
- Business planning.
- Build appropriate models for the above-mentioned projects allowing for client requirement and relevant regulations.
- Lend support on strands of research and specialisms work aimed at providing key insights to help our clients / consultants
- Develop cutting edge proposals for winning new and different clients /engagements
- Work closely with the team to develop consistent standards and best practice.
- Sharing knowledge in a timely and effective way by submitting regularly to the knowledge database
- Contribute to wider opportunities within EY and to raising its profile externally e.g. taking an active role in writing articles for The Actuary
- Develop and maintain deep technical knowledge in modelling skills
- Present internally and externally on areas of technical specialist knowledge
- Develop reports and presentations for the client
Skills and attributes for success
In addition to technical competence, what will set you up for success at EY is your ability to:
- Strong communication, documentation, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills
- Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
- Broad consulting and project management skills, effective written and oral communication skills
- Pursue passions beyond work and invest in your wellbeing
To qualify for the role you must have:
- A qualified graduate or postgraduate in Actuarial Science with minimum of 6 Qualified papers having 5+ years of experience in Actuarial GI domain.
Good technical understanding
- Reserving techniques
- Business planning and capital modeling
- IFRS 17 methodologies
- Audit
People Skills:
- Proven communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to put across complex technical issues and solutions to non-actuaries.
- Good team player and team handling skills
Desirable
- Good working knowledge of the relevant actuarial concepts and methodologies
- Working knowledge of tools like R, Python etc.

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.
AboutCompany:
Luminous Power Technologies is a leading player in energy solutions, committed to driving Indias clean energy transition with a sharp focus on innovation and sustainability. With a legacy spanning over 38 Years, Luminous has built a robust presence in the energy and residential solar space. Its wide portfolio of innovative products, including inverters, batteries, and best-in-class solar solutions that is designed to provide the end-to-end energy management ecosystem with reliability, safety, and efficiency.
As the demand for reliable, clean, and efficient power growsespecially among home consumers, as a consumer energy fulfillment company, Luminous fulfils the evolving energy needs of millions of households and businesses across the world. The company operates seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, supported by an expansive network of over 28 sales offices and 100,000 channel partners across India. Today, Luminous powers over 100 million Indian homes and is expanding its reach globally, with a presence in more than 40 international markets.

As an emerging Prosumer technology brand, the companys vision goes beyond just providing power; it's about empowering consumers. Through their flagship Connect-X app and integrated technologies, consumers get real-time insights and complete transparency over their energy ecosystems, through valuable information on energy consumption and monitoring, solar energy generation, and inverter performance.
The companys culture is a true representation of inclusion, allyship, and empowerment. Luminous remains committed to responsible business practices, demonstrated through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility programs supporting Education & Employment, Environmental conservation, and Electrification through Solar.
With a passionate team and a relentless drive to innovate, Luminous continues to set benchmarks in the energy sector. Its consistent recognition, such as five consecutive Consumer Superbrand Awards for residential power backup, underscores its trusted reputation in homes across India and beyond.
Luminous Power Technologies is more than an energy solutions company its a catalyst for a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

A Center Manager in the education and EdTech industry runs the daily operations, P&L, sales targets, and academic quality of a learning center.

Team Leadership: Hire, train, and mentor counselors, trainers, and support staff.

Experience: 3 to 10+ years in education management, coaching, EdTech, or sales.

Skills: Strong communication, team handling, local networking, and target orientation.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Position: Water Supply Design Specialist

Location: Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
Project Duration: 2 Years (Project-Based Assignment)
Qualification: M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Water Resources Engineering. Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or related discipline will be preferred.

Experience: Minimum 10 years of total professional experience with at least 8 years of relevant experience in water supply system design and preparation of DPRs for water infrastructure projects. Candidates should have hands-on experience in the design of Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) of 5 MLD and above capacity, hydraulic modelling using WaterGEMS and EPANET, and water supply projects in hilly terrain. Experience in externally aided projects will be preferred. Maximum Age: 45 Years

Purpose & Scope of Position
The Water Supply Design Specialist will be responsible for the design, hydraulic analysis, and technical evaluation of water supply infrastructure systems. The role focuses on developing efficient and sustainable water supply solutions, optimizing system performance through hydraulic modelling, and ensuring that designs meet applicable engineering standards, project requirements, and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare and review DPRs, design reports, calculations, technical specifications, BOQs, and tender documents for water supply projects.
• Carry out hydraulic modelling and network analysis using WaterGEMS and EPANET.
• Design water supply systems including intake structures, transmission mains, distribution networks, pumping stations, service reservoirs, and water treatment plants.
• Perform demand assessment, hydraulic calculations, pipe sizing, pressure analysis, and network optimization.
• Design and review Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) of 5 MLD and above capacity.
• Prepare technical drawings, design criteria, and engineering documentation for water supply infrastructure.
• Ensure compliance with CPHEEO guidelines, BIS standards, and applicable engineering practices.
• Review design submissions, technical reports, and engineering deliverables prepared by consultants and contractors.
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure integration of design inputs and project requirements.
• Provide technical support during design reviews, approvals, and implementation stages.

Required Experience and Exposure
Proven experience in the design of urban and rural water supply systems.
• Extensive experience in preparation and review of water supply DPRs and detailed engineering designs.
• Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, network analysis, and system optimization using WaterGEMS and EPANET.
• Experience in design and review of Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) with capacities of 5 MLD or higher.
• Exposure to externally aided infrastructure projects will be an advantage.
• Experience in water supply projects in hilly and mountainous regions is highly desirable.

Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
