Description:
Job Summary
Discipline - Clients & Industries. Role Type - UKI Technology & Reporting, Clients & Industries. Business unit specific description Clients & Industries GDS UKI.
The Data Insights Executive serves as a strategic enabler of data-driven decision-making and digital transformation across UKI Client & Industries team. This role is responsible for delivering business-relevant insights and innovative digital solutions by leveraging advanced analytics, Microsoft 365 tools, and Copilot capabilities. Acting as a bridge between technology and business strategy, the Data Insights executive ensures that data is transformed into actionable intelligence, fostering operational excellence and driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Deliver high-quality, data-driven insights through analytics and visualisations to support informed business decision-making.
Support digital transformation initiatives by leveraging Microsoft 365, Copilot, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
Work closely with business stakeholders and leaders to align data and digital initiatives with business priorities and regional objectives.
Communicate insights clearly and effectively through well-structured reports, dashboards, presentations, and professional stakeholder communications.
Support leadership decision-making through timely and accurate reporting, trend analysis, and actionable insights.
Design, develop, and maintain business applications using PowerApps (Canvas) to support operational and business requirements.
Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel Online, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Collaborate closely with MSM, BD, BMC, FMT, Operations, and other relevant teams to develop effective and user-centric solutions.
Support user adoption through training, documentation, knowledge sharing, and ongoing assistance.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Alteryx-based ETL workflows to strengthen data-driven reporting and decision-making
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates good proficiency in analytics platforms and visualisation tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar tools to transform data into meaningful and actionable insights.
Skilled in developing interactive dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders understand trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Applies analytical and basic statistical techniques to support business decision-making and identify opportunities for improvement.
Good project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deliverables effectively.
Presentation and facilitation skills: Ability to participate in and facilitate meetings, develop presentations, interpret data, generate meaningful business insights, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
Ownership and accountability: Ability to work independently with appropriate guidance, take ownership of assigned tasks and projects, and ensure timely delivery.
Business acumen and adaptability: Ability to understand business requirements and adapt to changing stakeholder and customer expectations.
Quick learner: Ability to quickly understand processes, project objectives, requirements, and complexities and move into delivery effectively.
Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce turnaround times, enhance quality, and generate additional insights.
Attention to detail: Maintain accuracy and consistency across data, numbers, analysis, reporting, and formatting.
Multi-tasking capability: Demonstrate effective time management, prioritization, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables.
Excellent communication: Strong listening, reading, writing, and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with business stakeholders and senior team members, with the ability to understand requirements and communicate effectively.
MS Office skills: Good to advanced proficiency in Excel reporting and PowerPoint presentations.
Power BI / Other BI tools / Alteryx: Hands-on experience in data integration, data preparation, reporting, and data visualization.
Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry having exposure working on applications and automation.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)
Demonstrate excellent stakeholder management
Experience in team management

Role #3 - Rapid Response Reporting Specialist
The Opportunity
To join a high-performing multi-national team within the Global R&DA that provides financial reporting, analytics, and insights support in response to strategic and ad hoc business requests. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders across a diverse portfolio of customers to design, develop and test reports and dashboards that support strategic initiatives and inform leadership decision-making.
What we look for
We are seeking a Senior Analyst with 10+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations, to join the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.
The successful candidate will play a key role within a small dedicated team working with stakeholders to understand business requirements and advise on the most appropriate reporting solutions.
The role involves producing reporting specifications, designing and developing reports and dashboards, managing user acceptance testing, creating user documentation and delivering demonstrations and training sessions.
The ideal candidate will:
Combine strong technical expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex business requirements into impactful reporting solutions.
Demonstrate a strong aptitude for understanding commercial financial reporting and analysis.
Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.
Be a practical and analytical problem-solver with the ability to clearly articulate approach, findings and recommendations.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Take ownership of deliverables ensuring a high standard of quality, accuracy and timeliness.
Key responsibilities
Demonstrate the confidence to ask the right questions to ensure outputs align with business requirements and stakeholder expectations.
Ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of tasks assigned to you, keeping stakeholders and colleagues informed of progress and any potential issues.
Develop a broad understanding of EYs commercial Finance reporting portfolio that can be drawn on for direction and knowledge.
Ensure all reports and dashboards are developed in accordance with established build standards, governance requirements and approved style templates.
Act as a liaison between source data providers and the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.
Stakeholder management
Act as a trusted business advisor to finance and business stakeholders.
Develop a thorough understanding of business requirements building stakeholder confidence through insightful questioning and high-quality delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular updates on priorities, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
Challenge requests constructively and in a consultative manner ensuring proposed solutions align with strategic objectives, reporting standards and best practices.
Present findings, insights, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and impactful manner tailored to the audience.
Continuous improvement
Support process improvement initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and stakeholder experience.
Document reporting processes and business logic for reporting assigned to you.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes.
Technical skill set
Demonstrate extensive experience designing, developing and maintaining complex reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Design and develop advanced SQL queries to extract, interrogate, transform and analyse large datasets to help inform on the build of new reports and dashboards.
Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, Power Query, automation and large-scale data analysis.
Interpret, troubleshoot and enhance complex reports and dashboards developed by others.
Demonstrate experience working with large and complex financial datasets.
Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent listening and communication skills.
Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
A proactive customer-focused approach with a willingness to embrace new ideas and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform.
Monitor platform health using native tools like AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor.
Collaborate with CloudOps and DevOps teams to address deployment or configuration issues.

Working knowledge of AWS and Azure core services.

Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

34 years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure support.

Scripting: Bash

Templates: CloudFormation, ARM templates
Scripting: Python

Observability: Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
Networking: VPC/VNet basics, load balancers
Certification: AWS/Azure (Associate-level preferred)

Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud technologies and DevOps practices.
Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
Detail-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.

The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.

Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.

Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring followthrough on actions and highquality execution.

Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.

Good analytical and problemsolving skills, with attention to detail.
Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering highquality outputs under tight timelines.
A clientfocused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

EY Risk Consulting Manager (Risk Analytics)

This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.

Design, develop and oversee the deployment of process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform and validate deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.

Process Mining & Analytics

Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.

Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.

Process Mining
Data Analytics

Business Intelligence
Process Improvement

And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Job Summary
Assistant / Associate Manager: Decision Modelling & Economics (DME, VME)
Key Responsibilities
Leading a team of financial modellers who are engaged in the development and review of financial models. Managing client relationship with various user offices across MENA region and actively taking part in business development initiatives of the firm.
Liaising with the onshore team and acting as a single point of contact in project execution and delivery.
Being responsible for acting as a mentor for 35 member team and responsible for their career growth within the firm.
Develop and review of financial models for purposes including strategic planning; feasibility study, capital allocation; transaction support; mergers and acquisitions; investment appraisal; financial accounting and reporting purposes.
Have an eye for detail to assess the model for its accuracy, viz, arithmetical, and logical flow of items in the model and raising the review observations to ensure quality.
Identify issues and propose strategies related to the procedures executed
Stay abreast of current business and economic developments relevant to the client's business
Managing and motivating teams of professionals with diverse skills and backgrounds and fostering a team-oriented environment
Demonstrating in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge
Maintaining long-term client relationships and networks and cultivating business development opportunities
Use current technology and tools to innovate and enhance the effectiveness of services provided and act as a leader in adopting new tools and techniques
Work in a highly regarded team, which values collaboration, respect and knowledge sharing
Work in close collaboration with other Strategy and Transaction teams and the wider firm
What we look for
You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. Were looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
You are curious and purpose driven. Were looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.
You are inclusive. Were looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
You are highly motivated. Were looking for candidates who are highly motivated, analytical, logical thinkers with a passion in providing financial solutions and have a very strong attention to detail. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients goals.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting; Masters preferred
CA / CFA / CPA preferred or MBA (preferably from a premier institute) with a good academic background
5-8 years of relevant work experience
Experience with a venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, or national accounting firm; experience in a financial modelling practice is preferred
Demonstrated aptitude in quantitative and qualitative analysis
Strong financial modelling skills
Ability to create innovative, robust and flexible financial model solutions based on clients financial and operational information to provide insight into client decisions
Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills
A strong work ethic and the ability to adapt to new challenges in a collaborative team environment
A strong desire to continually develop themselves and others
Ability to successfully manage engagements including the work of team members, client interaction, quality of service and expenditures against budget and revenue
Ability to provide best practice financial modelling guidance to team members to ensure the completion of work deliverables at the highest level of quality
Superior skills in MS Excel with VBA skills
General PC proficiency including Word, and PowerPoint
We would expect for you to be available to travel outside of your assigned office location at least 20-40% of the time, plus commute within the region to other GDS locations on a short or long-term basis, whenever required.

EY- Risk Consulting Senior Consultant (Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring Model Validation)
As part of our Risk Consulting FS team, we are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst contributing to the delivery of Risk Consulting FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences.
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant, you will engage with clients to support the validation and enhancement of sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are aligned with regulatory standards and operational requirements. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will support the validation and fine-tuning of models/tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing subject matter knowledge and supporting the implementation of solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Support sanctions screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems, anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms.
Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis to assess model design, effectiveness, performance and compliance with regulatory expectations.
Execute model testing activities including back-testing, threshold calibration, data analysis and performance assessments.
Analyse large volumes of transactional and customer data to identify trends, gaps and potential model improvements.
Assist in the development and enhancement of validation methodologies, frameworks and performance metrics.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the integration of model outputs into business processes.
Participate in model implementation reviews, fine-tuning exercises and model performance monitoring activities.
Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and model validation techniques.
Support multiple client engagements and related initiatives while ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
Good to have experience in Risk Management or other Risk Consulting engagements.
The job would require travel (Over 50%) to client locations in Middle East and North Africa such as Dubai, Kuwait, Riyadh, Doha etc.
Skills and attributes for success
Proficient in SQL and Python.
Familiarity with database management and data analysis tools.
Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project delivery.
Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) regulations and screening tools.
Understanding of sanctions screening systems, transaction monitoring platforms and model validation methodologies.
Exceptional command over spoken and written English.
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
Highly analytical, organised, and meticulous consulting skills; attention to detail and quality assurance.
Ability to work collaboratively within engagement teams and contribute effectively to project delivery.
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadlines.
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively.
Work experience in similar industry (Big 4 preferred).
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree in engineering, Finance, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience working with business consulting firms.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferably, you may also have
AML, CTF Certification (CAMS, CAFP).
Experience / certifications in Cloud Data Architecture, Data Engineering.
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

Oracle Human Capital Management Functional - Senior(Payroll, Absence and Time & Labor)
Job Summary:
We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Oracle Fusion Payroll - Functional Senior Consultant to join our team. Manage and support internal KPIs, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Should be able to interpret functional requirements and able to deliver and design it from onsite and offshore. If required, ready to travel to onsite
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll and related Oracle HCM modules like Absence and time & labor, payroll elements, balances, payroll flows, costing, retro pay, Core HR
Collaborate with clients to understand their payroll, and related HCM processes and requirements and provide recommendations for improvements and optimizations. Conduct fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design documentation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify and mitigate system risks by evaluating functional and cross-functional dependencies, proactively recommend process improvements based on best practices.
Develop and maintain project documentation using AIM / OUM / TCM / Agile or other prescribed methodologies, including functional specifications, payroll configuration workbooks, test plans, and user guides.
Drive and assist business users during Prototype/CRPs/SITs/UATs/KUTs and prepare payroll test scripts, payroll cycle test cases, costing validation scenarios and conduct trainings.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion Payroll and Human Resources, providing timely and effective support to clients.
Ensure project timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met and function as the primary functional consultant for stakeholder alignment.
Stay updated with the latest Oracle Fusion Payroll and Oracle Fusion HCM features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.
Participate in proposal development and client presentations.
Guide junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Experience:
Core experience in Payroll and Human Resource with localization knowhow and having HR/payroll domain/process knowledge is preferred.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience working in ERP HR modules (EBS /Fusion) in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Absence, Time and labor with implementation and support experience with a focus on functional consulting.
Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle EBS, and emerging ERP platforms.
In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM suite and its integration with other Oracle applications suits.
Lead the team either from the onsite and offshore, manage delivery independently.
Experience in payroll costing and integration with Manpower planning, Attendance, Time and Labour or downstream finance systems.
Familiarity with Oracle Reporting Tools (OTBI, BI Publisher), payroll reports, payroll flows and integrations using HCM Extracts.
Demonstrated expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll, payroll elements, balances, fast formulas, payroll costing, retro pay, Core HR, and Time and Labour
Knowledge of configuration workbooks, Fast Formulas, Payroll Rules, payroll elements, balances, costing, payment methods, payroll processes and payroll reporting is desirable.
Prior consulting experience in a Big Four or similar environment is an asset.
Experience in any of the major industry sectors like Retail, Government, Energy, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities and Finance & Banking
Competencies / Skills:
Strong customer handling skills and ability to lead & mentor team-members
Ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to work as part of a team
Ability to follow well defined release management processes
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Must have a valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Client site work / Business Traveling involve

Oracle Consultant - Technical - Senior
(OIC, BIP, VB Studio & AI Agents)
Summary:
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant Senior, with primary expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BI Publisher (BIP), complemented by hands-on experience in Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio) and Oracle AI Agents. The ideal candidate will have a strong Oracle Fusion Cloud technical background and proven experience delivering integrations, reporting solutions, application extensions, intelligent automation, and transformation initiatives across ERP, SCM, PROC, HCM, PPM, and IT support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including connections, adapters, orchestration, transformations, error handling, monitoring, and third-party integrations.
Develop and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports, data models, templates, bursting configurations, extracts, and enterprise payment or document formats.
Build and extend Oracle Fusion Cloud user experiences using Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), including application extensions, service connections, business objects, pages, fragments, and deployment pipelines.
Configure and develop Oracle AI Agents and supporting tools, knowledge sources, prompts, business-object interactions, BIP reports, and OIC or REST integrations to deliver secure, governed automation.
Translate functional and business requirements into scalable technical designs, specifications, integrations, reports, extensions, and AI-enabled solutions.
Deliver high-quality work across the full SDLC, including code reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, release management, production deployment, and Hypercare support.
Identify technical and delivery risks, resolve issues proactively, and escalate concerns where appropriate.
Build strong relationships with clients and internal teams while supporting Managers in meeting client commitments and internal KPIs.
Job Requirements:
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BI Publisher (BIP), supported by relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience.
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience, Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations with relevant experience developing Oracle Fusion Cloud technical solutions, including at least one end-to-end implementation or major rollout.
Extensive OIC experience covering REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, database, Oracle ERP, HCM, and SCM Cloud adapters; mappings, lookups, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and performance troubleshooting.
Strong BIP expertise covering SQL-based data models, layouts, eText and XML templates, bursting, scheduling, security, troubleshooting, and report performance optimization.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), including Fusion application extensions, web applications, service connections, business objects, dynamic pages or forms, Git repositories, build jobs, and deployment pipelines.
Experience with Oracle AI Agents or AI Agent Studio, including agent and tool configuration, prompt design, knowledge sources, business objects, documents, external REST services, BIP reports, OIC integrations, testing, security, and deployment governance.
Good understanding of Oracle Fusion modules across ERP, SCM, HCM, and Projects, with the ability to work closely with functional teams.
Proficiency in OTBI, SQL, PL/SQL, REST and SOAP web services, Oracle Cloud security, and related reporting or integration technologies.
Experience with data migration and conversion using FBDI, HDL, spreadsheet loaders, and relevant Oracle Cloud import processes.

Job Listing Detail
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. Were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The Opportunity
Were looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Offensive Security, Red Teaming, Cloudnative VAPT, and DevSecOps security assurance. Exposure to AI, ML, and GenAI security assessments is considered a desirable and goodtohave capability, as organizations increasingly adopt AIenabled technologies.
As part of our Cyber Technology Consulting practice, you will play a key role in leading and delivering offensive security services to clients across the MENA region. You will work with leading organizations across sectors including Financial Services, Government & Public Sector, Energy, Telecom, Healthcare, and Digital-native enterprises, helping them proactively identify vulnerabilities, simulate advanced adversaries, and strengthen their cyber resilience.
This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic advisory, and large-scale transformation, while contributing to the growth of our Offensive Security competency.
Your Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery And Engagement Management
Lead and deliver end-to-end offensive security engagements, including:
Network and infrastructure penetration testing
Web and mobile application security testing
API security assessments (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, microservices)
Cloud security testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP
Plan and execute red team / adversary simulation / assumed breach exercises, emulating real-world threat actors to test organizational detection and response capabilities.
Execute and oversee purple teaming engagements, enabling alignment between offensive findings and defensive improvements (SOC, detection engineering, incident response).
Conduct and lead cloud offensive security assessments and validate effectiveness of controls across all layers and workloads within AWS, Azure, and GCP, including IAM, network, storage, container, serverless, and DevSecOps pipeline components.
Assess cloud misconfigurations, identity abuse paths, privilege escalation scenarios, insecure pipeline configurations, exposed secrets, and lateral movement techniques across hybrid and cloud native environments.
Perform penetration testing and security assessments of cloud native architectures, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, container images, and CI/CD pipelines to identify weaknesses across the secure software delivery lifecycle.
Assess and validate CSPM / CNAPP controls, identifying configuration gaps, privilege escalation paths, and exposure risks in cloud-native environments.
Deliver AI/GenAI security assessments, including (Desirable / GoodtoHave):
Prompt injection and adversarial input risks
Model misuse and abuse scenarios
Data leakage and insecure integration risks
AI governance and secure deployment considerations
Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk insights, including attack paths, impact analysis, and prioritized remediation strategies.
Stakeholder Engagement And Advisory
Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, security leaders, and engineering teams, articulating security risks in a business-relevant and outcome-driven manner.
Present complex offensive security findings to both technical and executive audiences, tailoring messaging appropriately.
Support clients in developing offensive security roadmaps, maturity models, and remediation programs aligned to leading practices.
Practice And Capability Development
Contribute to building the Offensive Security practice, including:
Development of methodologies, testing playbooks, and accelerators
Creation of reusable assets and frameworks
Standardization of delivery approaches and quality benchmarks
Support go-to-market initiatives, thought leadership, and client pursuits:
RFP/RFI responses
Solution positioning and capability presentations
Market-facing content development (whitepapers, POVs)
Stay ahead of evolving threat landscape, including:
Advanced attacker techniques and exploit trends
API and cloud-native attack vectors
AI/ML security risks and emerging vulnerabilities
People Leadership And Team Development
Manage and mentor a team of consultants and senior consultants, fostering:
Deep technical capability in offensive security domains
High-quality delivery and reporting standards
Continuous learning and certification progression
Provide performance feedback, coaching, and career guidance aligned with firm values.
Build a collaborative, high-performance culture within the Offensive Security team.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong hands-on expertise in offensive security methodologies, including penetration testing, exploit development, adversary simulation, and attack path analysis.
Deep understanding of:
OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10
Authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, SSO, etc.)
Business logic vulnerabilities and modern application architectures
Proven experience in API security testing and microservices environments.
Strong working knowledge of cloud security risks, including:
Misconfigurations, IAM weaknesses, secrets exposure, lateral movement
Cloud-native architectures and shared responsibility model
Familiarity with CSPM, CNAPP, and CIEM concepts and their practical implementation.
Awareness of AI security risks, including adversarial attack techniques, prompt injection, and model governance concerns.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with attention to detail.
Ability to convert complex technical findings into clear, risk-based narratives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple engagements in parallel with strong quality and delivery discipline.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
A bachelors or masters degree in cyber security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
1014 years of experience in Cyber Security, with strong focus on Offensive Security and advanced VAPT.
Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security, SANS Top 25, and MITRE ATT&CK.
Hands-on experience delivering:
VAPT engagements across network, application, API, and cloud layers
Red team / adversary simulation exercises
Cloud security assessments
Proven experience delivering Red Team, Cloud native penetration testing, and DevSecOps security validation engagements across modern engineering environments.
Hands on experience testing AWS, Azure, or GCP environments, modern application stacks, CI/CD platforms, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code implementations.
Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment, managing clients and engagements.
Strong reporting, documentation, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to work in global and cross-cultural environments.
Willingness and flexibility to travel across the MENA region, as required.
Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, CRTO, GWAPT, GPEN, or equivalent.
Experience in:
Advanced red teaming and purple teaming engagements
API security and cloud offensive security
AI/LLM application security testing
DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline security
Container and Kubernetes security
Exposure to:
BAS tools and attack simulation platforms
EDR/XDR validation and detection engineering
Regulatory and industry frameworks relevant to MENA
What We Look For
We are looking for individuals who bring:
A growth mindset and passion for offensive security
The ability to balance deep technical expertise with business acumen
Strong client-centricity and relationship-building capability
A collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation
A commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

Support risk and control initiatives

Prepare governance materials, status packs, ad hoc analysis and trend insights, and identify recurring control issues or themes for escalation and continuous improvement.

Strong organization, collaboration, attention to detail and written communication skills are essential.
Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Risk Management, Cybersecurity, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 5 years of experience in technology risk, internal controls, IT audit, compliance, governance, project delivery or a related field.
Experience supporting RACM maintenance, risk and control assessments, control documentation, certification or remediation activities.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to organize and synthesize complex information.

What We Offer You

Job Summary
EY-Process & Controls Risk Consulting O&G Upstream Senior
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We're looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Energy sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
Assist in executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Support in performing end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Oil & Gas upstream industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firms quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree in engineering with specialisation in Oil & Gas or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA.
PMP certification holders will be preferred
Experience in Internal Audit /Risk Management with Oil & Gas upstream sector focus or working in Oil and Gas Drilling and / or Oil Field Service Companies, or Exploration & Production (E&P) Companies or working as Drilling Engineers, Rig Foreman, or in Warehousing and Logistics for Drilling Operations.
Experience leading or supporting risk-based internal audits across upstream operations, including drilling and well operations, rig management, production operations, workover activities, petroleum engineering processes, drilling materials and inventory management, supply chain and logistics, contract management, HSE compliance.
Knowledge of key upstream business and operational processes, including Exploration & Appraisal activities, Field Development Planning, Work Programs & Budgets (WP&B), Authorization for Expenditure (AFE), Petroleum Cost Recovery, Joint Venture (JV) Accounting, Cost Allocations, Affiliate and Related Party Charges, Production Allocation, Reservoir Management, and Hydrocarbon Measurement controls.
Experience evaluating operational and financial controls related to drilling campaigns, rig utilization, non-productive time (NPT), well costs, contractor performance, procurement and contracting, warehousing and drilling materials management, inventory controls, logistics operations, and production reporting.
Strong understanding of Process Safety Management (PSM), Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Well Integrity Management, Asset Integrity, Reliability Engineering, and applicable industry standards and frameworks (e.g., API, IADC, ISO 55000, OSHA PSM, IWCF/IADC well control requirements, and other upstream industry standards).
A minimum of 4 years of relevant work experience
A valid passport for travel.
Internal Audit Software Such as Teammate and ERP Exposure such as SAP, Oracle to extract reports (contracting/procurement/material management modules).

Job Summary
EY Cybersecurity Manager, Identity & Access Management (IAM)
As Manager in EY's Cybersecurity practice, you will play a key role in delivering Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across multiple client environments. We are seeking cybersecurity professionals with expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management (AM), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) such as Microsoft Entra ID, IBM Security Verify Governance, IBM Security Verify Access, Delinea Secret Server, SailPoint Identity or other leading IAM technologies.
The role involves implementing, administering, and optimizing IAM solutions that enable secure user access, enforce governance controls, manage privileged accounts, and support regulatory compliance across IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments.
The Opportunity
We are seeking cybersecurity professionals with 12+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance, Access Management, Privileged Access Management, or Cybersecurity Consulting.
The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in identity lifecycle management, role-based access controls, authentication and authorization mechanisms, privileged account governance, and IAM operational processes.
Key Responsibilities Identity Governance & Administration
Implement and administer IGA solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Saviynt, IBM, SailPoint Identity and Oracle Identity Governance.
Configure identity lifecycle management processes, including joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, and access certification campaigns.
Design and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models.
Support Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and policy enforcement.
Perform access reviews, user entitlement analysis, and compliance reporting.
Integrate governance workflows with enterprise applications and directories.
Support audit and regulatory compliance requirements.
Access Management & Federation
Deploy and administer access management platforms such as IBM Security Verify Access, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or Ping Identity.
Configure authentication and authorization policies for enterprise applications.
Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and adaptive access controls.
Support federation technologies including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and WS-Federation.
Integrate applications with centralized authentication platforms.
Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, and federation-related issues.
Support secure remote access and external identity integrations.
Participate in access management modernization and transformation initiatives.
Privileged Access Management
Administer Delinea Secret Server platforms for privileged credential management.
Manage privileged account onboarding, credential vaulting, and password rotation.
Configure privileged session management and privileged access workflows.
Support discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, applications, and network devices.
Implement least-privilege principles and privileged-access governance controls.
Monitor privileged account activities and support audit requirements.
Assist in remediation of privileged-access risks and compliance findings.
Support PAM integrations with enterprise identity systems.
OT Privileged Access Management
Support PAM implementation across Operational Technology and industrial environments.
Secure privileged access to OT assets, systems, and administrative accounts.
Enforce access governance controls for critical OT infrastructure.
Support compliance and operational requirements while maintaining security controls.
Collaborate with OT engineering and security teams during onboarding and implementation activities.
IAM Operations & Security Governance
Support IAM operational activities across multiple client environments.
Participate in identity governance, compliance, audit, and risk management initiatives.
Develop and maintain IAM operational procedures, standards, and documentation.
Conduct entitlement reviews, access risk assessments, and remediation activities.
Support security incidents involving identity and access misuse.
Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
Participate in IAM transformation, cloud identity, and Zero Trust initiatives.
Contribute to process improvement and automation efforts.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Access Management, and Privileged Access Management concepts.
Knowledge of authentication, authorization, federation, and access-control technologies.
Experience with RBAC, SoD, access certification, and identity lifecycle management.
Familiarity with Zero Trust and Identity-Centric Security principles.
Understanding of Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise identity architectures.
Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting IAM.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility-the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.
Responsibilities Strategic Operations
Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.
Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.
Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.
Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.
Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.
Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.
Operational Excellence
Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.
Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.
Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.
Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

Fluent English speaker

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY - Manager Cyber Security OT Cybersecurity
Core Skills: OT Security, ICS/SCADA, Dragos, Nozomi, OT Risk Assessment, Industrial Cyber Resilience
The Opportunity
As part of our Cyber Technology Consulting practice, you will lead and deliver Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity engagements across clients in the MENA region, particularly within Energy, Oil & Gas, Utilities, and Smart City ecosystems.
You will work with some of the regions most critical infrastructure operators to assess, design, and enhance their OT security posture, ensuring resilience against evolving cyber threats targeting industrial environments. The role provides the opportunity to operate at the intersection of industrial operations, cybersecurity, and digital transformation, while contributing to the growth of our OT Security competency
Your Key Responsibilities Client Delivery & Engagement Management
Lead and deliver OT cybersecurity engagements, including:
OT risk assessments and maturity assessments
Architecture and network segmentation reviews
Security posture evaluations across SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, and ICS environments
Perform OT-focused vulnerability assessments and exposure analysis in coordination with engineering and operations teams.
Implement and operationalize OT monitoring solutions including:
Dragos Platform
Nozomi Networks Guardian / Vantage
Design and validate OT detection and response capabilities, leveraging network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, and threat intelligence.
Conduct industrial threat modeling and risk quantification aligned to operational impact, safety, and business continuity considerations.
Develop OT cybersecurity roadmaps and transformation programs, aligned with frameworks such as:
IEC 62443
NIST SP 800-82
NCA (KSA) / regional regulatory frameworks
Support implementation of:
OT network segmentation (zones & conduits)
Secure remote access for vendors and operators
OT-specific incident response and crisis management playbooks
Sector-Specific Advisory
Apply deep understanding of industrial processes and control systems across:
Energy and Power Generation
Oil & Gas (Upstream, Midstream, Downstream)
Utilities (Water, Electricity Distribution, Smart Grids)
Smart Cities and Critical Infrastructure ecosystems
Align OT security recommendations with operational priorities such as safety, availability, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
Bridge the gap between engineering, operations, and IT/security teams, ensuring practical and implementable solutions.
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory
Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, Plant Managers, OT Engineers, and Executive Leadership.
Translate complex technical issues into business, safety, and operational risk impacts.
Deliver executive-level briefings and technical deep-dives, tailored to diverse stakeholder groups.
Facilitate workshops, tabletop exercises, and scenario-based discussions for OT resilience.
Practice & Capability Development
Contribute to the growth of the OT Cybersecurity practice, including:
Development of methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators
Standardization of OT assessment frameworks and delivery artifacts
Support business development activities, including:
RFP/RFI responses
Client presentations and solution articulation
Thought leadership in OT cybersecurity and industrial resilience
Stay current with:
Emerging OT threats and attack campaigns
ICS vulnerabilities and adversary tactics
Evolving regulatory requirements across the MENA region
People Leadership & Team Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of OT security consultants and specialists.
Build cross-functional capability across OT, IT, and cyber domains.
Drive a culture of technical excellence, safety awareness, and delivery quality.
Provide structured feedback, coaching, and career development aligned to firm objectives.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong understanding of OT/ICS cybersecurity principles, including security challenges unique to industrial environments.
Hands-on experience with OT security platforms, especially:
Dragos
Nozomi Networks
Deep knowledge of:
Industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC-UA, PROFINET, IEC 61850)
OT asset visibility, anomaly detection, and network monitoring
Experience in installation, commissioning, FAT, and SAT of ICS systems like DCS, PLC, SCADA, and Network Devices in ICS Security related Projects
Proven capability in conducting OT risk assessments

Job Title
Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
Job Summary
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilitiesLearning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management

EY Cyber Security Manager Data Protection and Privacy Platforms Engineering
Job Listing Detail
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. Were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The Opportunity
Were looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Data Protection and Privacy Platforms Engineering. This role is centered on the implementation, engineering, integration, and administration of enterprise scale data protection and privacy technologies, helping organizations protect sensitive data across endpoints, networks, cloud, applications, and AI enabled platforms.
You will work closely with clients to design and operationalize Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data discovery and classification, privacy management platforms, and privacy enhancing technologies (PETs)enabling compliant, secure, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven environments.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and engineering of enterprise data protection and privacy platforms, including DLP, data discovery, classification, and privacy tooling.
Implement and administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions across endpoint, email, network, cloud, and SaaS environments.
Design and operationalize data discovery and data classification programs, enabling visibility into sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources.
Engineer and integrate privacy platforms supporting consent management, data subject rights (DSR/DSAR), records of processing, and privacy workflows.
Implement and support Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs) such as tokenization, pseudonymization, anonymization, encryption, and data masking.
Integrate data protection and privacy platforms with cloud, data, and AI ecosystems, including data lakes, analytics platforms, and AI/ML pipelines.
Manage Microsoft Purview Information Protection (Labeling) for data classification, sensitivity labeling, and policy enforcement
Configure and manage policy driven controls aligned with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, regional privacy laws) and organizational data governance standards.
Conduct platform configuration reviews, tuning, and optimization to improve effectiveness and reduce false positives.
Support incident response and investigations related to data leakage, privacy breaches, and policy violations.
Collaborate with security architecture, cloud, data, legal, and compliance teams to ensure end to end data protection.
Develop operational runbooks, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures for privacy and data protection platforms.
Mentor and guide junior engineers and consultants, fostering strong engineering and operational discipline.
Engage with client stakeholders to translate privacy and data protection requirements into practical, implementable technical solutions.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong hands on experience in data protection and privacy platforms engineering.
Deep understanding of data discovery, data classification, and data lifecycle controls.
Strong knowledge of DLP architectures and policy design across endpoint, cloud, and SaaS.
Experience implementing privacy enhancing technologies (PETs) and data security controls.
Ability to work across cloud, data, and AI environments, supporting secure data usage.
Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills in complex, enterprise environments.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, privacy officers, and business stakeholders.
Consulting mindset with the ability to manage multiple client engagements and priorities.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
1014 years of experience in Information Security, with strong focus on Data Protection, Privacy Engineering, or Platform Implementation.
Hands on experience implementing and administering DLP solutions (endpoint, email, cloud, network).
Experience with data discovery and classification technologies across structured and unstructured data.
Practical experience with privacy platforms supporting DSAR/DSR, consent, and privacy workflows.
Strong understanding of data protection controls such as encryption, key management, tokenization, and masking.
Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments.
Relevant certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, or equivalent are an advantage.
Ideally, Youll Also Have
Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment.
Exposure to AI and analytics platforms, with focus on protecting sensitive training and inference data.
Familiarity with global privacy regulations and how they translate into technical controls.
Experience integrating privacy and data protection platforms with SIEM/SOAR or SOC processes.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted client relationships.
A proactive, hands on approach to solving complex data protection challenges.
What We Look For
Professionals with a strong engineering and implementation mindset, not just advisory knowledge.
Ability to lead data protection and privacy platform delivery for complex enterprise clients.
Comfort engaging with CISOs, DPOs, Legal, Data, and Cloud teams.
Experience in RFP responses, solution design, effort estimation, and go to market activities is a plus.
Passion for enabling secure, compliant, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven organizations.

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. A qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience is mandatory. The role requires extensive hands-on implementation and leadership experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation. The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, finance stakeholder workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Project Financials implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Provide hands-on functional leadership across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
Design project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
Lead cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close solution design.
Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder sign-offs.
Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
Manage integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and senior stakeholder communication.
Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating with finance, technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
Qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting is mandatory.
Strong implementation and support experience across Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation.
Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
Proven experience leading Project Financials workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM and EPM.
Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting, financial control and team leadership skills.
Ability to lead Project Financials workstreams independently, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional designs.
Excellent organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
Ability to drive delivery governance, quality reviews, release priorities and team development.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Education
Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.
