Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.
Experience
Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings
Education
CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline Design for Technology
Role Type Visual Design
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As an Associate - Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Stay up to date with latest design trends, socialize the same to peers
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
1-4 years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Opportunity
As part of our Cyber Technology Consulting practice, you will lead and deliver Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity engagements across clients in the MENA region, particularly within Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, and Smart City ecosystems.
You will work with some of the region s most critical infrastructure operators to assess, design, and enhance their OT security posture, ensuring resilience against evolving cyber threats targeting industrial environments. The role provides the opportunity to operate at the intersection of industrial operations, cybersecurity, and digital transformation, while contributing to the growth of our OT Security competency
Your Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery Engagement Management
Lead and deliver OT cybersecurity engagements , including:
OT risk assessments and maturity assessments
Architecture and network segmentation reviews
Security posture evaluations across SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, and ICS environments
Perform OT-focused vulnerability assessments and exposure analysis in coordination with engineering and operations teams.
Implement and operationalize OT monitoring solutions including:
Dragos Platform
Nozomi Networks Guardian / Vantage
Design and validate OT detection and response capabilities , leveraging network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, and threat intelligence.
Conduct industrial threat modeling and risk quantification aligned to operational impact, safety, and business continuity considerations.

NIST SP 800-82
NCA (KSA) / regional regulatory frameworks

Secure remote access for vendors and operators
OT-specific incident response and crisis management playbooks

Oil Gas (Upstream, Midstream, Downstream)
Utilities (Water, Electricity Distribution, Smart Grids)
Smart Cities and Critical Infrastructure ecosystems
Align OT security recommendations with operational priorities such as safety, availability, reliability, and regulatory compliance .
Bridge the gap between engineering, operations, and IT/security teams , ensuring practical and implementable solutions.

Standardization of OT assessment frameworks and delivery artifacts
Support business development activities , including:

Client presentations and solution articulation
Thought leadership in OT cybersecurity and industrial resilience
Stay current with:
Emerging OT threats and attack campaigns
ICS vulnerabilities and adversary tactics
Evolving regulatory requirements across the MENA region

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of OT security consultants and specialists .
Build cross-functional capability across OT, IT, and cyber domains.
Drive a culture of technical excellence, safety awareness, and delivery quality .

Strong understanding of OT/ICS cybersecurity principles , including security challenges unique to industrial environments.
Hands-on experience with OT security platforms , especially:
Dragos
Nozomi Networks
Deep knowledge of:
Industrial communication protocols ( Modbus, DNP3, OPC-UA, PROFINET, IEC 61850 )
OT asset visibility, anomaly detection, and network monitoring
Experience in installation, commissioning, FAT, and SAT of ICS systems like DCS, PLC, SCADA, and Network Devices in ICS Security related Projects.
Proven capability in conducting OT risk assessments , including:
Threat modeling
Risk quantification
Control gap analysis
Strong understanding of industrial processes and operational workflows across Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, or Smart City environments.
Familiarity with IT/OT convergence risks , segmentation strategies, and secure architecture design.
Ability to communicate complex technical findings in a clear, business-impact context .
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing large, multi-stream client engagements .

OT security assessments and architecture reviews
Deployment or use of Dragos and/or Nozomi platforms
OT risk and maturity assessments
Experience working with clients in Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, or Smart Infrastructure sectors .

Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Willingness to travel across the MENA region , as required.

Certifications such as:
GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional)
ISA/IEC 62443 certifications
SANS ICS (GRID, ICS410, ICS515)
CISSP / CISM (added advantage)
Experience in:
OT incident response and forensic investigations
Industrial SOC / OT SOC design and implementation
Smart City cybersecurity architecture
Integration of OT with enterprise security tools (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)

Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, Tenable.ot, Forescout etc.

Application Vulnerability Compliance SME
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Application Compliance SME to drive vulnerability, patching, and lifecycle compliance across enterprise application technologies hosted on Windows and Linux environments.
This is not a hands-on application installation, configuration, or administration role. The SME will focus on identifying compliance risks, coordinating remediation with application and platform owners, driving patch and upgrade programs, improving visibility through automation, and ensuring vulnerabilities and End-of-Life/End-of-Support components are remediated within defined timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Own and coordinate application vulnerability and patch compliance activities across web, middleware, runtime, and application components.
Assess environments to identify technologies such as Microsoft IIS, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, NGINX, PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, .NET/ASP.NET, and related application components.
Review installed versions and inventories to identify:
Security vulnerabilities
Missing patches or security updates
End-of-Life (EOL) and End-of-Support (EOS) components
Unsupported or obsolete software versions
Components requiring upgrade or modernization
Analyze vulnerability findings, vendor advisories, CVEs, severity ratings, product applicability, and available remediation options to determine the appropriate compliance action.
Coordinate remediation with application owners, platform teams, infrastructure teams, and security teams, ensuring clear ownership and tracking through closure.
Drive application owners to assess application compatibility and dependencies before upgrades to PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, Tomcat, .NET, web servers, and other application components.
Define and maintain remediation plans, priorities, target dates, exceptions, dependencies, and risk tracking for outstanding vulnerabilities.
Coordinate patching and upgrade campaigns for application technologies without directly performing application installation, configuration, or production changes.
Develop and implement automation for vulnerability identification, inventory validation, compliance tracking, reporting, and remediation coordination using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash/Shell, or other automation platforms.
Correlate information from vulnerability management, software inventory, patching, CMDB, and application ownership data sources to improve accuracy and identify compliance gaps.
Track application components against vendor-supported versions and proactively identify technologies approaching EOL/EOS.
Support risk assessment and exception management where remediation cannot be completed within required timelines.
Monitor remediation progress and produce compliance dashboards, metrics, ageing reports, risk summaries, and leadership updates.
Identify recurring compliance gaps and recommend opportunities for automation, standardization, process improvement, and preventive controls.
Maintain application technology inventories, compliance standards, remediation procedures, and supporting documentation.
Support Incident, Change, Problem, Risk, and Vulnerability Management processes where application compliance is impacted.
Act as the SME and coordination point between Security, Infrastructure, Platform, and Application teams for application technology vulnerabilities and lifecycle compliance.
Core Technical Knowledge
The candidate should have strong working knowledge of:
Web and application platforms
Microsoft IIS
Apache HTTP Server
Apache Tomcat
NGINX
Application runtimes and frameworks
PHP
Node.js
Java/JDK
.NET / ASP.NET
Operating environments
Windows Server
Linux / RHEL
Vulnerability and lifecycle management
CVE and CVSS interpretation
Vendor security advisories
Patch and vulnerability assessment
EOL/EOS identification
Application dependency and compatibility assessment
Risk and exception management
Remediation tracking and compliance reporting
Automation and data analysis
PowerShell
Bash/Shell scripting
Automated inventory and compliance validation
Data correlation and reporting
Working knowledge of deployment and application delivery technologies such as Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines from a compliance and vulnerability management perspective, rather than as a deployment administrator.
Role Boundary
This is a governance, coordination, compliance, and automation-focused role. The Application Compliance SME will not be responsible for the routine installation, configuration, administration, or direct production implementation of application components. Remediation changes will be executed by the respective Application, Platform, or Infrastructure teams, while the SME will identify risk, define compliance requirements, coordinate remediation, track progress, automate compliance activities, and validate closure.
Preferred Profile
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Application Compliance, Vulnerability Management, Web Services, Middleware, or Application Platforms, with sufficient technical depth to understand application technology stacks, versions, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and lifecycle risks.
The candidate should be capable of analyzing technical findings and translating them into clear remediation requirements for application and platform owners, while coordinating remediation through completion.
The individual should be comfortable working across Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Platform teams, challenging unresolved risks, tracking remediation commitments, and providing clear compliance status to stakeholders and leadership.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY_ Consulting _ RISK Internal Audit - Manager_Healthcare
As part of our Consulting Risk Internal Audit team, our clients look for EY s expertise across the Consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404 and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals.
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you re working with, you ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
The opportunity
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. Youll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, youll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
Your key responsibilities
Market, Leadership and Growth
Executive-level skills in client relationship management and the ability to hold conversations with senior management executives.
Partnering with onshore teams to understand client s business related industry issues / trends and conduct Internal audits and internal control engagements for global clients.
Market Leadership
Participate in key business development efforts
Support the practice in building the Healthcare Sector - Specifically focusing on Healthcare - Providers and Payers (including third party insurance) experience within the Enterprise Risk Team.
Support multiple innovation initiatives to enhance existing solutions leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics
Collaborating with colleagues across multiple service lines, sharing your knowledge and experience to guide business decisions.
Monitoring industry news, tools and trends while suggesting potential risks, as well as opportunities to improve the way we work.
Collaborating with global Sector leads/ teams across the regions to help grow the Healthcare Sector Accounts across solutions
Opportunity of active participation in Healthcare Sector pursuits to bring in/ display the sector skillset within the team/ solutions/ enablers to bring the differentiation to the pursuit.
Support in building strategy around growing EYs and GDS footprint in the Healthcare Sector space, increasing GDS integration on the accounts.
Quality delivery
Independently manage client assignments with minimal supervision
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests.
Constantly monitor project progress, manage risk and verify key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving while executing client engagements and documenting working papers.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate on a timely basis.
Identify process gaps and accordingly provide recommendation in areas requiring improvement based on the clients business process and industry practice.
Operational Excellence
Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
Highly analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, or similar work experience in similar industry, Big 4 preferred)
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis validation
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.
To qualify for the role, you must have
More than 8 years of a Big 4 or professional firm or professional industry experience in risk , internal audit, internal controls
Specialization in handling engagements in the Healthcare Sector across the entire value chain.
Should have healthcare experience in
Providers: the ecosystem of providers which include hospitals, physician offices, academic medical centers, specialty care centers, urgent care, community and social care organizations, retail providers, home health care, digital health companies and virtual care platforms.
Payers: The payer for healthcare services may be a government or a health insurance company or a blend.
Experience of building/ implementing sector focused solutions for clients operating in the Healthcare Sector
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar).
Strong multi-project management skills.
Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor.
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to think differently and innovate
Ideally, you ll also have
Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
Run sector focused upskilling programs to train the team on latest solutions/ technologies in the Healthcare Sector
Support in build new sector focused solutions in collaboration with the Global sector teams/ GDS sector leads to enhance the GDS Play in the Healthcare Sector
Lead delivery of key big sector accounts to ensure display of sector depth and knowledge to onshore, stabilizing the GDS play in the account.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate - Senior Document Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications). You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.


Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and produce collaterals such as placemats, infographics, presentations, proposals, newsletters, posters, banners, and other marketing collaterals using MS-based applications
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique, innovative, and effective solutions/design concepts to customers
Meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Adhere to EY brand standards and remain cognizant of visual as well as verbal guidelines
Mentor junior team members on best practices around applying creativity in production environment
Stay up-to-date with latest design trends, socialize, and advocate the same to teams/customers
Seamlessly manage multiple creative projects simultaneously
Work with minimal supervision and guidance


Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree/College diploma (preferably in Graphic Design and/or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
5+ years of relevant experience


Ideally, you ll also have
Intermediate/basic knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Interactive PDF, Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics
Team management experience


Technologies and Tools
Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop


What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

Job Summary
SAP CPI Senior 1,2 TechOps (Application Management) Consultant
We are looking for an SAP CPI Senior to join the EY GDS - SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and optimization of our SAP CPI solutions in alignment with our business objectives in a multi-region environment. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize applications to deliver seamless global operations support to global clients.


Responsibilities
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests as Level 2 Application Management Specialist
Provide level 2 support for SAP CPI/PIPO development activities including customizations, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple SAP environments troubleshooting and resolving issues related to customer CPI developments and SAP System Performance
Collaborate with functional consultants to gather requirements for incidents, enhancements and problems and translate them into technical solutions
Perform Debugging and Testing to ensure the quality of CPI/PI/PO developments
Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing and production deployment of CPI/PI/PO objects
Document technical specifications, code changes and implementation details for knowledge sharing and future reference
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
Minimum of 5-7 years working experience in SAP CPI/PI/PO development with a focus on level 2 support
Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures.
Sound experience in Design and implement complex, end-to-end integration scenarios using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Event Mesh).
Upto 3 years of SAP PI/PO/CPI experience participation as a lead person responsible for integration design and implementation in at least two full-cycle SAP projects or roll-outs
Strong skills in SAP PI/PO/CPI Design, Configuration, and Administration
Good hands-on knowledge of Java, XSLT Mapping, Java mapping, Groovy Scripts Support integration projects through various phases from gathering business requirements to go-live and post-implementation support
Good Understanding of Business processes and Create and maintain end-to-end functional designs for interfaces
Suggest improvements to current operational procedures within integration environment good knowledge of integration technologies and specific SAP Integration architecture
Strong Knowledge of using IDOC, RFC, JDBC, File, ABAP Proxy, SOAP, HTTP, REST, SFTP, SuccessFactors
Knowledge of SAP BPM/BRM Design, Build, Monitoring and troubleshooting
Strong Knowledge of SAP Cloud Platform services like CPI-DS, SDI, Open Connectors, Persistence
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with good attention to detail
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate

PROJECT MANAGER - PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl (EPC Project)

Company: Mayasheel Ventures Limited
Location: Aizawl, Mizoram (site-based)
Industry: Construction / EPC - Commercial Retail

About the Project:
Mayasheel Ventures Limited is the EPC contractor for PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl, a commercial mall project being executed for HITES (HLL Infra Tech Services, a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited). The project covers full civil and MEP execution - including electrical, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing, lifts and allied services - delivered under detailed technical specifications, approved-makes and a consultant/client approval regime.

Role and Responsibilities:
- Lead overall site execution of the project: plan, coordinate and monitor civil and MEP works to meet project schedule, quality standards and contract specifications.
- Act as the primary point of contact with the client (HITES) and consultants: obtain approvals on shop drawings, materials/makes, deviations, and technical submissions in line with the contract's approved-makes and specification regime.
- Manage procurement and vendor coordination: float enquiries against BOQ, evaluate vendor quotations, follow up on material deliveries, and ensure ordered items match approved makes and specifications.
- Maintain drawing and BOQ discipline on site: work from the latest approved drawings and BOQs, flag mismatches between drawings, BOQ quantities and site conditions, and escalate variations for client approval before execution.
- Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor running bills and measurements; maintain documentation for billing, approvals and correspondence.
- Manage and mentor the site team (engineers, supervisors, surveyor/billing staff); allocate work, review daily progress and resolve site-level technical issues.
- Track project schedule, prepare progress reports, and coordinate sequencing between civil, electrical, HVAC, firefighting and other services to avoid rework.
- Ensure quality checks and safety practices on site in accordance with contract specifications and statutory requirements.
- Handle site logistics and planning in the Aizawl context, including material movement on hill roads, monsoon-impacted scheduling and remote-site resource planning.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
- B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institute.
- 10+ years of experience in execution of commercial building projects (malls, hotels, hospitals or institutional buildings), with at least 3-5 years in a Project Manager or senior site leadership role on EPC projects.
- Strong working knowledge of both civil and MEP execution: electrical distribution, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing and building services coordination.
- Experience working under client/consultant approval systems - shop drawings, material approvals, approved-makes compliance, deviation approvals and specification-driven execution.
- Good command over BOQs, rate analysis, measurement/billing certification and vendor/sub-contractor management.
- Proficient in reading drawings (civil and services), MS Office/Excel; exposure to project scheduling tools preferred.
- Strong communication and coordination skills for client, consultant, vendor and team management.
- Willingness to be based full-time at the Aizawl site; prior experience of working in remote or difficult-terrain project locations will be an advantage.

Perks and Benefits:
- Accommodation provided by the company.
- Fooding (meals) provided by the company.
- Other benefits as per company policy.
AboutCompany: Mayasheel Ventures Limited is an established engineering and construction company with a presence in the infrastructure sector since 2008. The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

Description:
Title Counsellor - Opioid Substitution Therapy (OST)
Location: YRG MERF Integrated Care Clinic, Aizawl, Mizoram
Organisation: YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)


Job Summary

Key Responsibilities
A. OST counselling (as per NACO OST guidelines) - Pre-induction counselling: assess readiness, explain OST, its benefits and limits, and obtain informed consent for treatment.
Ongoing counselling on adherence, dose-related concerns, craving, relapse prevention and lifestyle change.
Counselling on take-home doses, safe storage and responsible use, where applicable.
Risk-reduction counselling on HIV, hepatitis B and C, STIs and TB; promote safe injecting practices and overdose prevention.
Referral and follow-up for HIV testing (ICTC), ART, hepatitis care, TB (NTEP), mental health and de-addiction services; confirm that referrals are completed.
Family and partner counselling, and support groups for clients and caregivers, with the clients consent.
Use the monthly irregular / pre-LFU list to follow up clients by phone and through the linked IDU Targeted Intervention; document tracking outcomes.
Maintain counselling records and update registers and SOCH/MIS entries on time.
Uphold confidentiality and the rights of clients under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017.
Young people on OST - Offer youth-friendly, non-judgemental counselling suited to young adults who are new to treatment.
Address issues common to this group - family conflict, peer pressure, education and livelihood, relationships, sexual health and mental health.
Work with outreach staff and peer educators to bring in and retain young clients.
Open trial functions - Complete Good Clinical Practice (GCP) / Human Subjects Protection training before taking up any study task.
Explain the study to eligible clients in plain Mizo or English and support the informed consent process as set out in the protocol.
Deliver counselling sessions exactly as specified in the study manual; record each session on the fidelity checklist.
Administer study questionnaires and complete case report forms accurately and on schedule.
Support participant retention - appointment reminders, tracing of missed visits and follow-up as per the protocol.
Report adverse events, protocol deviations and client distress to the Medical Officer and Study Coordinator without delay.
Keep study participants data confidential and stored as per the studys data management plan.
Protecting study integrity (no contamination) - Use study materials, messages and tools only with enrolled study participants and only as the protocol allows.
Do not share study content with non-study clients, other staff, peer workers or outside organisations.
Keep study counselling and routine OST counselling clearly separate in records and in practice.
Raise any doubt about what may or may not be shared with the Study Coordinator before acting.
Team and reporting - Take part in daily clinic huddles, weekly case reviews and study team meetings.
Submit monthly counselling and study activity reports.
Carry out any other task assigned by the clinic in-charge in line with the programme.


Requirements
Essential (in line with NACO norms for NACP counsellors) - Either: Postgraduate degree in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Human Development or Nursing, with at least 1 year of counselling experience in the health sector; Or: Graduate degree in the same disciplines, with at least 3 years of counselling experience in the health sector.
Fluency in Mizo (spoken and written) and working knowledge of English.
Basic computer skills - MS Office, email and data entry.
Desirable - Experience of counselling at an OST centre, IDU Targeted Intervention, de-addiction or harm reduction setting.
Experience of working with young people. Prior experience in a research study; GCP certification. NACO / SACS counsellor training.
Candidates from the community of people who use drugs or people living with HIV who meet the criteria are encouraged to apply.


Personal Attributes
Non-judgemental, empathetic and comfortable working with people who use drugs.
Disciplined in following protocols and keeping accurate records.
Trustworthy with confidential information.
Able to work in a team and with flexible hours when the clinic needs it.

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Mayasheel Ventures Limited is an established engineering and construction company with a presence in the infrastructure sector since 2008. The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
About the company

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising
the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to
mid-market to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel
over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price
point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (1000–1500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (1500–3000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10
across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the companys strategic vision of
democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure
highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing
the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect
balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities
1) Operational Excellence Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to
brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service
quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners
to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and
timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery
mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the
assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures
before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed
properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to
achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your
portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the
segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

What Are We Looking For
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and
business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Responsiblefor evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digitalchannels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYCverification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieveseamless, paperless disbursements.

Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications,rework, and smooth disbursement.
Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approvedcases and provide feedback to improve filters.
Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatoryrequirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations PDs ofspecific cases.
Skills Required:
Strong analyticaland decision-making skills.
Knowledge ofretail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency indigital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention todetail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

What you ll do:
Lead and manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of both MV Switchgear portfolios.

- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.

- Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.

To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Description:
FACTORY HEAD

Role Purpose
The Factory Head will have full responsibility for the Cuddalore (Tamil Nadu) manufacturing facility, leading all plant operations to deliver safe, compliant, cost-effective and quality production from continuous extraction processes. The role owns plant P&L-linked targets, people leadership and statutory compliance, and drives operational excellence and capacity growth.
Key Responsibilities
Plant Operations & Production
Lead end-to-end plant operations: production, maintenance, utilities, quality, warehouse and dispatch.
Ensure uninterrupted, optimised running of continuous extraction processes to meet production plans, yield and throughput targets.
Drive process optimisation, debottlenecking and capacity enhancement; reduce solvent losses, energy and conversion costs.
Quality, Safety, Health & Environment
Build and sustain a strong safety culture; ensure zero-incident operations, with particular attention to solvent handling, pressure systems and process safety.
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, Pollution Control Board norms, hazardous chemicals rules and all applicable statutory and environmental regulations.
Maintain quality systems and ensure adherence to product specifications, customer requirements and audit readiness (ISO and other certifications).
Cost, Budget & Performance
Prepare and manage the plant budget; control manufacturing cost, raw material consumption and inventory.
Track and review KPIs: yield, OEE, downtime, cost per unit, safety and quality metrics.
Projects & Technology
Lead expansion, debottlenecking and new-process commissioning projects from planning through stabilisation.
Work with R&D, technical and corporate teams on scale-up, technology transfer and continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TPM).
People & Stakeholder Management
Lead, mentor and develop the plant leadership team and workforce; build succession depth.
Maintain cordial industrial relations and engagement with employees, contractors, unions (if any), local authorities and the community.
Coordinate with Corporate, Supply Chain, Sales and Procurement to align plant output with business needs.
Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering (mandatory). M.Tech or MBA is an added advantage.
Experience
Around 20 years of experience in chemical process industries, with a significant tenure as Plant Head / Factory Head / Site Head.
Hands-on experience in extraction processes and in continuous process manufacturing.
Industry background restricted to Agrochemicals or Extraction industries. Candidates from other sectors will not be considered.
Skills & Competencies
Strong command of process engineering, plant operations and troubleshooting in continuous extraction.
Proven track record in process safety, statutory compliance and environmental management.
Experience in capex projects, expansion and commissioning.
Cost and P&L orientation, with strong analytical and decision-making ability.
Leadership, team building and stakeholder management at senior level.
