Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).
Peripheral Drivers: Develop and maintain low-level drivers and Board Support Packages (BSP) for timers, ADC/DAC, DMA, GPIO, and external Flash/EEPROM.
Wired Protocols: Implement, configure, and troubleshoot wired serial and fieldbus interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN / RS-485.
Hardware Bring-Up: Lab Debugging: Bring up prototype boards and troubleshoot firmware-hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.

Communication Interfaces: Direct experience configuring and debugging wired buses: UART/USART, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic
tools (logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes).

Bachelor degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE),
Electrical & Electronics Engineering, (EEE),
Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.

Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.

Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners

Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Kindly Note : We are considering candidates who can relocate to the below mentioned locations
Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai
Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas)
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies - Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures - Inspection Optimization - Piping Circutization/TML development - API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals - In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment - Knowledge of materials and standards - Knowledge of corrosion & welding - Knowledge of NDTs -Thickness inspection management and analysis- Corrosion management and analysis- Inspection plan development/ optimization.- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) - Ability to lead teams - Excellent communication
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Job Purpose:
We are looking for a skilled Fabrication Supervisor to lead and oversee day-to-day fabrication and manufacturing activities. Key Responsibilities:

Production & Fabrication Management
Supervise sheet metal fabrication processes including cutting, bending, forming, welding, and assembly.
Ensure smooth operation of MIG welding equipment, press brake machines, and other fabrication tools.
Plan and allocate daily production targets and manpower based on manufacturing priorities.
Monitor production progress and ensure timely completion of work orders.
Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication specifications, and dimensional requirements.
Coordinate with Production Planning, Quality, and Maintenance teams to ensure uninterrupted workflow.

Team & Workforce Management
Assign tasks to welders, fabricators, machine operators, and support staff.
Train and mentor shop-floor personnel to improve productivity, quality, and workmanship.
Monitor attendance, discipline, performance, and manpower utilization.
Resolve daily operational challenges and ensure adequate workforce availability.
Foster teamwork, accountability, and adherence to production schedules.

Machine Operations & Maintenance
Ensure safe and efficient operation of MIG welding machines, press brake machines, and fabrication equipment.
Monitor machine performance, tooling conditions, and process parameters.
Coordinate preventive maintenance activities and report equipment breakdowns promptly.
Support proper machine setup, tool selection, and process optimization.
Minimize equipment downtime and maintain production continuity.

Quality Assurance
Ensure fabricated components meet engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
Conduct routine inspections of weld quality, bends, dimensions, and finished products.
Identify and troubleshoot fabrication defects, dimensional deviations, and welding issues.
Collaborate with the Quality team on inspections and corrective actions.
Drive initiatives to reduce rework, rejection, and material wastage.

Safety & 5S Compliance
Enforce safety regulations and ensure proper use of PPE across the fabrication shop.
Promote safe operation of welding equipment, press brakes, and material handling systems.
Maintain workplace cleanliness through effective 5S and housekeeping practices.
Identify unsafe conditions and implement corrective and preventive measures.
Ensure compliance with company safety standards and statutory requirements.

Desired Candidate Profile

Education:
Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:
2 to 4 years of experience in sheet metal fabrication, welding, and manufacturing operations.
Experience in supervising fabrication teams in a production environment.
Hands-on exposure to MIG welding, press brake operations, and metal fabrication processes.
Prior experience as a Fabrication Supervisor, Production Supervisor, Shop Floor Supervisor, or Team Leader will be an advantage.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

During the financial year 2018-19, Axis Max Life achieved ‘Gross Written Premium’ of Rs. 14,575 crore & had sum assured in force of Rs. 7,03,972 Crore. As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
What does an Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as a leader and the master of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs we make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top notch.
Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to imagine what its like being an Operations Manager.

Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: that in most companies, its all about the KPIs but in TaskUs its all about solving business problems through innovation. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will all lead to one thing that your department believes in: to provide the best possible customer experience to your clients.

As Operations Manager, you are also responsible for making sure that KPIs are being met consistently. You need to come up with ways in which to effectively make each employee reach their best potential. With this, you must also be creative because you need to devise effective plans on how to make each employee reach their target.
As a leader, you must also gain the trust and respect of your employees because lets face it -- how can you lead when people don't believe you? You need to be able to reach out to them, drop by their workstations, have short chit-chats, and make them feel important. You need to be able to identify their strengths and weaknesses, take advantage of them and assign them tasks that will help them work on their weaknesses and showcase their talents. This way, you are able to manage relationships better and develop people at the same time.

Requirements:

So, what is it were looking for?

Since this is an Operations Manager post, wed need someone who already has the skills to even call themselves a Manager. Were looking for someone who has strong interpersonal skills, verbal and written communication skills and most importantly empathy. Someone who has a high affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported.
Someone who has at least three years of related working experience, preferably someone who already knows how the system works -- specializing in a customer experience operations and management.
We need someone who is responsible and has a good track record of meeting and delivering targets. Someone who can articulate him/herself well enough with others, like teammates and clients. We need someone who can multitask and work in a fast-paced environment. Someone who can lead and is great in analyzing situations and data.

Description:
As a Quality Analyst, you will provide world-class service to your clients in an accurate, efficient and respectful manner on every call as measured by different performance metrics.
You must always strive for Good Customer Satisfaction and Experience and ensure that all calls are handled professionally based on the Quality Guidelines set by the Client. You will meet and exceed client mandated KPI's (Key Performance Indicators).
You must also ensure consistent performance based on a continuous improvement model. What else? You must also ensure that all login and Passwords (both Internal & External) are kept confidential.
You must also participate in all Internal and External mandated trainings and/or seminars.
You must have knowledge, understanding, and compliance with TaskUs policies and procedures.
Also, you must maintain knowledge of the functional area and company policies and procedures.
You will also provide feedback to management concerning possible problems or areas of improvement.

Well, we need someone with college or vocational school graduation as a qualification and whos willing to work on cyclical schedules.
So if you have at least 1-2 years of working experience in the related field (Quality tools, Auditing, and Customer service). Have experience on phone, email, and live chat support? That’s definitely a plus!

Meanwhile, you have experience in Customer Service, Sales, Billing, Collections and Technical Support? Even better!

We’re looking for someone who has strong verbal and written communication and comprehension skills. Someone who’s computer literate and proficient in the use of Windows OS, Apple OS X, Microsoft Office and Google applications. Can you type at least 30 WPM for voice and 35 WPM for Non-Voice campaigns? That’s what we need!

We need someone with good problem solving and critical thinking skills with a focus on issue resolution and customer satisfaction. A person who’s resourceful, able to multitask and has high attention to details will be a great addition to the team.

Description:
Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you
can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.

You must be adept at creating reports of your teams performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.

So, what are we looking for?

We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader.
Someone with college or vocational school graduation as a qualification and has at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 15+ teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company.
We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.

Job Summary
Tailored residential property management, with Brightstone.
Managing housing complexes, residential townships and residential communities requires subject matter expertise, customised services and a commitment to creating a seamless yet enjoyable living experience. At Brightstone - we are setting a new standard for excellence in residential property management, focused on enhancing resident satisfaction and property value for housing societies nationwide.


Role
Position: CRE.
Business: Property and Asset Management, Mohali.


Job Overview
You will be the face of Brightstone at the client s site and will be responsible for interacting and addressing the needs of guests / tenants by maintaining strong public relations, taking feedback / suggestions. You will also be responsible for:
Cooperate, coordinate and communicate with other departments to ensure good customer experience and taking customer feedback, after every service request/ complaint and sharing the feedback points with the team for improvement of services.
Maintaining a hospitality outlook and always look presentable.
Taking ownership of the request or complaint and ensuring they are handled effectively within TAT
Taking daily rounds of the premises and reporting any lapses/ observations to the relevant team.
Conducting timely Customer Feedback Surveys and sharing the reports with the client/management.
Responding to emergency situations (as per Brightstone policies) and contact the proper authorities when needed
Being familiar with lost and found procedures.
Nominating and attending the training programs at site/ Brightstone office.
Addressing concerns through daily checking of mails for priority requests.
Receiving calls and emails from clients.
Ensuring closure of complaints by proper communication to stakeholders.
Helping in activities like filing, checking and maintaining inventory records, MMR, DMR, complaint trackers, dashboard etc.
Updating the handover/ takeover register before end of shift for all completed/pending tasks.
Managing and participating in events, overlooking general maintenance and guest handling.


Site details
You will be working on a residential site, located at Mohali.

Reporting
You will be directly reporting to the Property Manager as per site.

Description:
Key Responsibilities of the Executive Chef

- Strategic Team Leadership: Oversee, mentor and guide the entire kitchen staff to ensure efficient and coordinated culinary operations across all shifts and kitchens.
- FSSAI & Hygiene Oversight: Enforce hygiene and sanitation protocols as per FSSAI standards. Supervise food receiving, storage and temperature control to ensure compliance at every stage.
- Menu Planning & Staff Scheduling: Collaborate with nutritionists to design sport-specific menus, approve weekly production schedules and ensure staff are briefed on athlete dietary requirements.
- Food Quality & Safety Control: Ensure adherence to food safety regulations and maintain quality standards across taste, nutritional value and presentation.
- Skill Development & Kitchen Innovation: Train chefs in advanced cooking techniques and introduce new kitchen technologies to improve operational efficiency and meal quality.
- Kitchen Operations Management: Supervise kitchen setup, oversee equipment maintenance and implement processes to maintain consistency in taste and nutrition.
- Cost Control & Procurement: Approve food budgets, optimize procurement processes and monitor food costs and consumption to minimize wastage and control expenses.
- Inventory & Resource Planning: Oversee inventory management using FIFO/FEFO principles and collaborate with administrative teams on budget forecasting and operational planning.
- Athlete-Centric Menu Design: Develop customized athlete meal plans in collaboration with nutritionists and recommend ingredient substitutions to enhance variety and nutritional performance.
- Timely Service Delivery: Ensure timely and consistent meal delivery, particularly during pre/post-training sessions and competition days.
- Staff Development & Workplace Culture: Promote fair treatment, an inclusive team environment and continuous skill development, including plate presentation and meal preparation efficiency.
- Performance Evaluation & Discipline: Assess staff performance, provide constructive feedback and implement progressive disciplinary procedures wherever necessary.
- Food Handling & Cross-Contamination Prevention: Ensure safe food cleaning, handling, storage and segregation of raw/cooked and vegetarian/non-vegetarian items across preparation and storage areas.
- HACCP Compliance & Audits: Ensure timely completion of HACCP documentation, conduct food safety audits and implement corrective actions wherever required.
- Peak & Crisis Management: Strategically manage kitchen workflows and staff resources during high-volume service periods without compromising food quality or nutritional standards.
- Staff Health & Hygiene Monitoring: Oversee staff health screening programmes and ensure periodic medical check-ups for all food handlers and kitchen personnel.

Act as the primary engagement and solution leadership point for day-to-day Salesforce delivery, priorities, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions.

Lead solutioning for Salesforce CPQ (Steelbrick), including product configuration, pricing, quoting, renewals, quote-to-order workflows, integrations, and related platform enhancements.
Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical recommendations, solution options, process designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation approaches.
Perform business systems analysis as required, including requirements clarification, process analysis, impact assessment, backlog refinement, and acceptance-criteria review.
Drive solution estimation, sprint planning, architecture reviews, release planning, and delivery governance.
Coordinate with Business Analysts, Developers, QA Engineers, Release Managers, Product Owners, and Administrators to ensure smooth Agile delivery.
Review Salesforce configurations, Apex, LWC, Flows, APIs/integrations, data and security implications, and deployment strategies to ensure quality and platform best practices.
Establish and reinforce Salesforce development standards, security practices, architecture principles, and platform governance.
Provide technical guidance, architecture oversight, and escalation support for complex enhancements, defects, production issues, and cross-system dependencies.
Manage stakeholder communication around technical decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, anticipated delays, and resolution plans.
Maintain appropriate architecture, solution, process, and decision documentation.
Participate actively in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and other delivery meetings as required.
Coach and mentor team members through technical guidance, solution reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Drive continuous platform improvement by recommending Salesforce capabilities, architectural improvements, and process optimizations.
Required Skills & Experience
10+ years of Salesforce experience, including solution architecture and delivery leadership responsibilities.
Strong hands-on understanding of Salesforce CPQ (Steelbrick) and Quote-to-Cash / Quote-to-Order processes, including product configuration, pricing, quoting, renewals, and order-related workflows.
Strong Salesforce platform knowledge across configuration, Apex, LWC, Flows, REST APIs/integrations, data model, security model, governor limits, CI/CD, and deployment considerations.
Strong expertise in Sales Cloud and Service Cloud; Experience Cloud experience is preferred.
Demonstrated business systems analysis capability, including translating business requirements into clear functional and technical solutions.
Experience with solution estimation, sprint planning, architecture reviews, delivery governance, and Agile/Scrum delivery.
Strong stakeholder management, written communication, documentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
Experience leading and mentoring distributed/offshore Salesforce teams.
Ability to balance architecture quality, delivery timelines, changing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
Ability to work with a minimum 4-hour daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
Certifications
Salesforce Certified Administrator
Salesforce Platform App Builder
Salesforce Platform Developer I
Sales Cloud Consultant
Service Cloud Consultant
Salesforce CPQ Specialist - Strongly Preferred
Salesforce Application Architect / System Architect - Preferred

Maintain clear documentation and promptly communicate material issues, risks, dependencies, and anticipated delays.

Adapt to changing priorities and assignments within the scope of the role while maintaining delivery quality

Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.

Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.

Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

DepartmentSales - Institutional Funding

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. This involves visiting and building a pipeline of prospective Institutional lending customers seeking loan for the purpose of Institutional development and meeting the channel partners on a regular basis.
Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.
2. Achieving the target assigned on a month-on-month basis.
3. Understanding the Customers loan requirement and helping them as a SPOC in the end-to-end loan journey from login to disbursement.
4. Coordinating with the customer/s or channel partners and collecting all the required documents mentioned in the policy to ensure a hassle-free loan approval process for the customer.
5. Meet the assigned Channel partners on a regular basis and generate leads/referrals for New Business Acquisition.
6. Maintaining high levels of integrity at all times while engaging with the prospective / existing customers, Channel partners and the various support teams (Credit, Operations, Service, legal etc) within Credila.
7. Training and supporting the Channel partners in understanding the process & policies, joint customer visits and timely release of payouts.
8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products

Strong Negotiation skills
Team Worker
Creative (we thrive on this)
Analytical skills
Good communication skills
Perseverance
Nimble-footed
Self-motivated
Qualifications & Experience Graduate in any stream. MBA in Marketing and Finance will be preferred
At least 3 years of relevant Sales experience in Institutional Funding product

Role & responsibilities


The Claims and Deductions Management is accountable to register, analyse and collaborate with internal stakeholders to solve customer claims and deductions including those related to returns and refusals. In addition, the role monitors open claims and deductions to ensure that the aging of those are within the market defined turnaround time for resolution.
Claims holding customers payments Responsible for gathering the required information (including internal collaboration) and document cases for the proper categorization in case of uncategorized claims Reviews and ensures that all claims related documentation is attached in the case Manages claims and deduction resolution through collaboration with Sales, MSSU / CFSC, Finance, Marketing, Physical Logistics and Supply Chain Manages the closure of non-valid claims and deductions with Collections Manages the closure of valid claims and deductions via Credit Note creation Responsible for ensuring that all customer claims and deductions are closed within predefined timeframes Trigger and Review Claims and Deductions Ageing Report Propose list of deductions to be purged and claims to be closed - According to Market Credit Policy - and execute proposal after Credit Management approval Monitor and Close Open Customer Credit Notes Resolve digitization issues and register manually customer claims in case of digitization failures Ensures regular and effective reporting of the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs/PPIs/HealthChecks) and Claims and Deduction Management activities to minimize risk and proactively identify problem areas using analytical tools. Proposes the rules to identify duplicate Claims records, rules to match deductions with credit notes and rules to match existing Credit Notes with Claim Cases. Organizes and ensures ongoing training for Claims and Deduction Management activities Participates on Continuous Improvement activities related to Claims and Deduction Management Compares and analyses differences between return requests, original POR and COD (when aplicable) and the goods received at the warehouse Assess value of the Credit Note or Debit Note linked to a return by matching SKUs in the return to the original invoice Responsible for the management and resolution of Over and Under deliveries cases including the interactions with Physical Logistics and other E2E functions when needed (e.g. Demand Management, Billing, Payment Applications) Ensures regular and effective implementation of the Returns and Refusals Market Policy in all customer requests Ensures regular and effective implementation of Customer specifc agreements. E.g: Extended time for POD confirmation, Collection of Returns from Indirect Customers Ensures that all supporting documentation for the Returns and Refusals cases resolution (POD, POR, PGI, COD, Sales approvals) are archived in the corresponding Indexed Document Repository Validates that no open claims (Claims and Deduction Management) related to Returns and Refusals cases remain open after the resolution of the R&R Cases Develops and sends "Rejection Letters" to customers for non-approved Returns requests Collaborates with Collections for deductions related to non-approved Returns and Refusals requests Ultimate responsible for the closure of all exception cases in the Delivery Differences Cockpit Participates on Continuous Improvement activities related to Returns and Refusals Management Organizes and executes ongoing training for Returns and Refusals Management including updates on Market R&R Policy, Best practices for Refusals Mitigation Actions, Knowledge sharing across team members Key Relationships Internal to Group: (shared / conflicting interests) Key Relationships External to Group (shared / conflicting interests)

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Area Sales Manager CCGI Doors & Windows with strong expertise in Government sales and market development.

The candidate will be responsible for achieving sales targets, developing relationships with CPWD, PWD, MES & Housing Board Departments & managing the sales team, and expanding business opportunities within the assigned territory.

Desired Candidate Profile
10 to 12 years of relevant experience in Government Sales of CCGI Doors & Windows.
Strong understanding of the CCGI Doors & Windows market and Government sales cycle.
Proven experience in handling CPWD, PWD, MES & Housing Board Departments
Good knowledge of the assigned geographical market and customer network.
Strong team-handling, negotiation and business development skills.
Fluent in English and the local language.
Graduate / Post Graduate from a reputed institution.
Key Responsibilities
Drive monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.
Develop Government business for CCGI Doors & Windows through CPWD, PWD, MES departments.
Identify and develop new business opportunities
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers and channel partners.
Develop a strong project pipeline and ensure timely conversion of leads into orders.
Lead, guide and motivate the sales team to achieve business objectives.
Prepare and implement territory-wise sales and business development strategies.
Conduct regular market visits and track competitor activities, pricing and market trends.
Understand customer/project requirements and provide appropriate technical and commercial solutions.
Coordinate with internal operations/technical teams for smooth execution of sales orders.
Follow up on order processing, dispatch, collections and outstanding payments.
Resolve customer queries and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular sales reports, project pipelines, forecasts and MIS.
Identify opportunities for increasing market share and expanding the company's presence in the assigned territory.
Perks and benefits Incentives and Travel Allowance are in addition to CTC

Description:
Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner; Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business; Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.; Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers; Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV); Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate; Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise; transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.
Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Talent Management & Succession Planning: Lead the annual talent review and calibration cycle across designated employee levels and functions; ensure completion of Hi-Potential identification, succession plans for critical positions, leadership pipeline mapping and Individual Development Plans (IDPs). Track successor readiness, IDP completion and closure of identified talent gaps through quarterly reviews.
Leadership Development: Design, deploy and evaluate Future Fit Leaders (FFL), Technical Leadership Pipeline, Future Women Leadership Program, GET Development Program, and Junior, Middle and Executive Development Programs (JDP/MDP/EDP). Establish annual programme calendars, participant criteria, learning outcomes and post-programme effectiveness measures; track completion and demonstrated application of learning.
Organisation Development & Effectiveness: Lead approved organisation development, workforce transformation, culture-building and change management initiatives. Define project milestones, stakeholder responsibilities and success metrics for each initiative; review progress periodically and measure outcomes against agreed business and organisational effectiveness objectives.
Policies, Processes & HR Digitisation: Develop, review and standardise Talent Management (TM), Organisation Development (OD), and Rewards & Recognition (R&R) policies, SOPs and governance frameworks. Maintain an approved review calendar, ensure timely revision of documents, digitise prioritised workflows and monitor process compliance, turnaround times and error rates.
Rewards & Recognition: Own the governance and execution of Long Service Awards, Spot Awards, Excellence, Innovation, Leadership and other employee recognition programmes. Publish annual programme calendars and eligibility criteria, ensure transparent nominations and approvals, monitor participation and expenditure against budget, and review programme effectiveness and employee feedback annually.
Talent Pipeline & Campus Engagement: Develop and execute annual Engineering and Management Internship and campus engagement plans in partnership with academic institutions and business stakeholders. Establish intake targets, selection timelines, structured learning plans and evaluation criteria; track internship completion, business feedback and conversion to employment, where applicable.
Higher Education & Capability Building: Administer B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, Executive Education and other approved employee development programmes. Maintain programme eligibility and approval controls, track enrolment, attendance, completion, expenditure and academic outcomes, and conduct periodic reviews of learning effectiveness and return on learning investment.
HR Analytics & Continuous Improvement: Develop and maintain periodic dashboards, MIS and scorecards covering talent reviews, succession readiness, leadership development, programme participation, R&R, higher education and talent pipeline outcomes. Establish data definitions, reporting timelines and accountability for data accuracy; use insights to identify gaps and drive measurable improvements.
Quality, Compliance & Business Excellence: Ensure adherence to applicable QMS, IATF, ISO and other relevant business excellence requirements within the functional scope. Maintain audit-ready documentation, conduct periodic process reviews, close audit findings within agreed timelines and implement corrective and preventive actions to strengthen process compliance.
Stakeholder Management & Business Alignment: Partner with Business Heads, Functional Leaders, Plant Leadership, HR teams and Corporate Centres of Excellence (COEs) to translate business priorities into annual people-development plans. Establish clear ownership, milestones and review mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, resolve implementation dependencies and report progress and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Educational Background and Work Experience
Educational Qualification & Experience: Full-time MBA/PGDM/Master's degree in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, or an equivalent discipline from a reputed institute, with 14+ years of post-qualification HR experience in (large) manufacturing organisations, including at least 5+ years of focused experience in Talent Management, Organisation Development (OD), Leadership Development, Succession Planning, and Competency Management.
Industry & Organisational Exposure: Experience in large-scale manufacturing or process industries, preferably Steel, Metals, Mining, Automotive, Cement, Engineering, Power, Oil & Gas, or Chemicals. Exposure to large Indian or multinational organisations with a workforce of 3,000+ employees, along with demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide talent management initiatives, will be an added advantage.

On-Ground Documentation & Data Management
Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all registered farmers (Farmer Diaries, Farm History Sheets, and Land Maps). Cover 3 ICS in a month

Knowledge: Understanding of the National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) or other international organic guidelines.
Skills: Strong proficiency in local languages - (preferred Telugu for South), basic computer literacy for documentation, and willingness to travel extensively within rural farming clusters.

Job description Sales (LAP) Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Description:
Company: JSW Steel Ltd.
Location: Vijayanagar, Bellary, Karnataka
Experience: 410 Years
Department: Accounts Finance
Position: Manager / Sr. Manager CA (Accounts Finance)
Job Purpose
To manage and support day-to-day accounting and financeoperations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury and GSTcompliance, ensuring accurate financial records, timely transactions andadherence to statutory and internal control requirements.
Key Roles Responsibilities
1. Accounts Payable (AP)
Manage vendor invoices, invoice processing, verification and accounting.
Ensure timely vendor payments and reconciliation of vendor accounts.
Monitor outstanding payables and resolve vendor-related discrepancies.
Ensure compliance with applicable GST provisions, TDS and other statutory requirements.
2. Accounts Receivable (AR)
Manage customer invoicing, collections and outstanding receivables.
Perform customer account reconciliations and follow up on overdue payments.
Monitor receivable ageing and support working capital management.
Coordinate with internal teams to resolve billing and payment discrepancies.
3. Treasury Banking Operations
Support daily cash flow monitoring and fund management activities.
Coordinate with banks for payment processing and banking transactions.
Assist in bank reconciliations and monitoring of bank balances.
Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
4. GST Statutory Compliance
Good understanding of GST laws, rules and compliance requirements.
Support GST reconciliations, input tax credit (ITC) validation and related documentation.
Assist in GST return preparation and filing activities.
Ensure proper accounting treatment and documentation for GST-related transactions.
5. General Accounting Reporting
Ensure accurate accounting entries and maintenance of financial records.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Prepare account reconciliations and assist in audit requirements.
Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards and internal controls.
Required Qualifications
CA / CMA
Candidates with relevant professional qualifications will be preferred.
Required Experience Skills
410 years of relevant experience in Accounts Finance.
Hands-on experience in at least one or more of the following areas:
Accounts Payable
Accounts Receivable
Treasury and Banking Operations
Good understanding of GST, including ITC, GST reconciliation and compliance.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.
Experience working on ERP systems such as SAP (FI module) will be an advantage.
Good analytical, reconciliation and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in the manufacturing / steel / industrial sector will be an added advantage.
Ability to manage financial transactions with accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong focus on process compliance, internal controls and timely execution.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Work Location: JSW Steel Ltd.,Vijayanagar, Bellary Karnataka.

Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.

Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
To provide executive, business and operational coordination support to the Business Head, ensuring effective management of priorities, stakeholder engagement, cross-functional coordination and timely execution of key business initiatives. The role requires a smart, proactive and techno-functional professional with strong business acumen, excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with senior leadership and diverse internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Executive & Business Coordination

- Manage the Business Head's priorities, meetings, business reviews, calendar and executive communications.
- Prepare management presentations, MIS, business reports, meeting agendas and minutes.
- Track key decisions, action points and ensure timely closure across stakeholders.

2. Stakeholder Management & Liaisoning

- Coordinate with internal functional heads, project teams, consultants, technology partners, EPC contractors and external agencies.
- Facilitate engagement with government authorities, regulatory bodies and industry stakeholders.
- Drive effective communication, follow-ups and resolution of critical business matters.

3. Project & Operational Coordination*

- Monitor progress of key business initiatives, plant setup, project execution, commissioning and operationalisation.
- Coordinate with engineering, procurement, finance, HR, operations and other functions to track milestones and deliverables.
- Highlight project dependencies, bottlenecks and critical issues for management intervention.

4. Business & Techno-Functional Support

- Develop an understanding of solar manufacturing, technology, plant operations, project execution and business processes.
- Consolidate technical and functional inputs into actionable management updates.
- Support evaluation and coordination of business proposals, project reviews and strategic initiatives.

5. Management Reporting & Governance

- Establish structured tracking mechanisms for business priorities, projects and management decisions.
- Ensure timely reporting, documentation and follow-through on critical deliverables.
- Handle sensitive business information and leadership communications with confidentiality.

*Candidate Profile*

- Graduate in Engineering / MBA / Business Management preferred.
- 510 years of experience in Executive Assistance, Business Management, CEO/Business Head Office, PMO or Strategy & Planning.
- Experience in manufacturing, renewable energy, solar, infrastructure or engineering-led organisations preferred.
- Strong stakeholder management, liaisoning and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, MIS and management reporting.

*Desired Persona:*
A sharp, articulate and tech-savvy professional with high ownership, strong business understanding, executive presence and the ability to operate as an effective extension of the Business Head. The individual should be equally comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, understanding technical discussions and driving execution through structured follow-ups.

Description:
Objective: To achieve the sales (Primary and Secondary), distribution and merchandising objectives for the specified routes, through a team of Market Growth Representatives for a key market (volume and image)
Title: Sales Team Leader
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Kurnool
Job Responsibilities:
1. Sales Plan Execution:
a. Coordinate and achieve sales objectives for assigned Territory routes by brand and pack on a daily basis for secondary, primary volumes (Physical Cases & unit Cases), Gross revenue (GR) & Net revenue (NR).
b. Define route plans of the Market Growth Representatives, Account Developers to optimize coverage cost effectively and ensure adequate productivity.
2. Customer Management: Drive Relationship with Outlets through the team of Market growth representative and Account Developers to ensure sustained business.
3. Market Expansion:
a. Drive Horizontal Expansion with respect to number of outlets opened versus target to improve business in the coming years.
b. Take up the responsibility of opening new outlets during market visits and provide necessary support in terms of elements, discounts, coolers etc.
c. Drive conversion of high value/ high visibility outlets to Depth Outlets (Happy Deal, Vision 2020, Teen & College Outlets, Outlets in Emerging Channels) and ensure execution as per Company norms.
d. Market share gain through various ground level interventions such as driving outlet level billing vertically & horizontally.
4. Market Execution: Execute Channel Programmers, Promotional activities for the given set of outlets. Plan for merchandising elements, coolers based on outlets/ market requirements and as per the RED standards. Prepare MGR wise action plans for improving RED (Right Execution) parameters, HE etc.
5. People Management:
a. Carry out on job trainings with Market growth representatives (Off Role) to improve Execution skills on the job. Track PJP (Permanent Journey Plan) Compliance and other productivity Metrics of the team and provide inputs to improve the same via OJT
b. Evaluate performance and skills of MDs and provide inputs via on-the-job coaching, training etc.
c. Conduct Joint Weekly, Monthly Review with ASM to review performance wrt Sales, Execution Parameters of MDs and work on agreed actions.
d. Review Performance and market issues to be resolved via daily Gate Meetings
6. Budget Management:
a. Propose Discount spend for given set of outlets to drive business. Closely monitor customer outstanding and claims and ensure compliance to credit and other policies.
7. Asset Control: Ensure regular tracking of our Assets and ensure asset movements etc in compliance to the Asset Policy.
8. Distribution Management: In routine ensure monitoring distributor ROI, SKU wise margins, DMS (Distribution Management System), scheme spend distributor to market outlets.
Supervises: Market Growth Representatives and Account Developers
Direct Reports: No
Geographical Scope: Kurnool
Business Knowledge: Knowledge of Sales & Distribution preferably in an FMCG Company
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation or MBA
Experience: 2 - 4 years
Travel: Continuous travel within the designated area 80% Travel in a month

Our 15 factories, spread across India, manufacture the beverages that India wants. And if it is about India, we better make the best. With stringent processes, world-class machines, state-of-the-art equipment, and the best packaging materials, we make 68 different beverage products in multiple categories. In doing so, we strive to leave things better than we first inherited. Be it by skewing our energy sourcing towards renewable and clean energy, or collaborating with the local communities, to make their lives better.

Job Description - Assistant Manager (AM) Sourcing

Function: Enterprise North 3

Location: Andhra Pradesh

Designation: Assistant Manager- Sourcing

Job Overview
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Assistant Manager Sourcing with strong experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, and negotiation. The candidate will be responsible for implementing effective sourcing strategies, developing reliable vendor partnerships, optimizing procurement operations, and driving business growth through data-driven decisions.

Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end sourcing operations across locations and coordinate with Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Success, and Regional Business teams.
Develop and implement strategic sourcing plans to meet business requirements and optimize procurement costs.
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new vendors across different markets.
Manage supplier relationships, monitor vendor performance, and improve Supplier NPS.
Coordinate with the Catalog team for product listing, cataloguing, and pricing strategies.
Drive technology adoption among vendors by onboarding them onto Moglix platforms for order and inventory management.
Ensure standardization of products, processes, and pricing across categories.
Implement best practices in procurement and supplier management to minimize vendor risks.
Collaborate with category teams on strategic initiatives to drive category growth.
Ensure financial compliance, including taxation, accounts receivable/payable, and periodic vendor reconciliation.
Track pan-India sourcing KPIs, analyze data, and drive root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective actions.

Required Skills
Strategic Sourcing
Supplier NPS & Vendor Management
Negotiation Skills

Candidate Requirements
Minimum 3+ years of experience in Sourcing and Procurement, preferably in the Manufacturing industry.
Sound understanding of strategic sourcing strategies and procurement processes.
Minimum 6 months to 1 year of hands-on experience in SAP Ariba, with proficiency in executing strategic sourcing events.
Excellent sales and business development skills.
Strong ownership, problem-solving abilities, and willingness to build processes from scratch.
Startup experience will be an added advantage.

Education
Graduate degree, preferably B.Tech, from a reputed institute.
MBA from a reputed institute will be an added advantage.
