Description:
You will be the main point of contact for a small group of 3 to 5 client accounts. You run their client calls, plan and track their monthly work with our specialist teams, check the work before it reaches the client, and make sure every client gets what we promised, on time. You dont do the execution yourself. Our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and tech specialists do. You make sure it happens, and that its right.


What this Role Is
youve handled client accounts at a digital marketing agency, you understand marketing well enough to brief and check the work, and youre very organised.


What this Role Is Not
your background is IT project management, sales only, or SaaS customer support without marketing.


Responsibilities
Own your clients. Be the main contact for your 3 to 5 accounts. Lead the weekly and monthly client calls, and bring in a specialist when something technical needs explaining.
Plan the month. Take each clients agreed monthly plan and turn it into dated tasks, one task per line, on your client dashboard.
Track every day. Know whats happening on every task, spot delays early, and follow up with the team before a date slips.
Check before it goes out. Make sure every deliverable matches what the client asked for and what was agreed, after our team leads have approved the craft.
Report. Send each client a weekly update and a monthly report that explains results clearly.
Handle changes properly. Know the difference between a revision and new work. Log extra requests and get them priced, rather than quietly absorbing them.
Chase client inputs. Get the approvals, access and content you need from the client, early and in writing.
Keep and grow your accounts. Look after renewals, and spot where a client would benefit from more of our services.
Know your numbers. Understand the revenue and cost of your client group, and help keep it healthy.


Requirements
3 to 6 years of experience, with at least 2 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled at least 3 clients at the same time
Understands social media, ads, SEO and content, and design and video well enough to brief and check the work
Very organised: trackers, dashboards or project tools like Asana, ClickUp, Trello or Google Sheets
Calm and clear in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to Have
International clients (UK, US, UAE)
Both B2B and B2C clients
Understands marketing numbers: leads, cost per lead, traffic, engagement
Experience preparing client reports and presentations


Not Needed
Hands-on execution skills. Our specialist teams do the work.


KPIs
Your clients get what we promised, on time
Little work sent back by clients
Your clients renew and grow with us
Problems caught by you before the client notices
Clear, on-time weekly updates and monthly reports


Perks
Own a small, focused group of accounts: no juggling 15 clients
Specialist teams behind you, so you can focus on the client
A clear path to Client Servicing Lead

At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. Saturday Art Class is a non-profit organization that provides visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) education to children from low-income communities in India. By creating safe spaces for students to express themselves, we help them build essential skills to thrive during their formative years.
Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege, for every child, everywhere.
Role Overview
The Manager will play a critical role in anchoring the organization\'s work in Meghalaya by serving as a key bridge between the Mumbai-based team and state government stakeholders. The role will ensure seamless coordination across partnerships, training initiatives, curriculum contextualisation, and on-ground implementation. Working closely with government officials, school systems, and internal teams, the Manager will enable effective communication, alignment, and execution, ensuring that program design is responsive to the local context while staying aligned with organizational goals.
Roles and Responsibilities
Government Liaisoning and Partnerships
Act as a key point of coordination with government stakeholders, including DERT, the Directorate of School Education, and the MPower team
Support communication, scheduling, and follow-ups for meetings, reviews, and program updates
Build and maintain strong working relationships with state and district-level stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuity
Prepare briefs, reports, and communication materials for government engagements
Proactively engage with government stakeholders to understand priorities, evolving needs, and policy directions, and translate these into program actions
Ensure timely sharing of updates, data, and reports with government officials to build trust and transparency.
Support the preparation and facilitation of review meetings, presentations, and field visits with government stakeholders.
Track key decisions, approvals, and action points from government interactions, ensuring timely follow-through.
Identify opportunities to deepen the partnership, including scale-up, integration into existing systems, and long-term collaboration.
Training Coordination and Support
Plan and coordinate teacher training programs in collaboration with internal teams and government partners
Manage logistics, communication, and on-ground facilitation support for training sessions.
Track participation, engagement, and feedback from educators to inform ongoing improvements.
Support documentation of training processes and outcomes.
Curriculum Contextualisation
Act as a key bridge between government stakeholders and the internal curriculum team to co-develop a contextually relevant and effective well-being curriculum
Work closely with the curriculum team to adapt and contextualise the visual arts curriculum for Meghalaya
Incorporate local culture, practices, and classroom realities into curriculum design
Facilitate continuous feedback loops between government stakeholders, educators, and the curriculum team
Support pilot implementation of curriculum in schools and gather insights for iteration
Ensure alignment of curriculum with state priorities and education frameworks
Monitoring, Evaluation, and On-Ground Observations
Conduct regular school visits to observe classroom implementation and training impact
Collect qualitative and quantitative data to support monitoring and evaluation efforts
Document classroom practices, student engagement, and educator facilitation
Regularly review program dashboards and extract relevant insights to share with government officials and internal teams
Present key data points and trends to support decision-making, program improvements, and stakeholder updates
Share insights and feedback with internal teams to strengthen program design and delivery.
Program Coordination and Execution
Ensure alignment across partnerships, training, curriculum, and M&E workstreams, proactively identifying and resolving gaps.
Track progress of key program activities, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring accountability across teams.
Support and drive internal coordination between teams to enable smooth and timely on-ground execution.
Flag risks, delays, and dependencies early, and work with relevant stakeholders to problem-solve and course-correct.
Maintain structured trackers and systems for program management, ensuring visibility and transparency across teams.
Contribute to periodic reports, case studies, and program updates for both internal review and external stakeholders.
Support planning and execution of review meetings with government and internal teams, ensuring clear documentation and follow-through on action points.
Qualifications & Experience
5-6 years of experience in program management, operations, communications, consulting, or similar roles
Experience working closely with senior leadership and/or government stakeholders, with the ability to manage both strategic and operational responsibilities
Prior experience in the education or social sector is preferred, especially within government or school-based programs
Experience working in or with government systems, NGOs, or multi-stakeholder environments, particularly in Northeast India, is an added advantage
Demonstrated experience in professional writing, stakeholder communication, and supporting training or capacity-building initiatives, along with the ability to manage field operations and program tracking, documentation, and basic M&E processes.
Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, project management platforms, and communication tools
Based in Shillong, Meghalaya, with a willingness to travel across districts in Meghalaya as required
Working knowledge of Khasi and/or Garo is strongly preferred
Skills and Mindset
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with government stakeholders and represent the organization clearly
High ownership, reliability, and follow-through; able to independently drive workstreams and ensure closure
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in managing multiple priorities and stakeholders
Ability to operate in dynamic, on-ground contexts

Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.

Looker Studio reporting
Both B2B and B2C clients

Cost per lead and cost per sale improving for each client
Budgets never overspent

Problems caught by us, not by the client

Position Details
- Position: Video Presenter & Digital Content Correspondent
- Work Location: Primarily Remote (Work From Home)

- Experience: Fresh graduates and experienced candidates are welcome.
- Employment: Paid position under Innercall Media Pvt. Ltd.
Key Responsibilities
- Present regional news, current affairs, and social issues through on-camera videos.
- Research and present stories related to regionalism, identity, indigenous communities, culture, history, and contemporary society.
- Participate in developing and presenting original documentary series and in-depth explainers.
- Record voice-overs and narrations for documentaries, Shorts, and long-form content.

Recruitment & Selection Process
Round 1 Paid Assignment
Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid assignment involving a video presentation, narration, or research-based storytelling task.
The assignment will help us evaluate communication, research, storytelling, presentation skills, and understanding of regional issues.
Candidates completing the assignment according to the agreed requirements will receive the communicated payment, regardless of final selection.
Round 2 — Online Interview
Candidates selected after reviewing their assignments will be invited for an online interview.
Final selection will be based on the overall assessment of both rounds.
Who Can Apply?
We welcome applicants who:
- Have strong communication skills in English and/or Hindi.
- Are comfortable speaking on camera and recording audio.
- Have an interest in journalism, documentaries, regional affairs, and storytelling.
- Can independently research and present topics with accuracy and sensitivity.
- Are comfortable working remotely and undertaking occasional travel when required.
- Are willing to learn, contribute creative ideas, and grow professionally with the platform.
Previous professional media experience is not mandatory. Fresh graduates and aspiring journalists are encouraged to apply.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted regarding the paid assignment.
Request to Your Institution

Description:
Job Summary
You will run hiring, onboarding, attendance and day-to-day HR for a growing marketing agency of 20+ people.


Responsibilities
Run hiring. Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Internshala, Instagram and through referrals, within a day of a role being approved.
Screen candidates. Review applications, make first screening calls, check portfolios for creative roles, and shortlist for interviews.
Keep the process moving. Schedule interviews, collect feedback, follow up with candidates, and keep the hiring tracker updated every day.
Close hires. Coordinate offer letters, documents and joining.
Onboard well. Make sure every new joiner knows their role, their manager, working hours and expectations on day one. Check in at 7, 15 and 30 days.
Manage interns. Keep a monthly pipeline of interns, and track strong interns for full-time roles.
Track attendance and leave. Keep records current, and make sure leave is requested properly.
Support a professional workplace. Have early, calm conversations when behaviour, attendance or workload becomes an issue, and keep the founders informed.
Keep role documents current. Keep job descriptions and role sheets up to date with the team leads.


Requirements
2 to 6 years in recruitment, talent acquisition or HR operations
Hands-on hiring experience: posting, screening calls, scheduling and follow-ups
Comfortable on the phone with candidates every day
Organised, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
Calm and firm, and good with young teams
Good written and spoken English


Nice To Have
Hiring for creative or marketing roles
Experience at a startup, agency or small company
Has hired interns in volume
Has built onboarding checklists or hiring trackers


KPIs
Jobs posted within 24 hours of approval
Applicants reviewed within 2 to 3 days, and shortlisted candidates contacted within 24 hours
No open role left stuck
Every new joiner set up on day one
Attendance and leave records always current


Job Type
Full-time


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Job Summary
You will write and run marketing for our B2B and B2C clients: blogs, LinkedIn posts, website copy and emails, plus SEO and cold email campaigns.


Role Overview
you write clearly, youre curious about SEO and email marketing, and youre careful with facts.


What the role is not
you mainly want to do social media posting, graphic design or paid ads.


Experience
1 to 3 years (freshers with strong writing samples are welcome)


Responsibilities
Write. Blogs, LinkedIn posts, website copy and email copy, in each clients voice.
Check facts. Link every statistic and claim to its original source. If it cant be sourced, it comes out.
Support SEO. Keyword research, on-page SEO, publishing blogs on WordPress, and refreshing older pages.
Run email campaigns. Build prospect lists, set up email sequences, send test emails, and reply to responses within a working day.
Help with websites. Paste approved copy into pages exactly as written, and flag anything missing.
Use AI tools well. Use them to research and draft faster, then check and improve everything they produce.
Report. Update trackers and help prepare weekly reports.


Requirements
1 to 3 years in content writing, SEO or email marketing (or strong samples if youre a fresher)
Excellent written English
Basic understanding of SEO
Careful with facts and details
Comfortable with Google Docs, Sheets and AI writing tools
Takes feedback well


Nice to Have
WordPress
Ahrefs, Semrush or Search Console
Apollo, Instantly, Lemlist or similar email tools
LinkedIn writing
Experience with both B2B and B2C writing


KPIs
Clear, accurate writing with few rewrites needed
No unsourced claims in published work
Email campaigns that go out correctly, with fast replies
Tasks completed on time


Growth Path
Digital Marketing Executive, then Senior Executive, then Growth Marketing Lead.


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.


Job Type
Full-time

Description:
Job Summary
You will shoot and edit video for our B2B and B2C clients: reels, shorts, founder videos, podcasts, customer stories, ads and event coverage.
Job Type: Full-time


Responsibilities
Plan shoots. Shot lists, locations, timings and what the client needs to prepare.
Shoot. Founder videos, talking heads, brand content, testimonials, events and podcasts. Youll handle framing, lighting and clean audio.
Edit. Reels, shorts, YouTube videos, podcasts and ads, with strong hooks, good pacing and captions, ready for each platform.
Repurpose. Turn one long shoot into several short clips, in every size each platform needs.
Keep each clients style consistent. Follow the agreed style for each brand: fonts, colours, captions and pace.
Make video ads. Edit ads for our paid ads team, in the versions and sizes they need.
Stay organised. Keep footage and project files organised and backed up, so anything can be found later.
Raise the standard. Review edits from freelancers or junior editors, and suggest better ideas for shots, hooks and stories.
Requirements
3 to 6 years of video editing and shooting, with brand or business content
A portfolio with reels, shorts and talking-head work for real clients
Strong in Premiere Pro, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve
Comfortable shooting with a DSLR or mirrorless camera, lights and mics
Fast, reliable turnaround
Takes feedback well
Nice To Have
Motion graphics (After Effects)
Podcast or multi-camera shoots
An eye for thumbnails and covers
Video ads experience
Has guided a junior editor
KPIs
Videos delivered on time
Few revisions needed
Consistent quality and style for each client
Video results like views and watch time improving
Perks
Shoot and edit for a wide range of B2B and B2C brands
Room to shape our in-house video style
Work alongside designers, social media and ads teams

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

Description:
Field Associate - West Jaintia Hills (Khasi Language)
Location: Meghalaya
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Role Overview
Ground Zero is seeking an energetic Field Associate to empower women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) under our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). The candidate will work independently on the ground, driving member participation, enterprise governance, local business operations, procurement, and market linkages in agri-business and rural commodities.
Key Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business activities, procurement, aggregation, and local marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Assist PG leaders in executing business plans across local value chains (agri-commodities, spices, etc.). Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, and logistics service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Guide PG leaders in maintaining financial discipline, books of accounts, meeting documentation, and governance records.
Capacity Building & Training: Organize and conduct block- and district-level training sessions for women entrepreneurs and producer group leaders.
Strategic Linkages & Stakeholder Support: Facilitate market, credit, and institutional linkages with government departments and community institutions with strategic guidance from senior leadership.
Field Monitoring & Reporting: Conduct needs assessments, value chain studies, and submit regular updates on field progress, financials, and operational challenges.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Social Work, or a related discipline (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, livelihood promotion, SHGs/PGs, or enterprise development. Candidates from development/enterprise fellowship programs are also eligible.
Language Mandatory: Fluency in written and spoken Khasi is mandatory. Basic proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable.
Key Competencies: Strong field facilitation skills, basic computer proficiency (MS Excel, Word), and a proactive approach to solving field challenges.
Logistics: Owning a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly preferred for rural movement. Periodic travel to Shillong and Guwahati for strategic reviews will be required.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though eligible male candidates are welcome to apply.

The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .
